// ---------- simulated clock (memory timestamps follow the session dates; "today" in prompts too) ----------
let clockT = Date.UTC(2023, 0, 1);
const RealDate = Date;
globalThis.Date = class extends RealDate {
  constructor(...args) {
    if (args.length === 0) super(clockT);
    else super(...args);
  }
  static now() {
    return ++clockT;
  }
};

// ---------- model calls ----------
const ANSWER_SYSTEM =
  "You are AURA, a personal assistant. Answer the user's question about themselves as briefly and exactly as you can, using only the information given. " +
  "If the information is not enough, say that you do not know.";
const JUDGE_SYSTEM =
  "You grade an assistant's answer against a reference answer. Reply with JSON {\"correct\": true|false}. " +
  "Answer true if the response contains the correct answer, or is equivalent to it, or contains all the intermediate steps to get it. " +
  "Answer false if the response only contains a subset of the information required, or gives a different answer. " +
  "If the response contains some previous (outdated) information together with an updated answer, it is correct as long as the updated answer is the required answer.";
const ANSWER_SCHEMA = { type: "object", properties: { answer: { type: "string" } }, required: ["answer"] };
const JUDGE_SCHEMA = { type: "object", properties: { correct: { type: "boolean" } }, required: ["correct"] };

let policyNow = "auto";
let lastCall = 0;
const gap = 60000 / cfg.rpm;
const latency = [];
const norm = (s) => String(s ?? "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}\s]/gu, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

// rule-based stand-in for Gemini, used only with --check-with-sim (understands the fixture's sentences)
function simHandler(args) {
  const { system = "", prompt = "" } = args;
  if (/maintain the long-term memory/.test(system)) {
    const cands = parseCandidates(prompt);
    const lines = prompt.split("New messages to process:")[1]?.split("\n").filter((l) => l.startsWith("User: ")).map((l) => l.slice(6)) || [];
    const ops = [];
    const findC = (re) => cands.find((c) => re.test(c.content));
    for (const line of lines) {
      let m;
      if ((m = /I live in (\w+)|moved to (\w+)/.exec(line))) {
        const v = m[1] || m[2];
        const c = findC(/^The user lives in/);
        const content = `The user lives in ${v}.`;
        if (!c) ops.push({ action: "add", content, category: "personal" });
        else if (c.content !== content) ops.push({ action: "update", memory_id: c.id, content, category: "personal" });
      } else if ((m = /I (?:now )?work at (\w+)/.exec(line))) {
        const content = `The user works at ${m[1]}.`;
        const c = findC(/^The user works at/);
        if (!c) ops.push({ action: "add", content, category: "work" });
        else if (c.content !== content) ops.push({ action: "update", memory_id: c.id, content, category: "work" });
      } else if ((m = /I like (\w+)/.exec(line))) {
        const content = `The user likes ${m[1]}.`;
        if (!cands.some((c) => c.content === content)) ops.push({ action: "add", content, category: "preference" });
      }
    }
    return { operations: ops };
  }
  if (system.startsWith("You are AURA, a personal assistant. Answer")) {
    const q = /Question: (.*)/.exec(prompt)?.[1] || "";
    const re = /live/i.test(q) ? /(?:lives in|live in|moved to) (\w+)/g : /(?:works at|work at) (\w+)/g;
    const found = [...prompt.matchAll(re)].map((m) => m[1]);
    const context = prompt.includes("Conversation history:");
    return { answer: found.length ? (context ? found[found.length - 1] : found[0]) : "I do not know." };
  }
  if (system.startsWith("You grade")) {
    const gold = /Correct answer: (.*)/.exec(prompt)?.[1] || "";
    const resp = /Model response: (.*)/.exec(prompt)?.[1] || "";
    return { correct: norm(resp).includes(norm(gold)) };
  }
  throw new Error("unexpected model call in the simulation");
}

env.gem.setHandler(async (args, realGen) => {
  const isExtract = /maintain the long-term memory/.test(args.system || "");
  let res;
  if (check) res = simHandler(args);
  else {
    const wait = lastCall + gap - performance.now();
    if (wait > 0) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, wait));
    lastCall = performance.now();
    const t0 = performance.now();
    res = await realGen(args);
    latency.push(performance.now() - t0);
  }
  // append-only memory (the usual default of memory layers): a changed fact is stored as one more fact and the
  // old one stays active; nothing is retired or deleted. (Experiment 1 simply drops changes; here the new value
  // is kept, which is what an append-only system does with "I have just moved to Hyderabad".)
  if (isExtract && policyNow === "append") {
    res = {
      ...res,
      operations: (res.operations || []).filter((o) => o.action === "add" || (o.action === "update" && o.content)).map((o) => ({ action: "add", content: o.content, category: o.category })),
    };
  }
  return res;
});

// ---------- one question under one policy ----------
const sessionText = (s) => s.turns.map((t) => `${t.role === "user" ? "User" : "AURA"}: ${trunc(t.content, t.role)}`).join("\n");
const trunc = (text, role) => (role === "assistant" && text.length > cfg.assistantChars ? text.slice(0, cfg.assistantChars) + " â€¦" : text);

async function ingest(sessions, policy) {
  env.reset();
  env.saveSettings({ autoMemory: true, confirmMemoryChanges: policy === "gate" });
  const msg = env.db.prepare("INSERT INTO messages(conversation_id, role, modality, text, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'text', ?, ?)");
  const res = { prompts: 0, accepted: 0, rejected: 0, extractionErrors: 0, lastError: "" };
  for (const s of sessions) {
    clockT = s.date;
    const t = Date.now();
    const convId = Number(env.db.prepare("INSERT INTO conversations(started_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?)").run(t, t).lastInsertRowid);
    for (const turn of s.turns) msg.run(convId, turn.role === "user" ? "user" : "assistant", trunc(String(turn.content ?? ""), turn.role), Date.now());
    try {
      await env.mem.extractFromConversation(convId);
    } catch (err) {
      res.extractionErrors++;
      res.lastError = String(err?.message || err);
    }
    if (policy === "gate") {
      for (const p of env.mem.listProposals()) {
        res.prompts++;
        const ok = cfg.reviewer === "accept" ? true : cfg.reviewer === "reject" ? false : s.evidence;
        if (ok) {
          await env.mem.acceptProposal(p.id);
          res.accepted++;
        } else {
          env.mem.rejectProposal(p.id);
          res.rejected++;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return res;
}

async function answerFrom(q, sessions, mode) {
  let body = "";
  let top = [];
  if (mode === "memory") {
    top = await env.mem.searchMemories(q.question, cfg.k);
    const fmtDate = (m) => (cfg.withDates ? `[${new Date(m.updatedAt).toISOString().slice(0, 10)}] ` : "");
    body = `Memories about the user:\n${top.length ? top.map((m) => `- ${fmtDate(m)}${m.content}`).join("\n") : "(none)"}\n`;
  } else if (mode === "context") {
    body = `Conversation history:\n${sessions.map((s) => `--- ${new Date(s.date).toISOString().slice(0, 10)} ---\n${sessionText(s)}`).join("\n")}\n`;
  }
  clockT = parseDate(q.question_date, clockT);
  const prompt = `Today's date: ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}\n\n${body}\nQuestion: ${q.question}`;
  const res = await env.gem.generateJSON({ system: ANSWER_SYSTEM, prompt, schema: ANSWER_SCHEMA });
  return { response: String(res?.answer ?? ""), top };
}

async function grade(q, response) {
  const strict = norm(response).includes(norm(q.answer)) ? 1 : 0;
  if (!cfg.judge) return { strict, judged: null };
  const res = await env.gem.generateJSON({
    system: JUDGE_SYSTEM,
    prompt: `Question: ${q.question}\nCorrect answer: ${q.answer}\nModel response: ${response.replace(/\n/g, " ")}`,
    schema: JUDGE_SCHEMA,
  });
  return { strict, judged: res?.correct ? 1 : 0 };
}

// ---------- main loop ----------
const outOfTime = budget(Number(a.budget));
const done = new Set(readRows(out, "runs.jsonl").map((r) => `${r.policy}|${r.qid}`));
let stop = false;

for (const { q, sessions } of plan) {
  if (stop || outOfTime()) break;
  const units = [...cfg.baselines.map((b) => ({ name: b, kind: "baseline" })), ...cfg.policies.map((p) => ({ name: p, kind: "policy" }))];
  for (const u of units) {
    if (done.has(`${u.name}|${q.question_id}`)) continue;
    const before = { ...env.gem.usage };
    policyNow = u.kind === "policy" ? u.name : "none";
    let ing = { prompts: 0, accepted: 0, rejected: 0, extractionErrors: 0, lastError: "" };
    let ans;
    if (u.kind === "policy") {
      ing = await ingest(sessions, u.name);
      if (ing.extractionErrors > 0 && !check) {
        console.log(`${u.name} ${q.question_id}: ${ing.extractionErrors} extraction request(s) failed (${ing.lastError}). Not saved. Wait (quota?) and continue with: npm run eval:lme -- --out "${out}" --yes`);
        stop = true;
        break;
      }
      ans = await answerFrom(q, sessions, "memory");
    } else {
      ans = await answerFrom(q, sessions, u.name === "context" ? "context" : "none");
    }
    const g = await grade(q, ans.response);
    const gold = norm(q.answer);
    const rows = env.db.prepare("SELECT content, status FROM memories").all();
    const activeText = norm(rows.filter((r) => r.status === "active").map((r) => r.content).join(" . "));
    const topText = norm(ans.top.map((m) => m.content).join(" . "));
    const row = {
      policy: u.name,
      kind: u.kind,
      qid: q.question_id,
      qtype: q.question_type,
      sessions: sessions.length,
      evidenceSessions: sessions.filter((s) => s.evidence).length,
      judged: g.judged,
      strict: g.strict,
      goldInActive: u.kind === "policy" && gold ? (activeText.includes(gold) ? 1 : 0) : null,
      goldInTop: u.kind === "policy" && gold ? (topText.includes(gold) ? 1 : 0) : null,
      activeN: u.kind === "policy" ? rows.filter((r) => r.status === "active").length : null,
      inactiveN: u.kind === "policy" ? rows.filter((r) => r.status !== "active").length : null,
      prompts: ing.prompts,
      accepted: ing.accepted,
      rejected: ing.rejected,
      requests: env.gem.usage.calls - before.calls,
      promptTokens: env.gem.usage.promptTokens - before.promptTokens,
      outputTokens: env.gem.usage.outputTokens - before.outputTokens,
      gold: q.answer,
      response: ans.response.slice(0, 300),
    };
    appendRows(out, "runs.jsonl", [row]);
    if (u.kind === "policy") appendRows(out, "memories.jsonl", [{ policy: u.name, qid: q.question_id, gold: q.answer, memories: rows }]);
    console.log(`${u.name.padEnd(8)} ${String(q.question_id).padEnd(12)} judged ${g.judged ?? "-"} strict ${g.strict}` + (u.kind === "policy" ? `  answer-in-memory ${row.goldInActive}  prompts ${row.prompts}  active ${row.activeN}/${row.activeN + row.inactiveN}` : ""));
  }
}
env.cleanup();

// ---------- summary ----------
const rowsAll = readRows(out, "runs.jsonl");
const names = [...cfg.baselines, ...cfg.policies];
const complete = plan.filter(({ q }) => names.every((n) => rowsAll.some((r) => r.policy === n && r.qid === q.question_id))).map(({ q }) => q.question_id);
if (complete.length < plan.length) {
  console.log(`\n${complete.length} of ${plan.length} questions complete. Continue with:  npm run eval:lme -- --out "${out}" --yes`);
  process.exit(0);
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "runs.csv"), toCSV(rowsAll));

// exact two-sided sign test for paired outcomes (b = only first right, c = only second right)
function signTest(b, c) {
  const n = b + c;
  if (!n) return 1;
  const k = Math.min(b, c);
  let p = 0;
  let coef = 1; // C(n, i)
  for (let i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
    p += coef;
    coef = (coef * (n - i)) / (i + 1);
  }
  return Math.min(1, (2 * p) / 2 ** n);
}

const score = (r) => (cfg.judge ? r.judged : r.strict);
const by = (n) => rowsAll.filter((r) => r.policy === n);
const md = [];
md.push(`# Experiment 5: LongMemEval ${cfg.questionTypes.join("/")} (${cfg.model})`);
md.push("");
md.push(
  `${plan.length} questions from ${cfg.dataFile}; each played with its evidence sessions plus ${cfg.distractorSessions} distractor session(s) (seed ${cfg.seed}); ` +
    `answers from the top ${cfg.k} memories of AURA's search; candidate selection: ${cfg.extractMinScore}, mode \`${cfg.candidates ?? "default"}\`, re-proposal limit ${cfg.repropose ?? 0}; gate reviewer: ${cfg.reviewer}. ` +
    `Accuracy = ${cfg.judge ? "Gemini judge (knowledge-update rule)" : "strict string match"}, with 95% Wilson interval. ` +
    `"Answer in memory" = a normalised active memory contains the reference answer string (a heuristic, only meaningful for short answers).`
);
md.push("");
md.push(
  mdTable(
    ["system", "n", "accuracy [95% CI]", "strict match", "answer in active memory", "answer in top-k", "prompts / question", "active memories", "superseded or outdated", "requests"],
    names.map((n) => {
      const s = by(n);
      const k = s.reduce((t, r) => t + (score(r) || 0), 0);
      const [lo, hi] = wilson(k, s.length);
      const pol = s.filter((r) => r.kind === "policy");
      const m = (key) => (pol.length ? fmt(mean(pol.map((r) => r[key])), 2) : "n/a");
      return [n, s.length, `${fmt(k / s.length)} [${fmt(lo)}, ${fmt(hi)}]`, fmt(mean(s.map((r) => r.strict))), pol.length ? fmt(mean(pol.map((r) => r.goldInActive))) : "n/a", pol.length ? fmt(mean(pol.map((r) => r.goldInTop))) : "n/a", m("prompts"), m("activeN"), m("inactiveN"), s.reduce((t, r) => t + r.requests, 0)];
    })
  )
);
md.push("");
md.push("Paired comparisons (same questions; b = only the first system is right, c = only the second; exact two-sided sign test):");
md.push("");
const pairs = [];
for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < names.length; j++) pairs.push([names[i], names[j]]);
md.push(
  mdTable(
    ["first", "second", "b", "c", "p"],
    pairs.map(([x, y]) => {
      let b = 0;
      let c = 0;
      for (const id of complete) {
        const rx = by(x).find((r) => r.qid === id);
        const ry = by(y).find((r) => r.qid === id);
        const sx = score(rx) || 0;
        const sy = score(ry) || 0;
        if (sx && !sy) b++;
        if (!sx && sy) c++;
      }
      return [x, y, b, c, fmt(signTest(b, c))];
    })
  )
);
md.push("");
md.push("Every row: runs.csv. Every final memory store: memories.jsonl. The model's answers are in the `response` column.");
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "summary.md"), md.join("\n") + "\n");
writeJSON(path.join(out, "run-info.json"), { finishedAt: new RealDate().toISOString(), node: process.version, platform: `${process.platform}-${process.arch}`, meanLatencyMs: mean(latency) });
console.log(`\nResults: ${out}`);

// Experiment 3: can the extractor see the memory it should change?
// AURA's extractor may only update, retire or forget memories that are shown in its prompt: the 12 most
// related to the new messages (searchMemories) plus the 8 most recently confirmed (coreMemories). When the
// user says "I've just moved to Hyderabad" and the old "The user lives in Pune." is not among them, the
// old fact cannot be replaced and stays active next to the new one. This measures how often that happens
// as the store grows, using AURA's real candidate selection and the local embedding model. No Gemini calls.
//
//   npm run eval:reach
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
import { openIsolated, EVAL_DIR } from "./lib/env.mjs";
import { SLOTS, factOf, fillerSample } from "./lib/scenarios.mjs";
import { rng, hash, pick, shuffle } from "./lib/rng.mjs";
import { mean, fmt, toCSV, mdTable, writeJSON, wilson, outDir, appendRows, readRows, budget } from "./lib/stats.mjs";

const { values: a } = parseArgs({
  options: {
    stores: { type: "string", default: "30" },
    sizes: { type: "string", default: "0,25,50,100,200,350" },
    out: { type: "string" },
    budget: { type: "string", default: "0" },
  },
});
const out = outDir(EVAL_DIR, "reachability", a.out);
const cfgFile = path.join(out, "config.json");
const cfg = fs.existsSync(cfgFile)
  ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(cfgFile, "utf8"))
  : { experiment: "reachability", stores: Number(a.stores), sizes: a.sizes.split(",").map(Number), related: 12, recent: 8 };
if (!fs.existsSync(cfgFile)) writeJSON(cfgFile, { ...cfg, startedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
const outOfTime = budget(Number(a.budget));
const doneStores = new Set(readRows(out, "changes.jsonl").map((r) => `${r.size}|${r.store}`)); // checkpoint per store

const env = await openIsolated();
const { mem, models, db } = env;
const DAY = 86400000;
const fill = (tpl, v) => tpl.replaceAll("{v}", v);

// Two more ways to say each change (the first phrasing comes from scenarios.mjs), so the result does not
// hinge on one sentence. Used only here; Experiment 1 keeps its original sentences.
const MORE = {
  city: { update: ["We relocated to {v} last month.", "My new address is in {v}."] },
  employer: { update: ["I started a new job at {v}.", "I'm now working for {v}."], retire: ["I resigned and I'm taking a break from work.", "I'm unemployed at the moment."] },
  pet: { update: ["Sorry, I got it wrong earlier: my dog's name is {v}.", "We renamed our dog to {v}."], retire: ["Our dog died recently.", "We don't have a dog anymore."] },
  sister: {},
  diet: { update: ["I've become {v}.", "From now on my diet is {v}."] },
  gym: { update: ["My workouts are now at {v}.", "I changed my gym slot to {v}."], retire: ["I cancelled my gym membership.", "I don't work out anymore."] },
  language: { update: ["I switched to studying {v}.", "Now I'm taking {v} classes."], retire: ["I stopped my language classes.", "I'm not studying any language now."] },
  car: { update: ["I upgraded to a {v}.", "My new car is a {v}."], retire: ["I got rid of my car.", "I don't own a car anymore."] },
  project: { update: ["I'm now heading the {v} project.", "They put me on project {v}."], retire: ["The project I was leading is done.", "I'm not on any project right now."] },
  coffee: { update: ["I've switched to having my coffee {v}.", "Now I drink my coffee {v}."], retire: ["I don't drink coffee anymore.", "I gave up coffee."] },
  hobby: { update: ["These days I'm really into {v}.", "I've picked up {v} as my main hobby."] },
  birthday: {},
};
const MODES = ["default", "nomin", "sentence", "adaptive"]; // candidate selection modes compared (server/memory.mjs)
const FORGET = ["Please forget what I told you about {l}.", "Delete what you know about {l}.", "Don't remember anything about {l}."];
for (const size of cfg.sizes) {
  for (let s = 0; s < cfg.stores; s++) {
    if (doneStores.has(`${size}|${s}`)) continue;
    if (outOfTime()) break;
    const rows = [];
    env.reset();
    const r = rng(hash(`reach|${size}|${s}`));
    // one value for every slot, plus N unrelated facts, learned at random times over 90 days
    const values = Object.fromEntries(SLOTS.map((sl) => [sl.key, pick(sl.values, r)]));
    const contents = shuffle([...SLOTS.map((sl) => factOf(sl.key, values[sl.key])), ...fillerSample(size, `reach|${size}|${s}`)], r);
    const ins = db.prepare("INSERT INTO memories(content, category, status, source, embedding, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, 'other', 'active', 'manual', ?, ?, ?)");
    for (const c of contents) {
      const t = Date.now() - Math.floor(r() * 90 * DAY);
      ins.run(c, env.f32ToBlob(await models.embedText(c)), t, t);
    }
    const all = db.prepare("SELECT id, content, embedding FROM memories").all().map((x) => ({ ...x, vec: new Float32Array(new Uint8Array(x.embedding).buffer) }));
    const idOf = new Map(all.map((x) => [x.content, x.id]));
    const recentIds = new Set(mem.coreMemories(cfg.recent).map((m) => m.id));

    for (const sl of SLOTS) {
      const target = idOf.get(factOf(sl.key, values[sl.key]));
      const newV = sl.values.find((v) => v !== values[sl.key]);
      const utterances = [];
      if (sl.update) [sl.update, ...(MORE[sl.key].update || [])].forEach((t, k) => utterances.push(["update", k, fill(t, newV)]));
      if (sl.retire) [sl.retire, ...(MORE[sl.key].retire || [])].forEach((t, k) => utterances.push(["retire", k, t]));
      FORGET.forEach((t, k) => utterances.push(["forget", k, t.replace("{l}", sl.label)]));
      // the same changes buried in a longer turn (two unrelated sentences added), as in real conversations
      const MIXERS = ["Can you set a timer for ten minutes?", "What's the weather like in Shimla today?", "Is it true that octopuses have three hearts?"];
      const plainCount = utterances.length;
      utterances.slice(0, plainCount).forEach(([kind, phrasing, text], k) =>
        utterances.push([kind, phrasing, `${text} ${MIXERS[(k + SLOTS.indexOf(sl)) % 3]} ${MIXERS[(k + SLOTS.indexOf(sl) + 1) % 3]}`, 1])
      );
      for (const [kind, phrasing, text, mixed = 0] of utterances) {
        // exactly how extractFromConversation picks candidates: searchMemories(userText, 12) + coreMemories(8)
        const related = (await mem.searchMemories(text, cfg.related)).map((m) => m.id);
        const viaRelated = related.includes(target);
        const viaRecent = recentIds.has(target);
        // the same selection without the minimum score of 0.25 (always the 12 best matches)
        const qv = await models.embedText(text);
        const ranked = all.map((x) => ({ id: x.id, h: 0.85 * models.cosine(qv, x.vec) + 0.15 * mem.lexicalScore(text, x.content) })).sort((p, q) => q.h - p.h);
        const top12 = ranked.slice(0, cfg.related).map((x) => x.id);
        const rank = ranked.findIndex((x) => x.id === target) + 1;
        // the candidate-selection modes of server/memory.mjs (selectCandidates): is the target shown, and how many are shown
        const byMode = {};
        for (const m of MODES) {
          const shown = await mem.selectCandidates(text, m);
          byMode[`reach_${m}`] = shown.some((x) => x.id === target) ? 1 : 0;
          byMode[`cand_${m}`] = shown.length;
        }
        rows.push({
          size, store: s, slot: sl.key, kind, phrasing, mixed, text,
          reachable: viaRelated || viaRecent ? 1 : 0, viaRelated: viaRelated ? 1 : 0, viaRecent: viaRecent ? 1 : 0,
          reachableNoMin: top12.includes(target) || viaRecent ? 1 : 0,
          hybridRank: rank,
          ...byMode,
        });
      }
    }
    appendRows(out, "changes.jsonl", rows);
  }
  const done = readRows(out, "changes.jsonl").filter((x) => x.size === size && !x.mixed);
  console.log(`N=${size}: ${done.length ? `reachable ${fmt(mean(done.map((x) => x.reachable)))} (related ${fmt(mean(done.map((x) => x.viaRelated)))}) after ${new Set(done.map((x) => x.store)).size} store(s)` : "not started"}`);
}
const embedStats = { ...models.embedStats };
env.cleanup();
const rows0 = readRows(out, "changes.jsonl");
const rows = rows0.filter((x) => !x.mixed);
if (!cfg.sizes.every((z) => new Set(rows0.filter((r) => r.size === z).map((r) => r.store)).size === cfg.stores)) {
  console.log(`\nNot finished. Continue with:  npm run eval:reach -- --out "${out}"`);
  process.exit(0);
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "changes.csv"), toCSV(rows));
const allRows = rows0; // plain and mixed turns; the first tables below use the single-sentence turns only (as in earlier runs)
const summary = [];
for (const size of cfg.sizes) {
  for (const kind of ["all", "update", "retire", "forget"]) {
    const sel = rows.filter((x) => x.size === size && (kind === "all" || x.kind === kind));
    const k = sel.reduce((t, x) => t + x.reachable, 0);
    const [lo, hi] = wilson(k, sel.length);
    const k2 = sel.reduce((t, x) => t + x.reachableNoMin, 0);
    const [lo2, hi2] = wilson(k2, sel.length);
    summary.push({ size, kind, n: sel.length, reachable: k / sel.length, lo, hi, viaRelated: mean(sel.map((x) => x.viaRelated)), viaRecentOnly: mean(sel.map((x) => (x.viaRecent && !x.viaRelated ? 1 : 0))), reachableNoMin: k2 / sel.length, lo2, hi2 });
  }
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "summary.csv"), toCSV(summary));
const md = [];
md.push(`# Experiment 3: can the extractor see the memory it has to change?`);
md.push(``);
md.push(`${cfg.stores} stores per size; each store has one fact for each of the 12 slots plus N unrelated facts with random ages (0-90 days). ` +
  `For every fact, the sentences a user would say to change it ("I've just moved to â€¦", "I stopped going to the gym.", "Please forget â€¦") are run through AURA's real candidate selection ` +
  `(searchMemories(text, ${cfg.related}) + coreMemories(${cfg.recent})). Reachable = the fact to change is among the candidates; 95% Wilson intervals.`);
md.push(``);
md.push(mdTable(["unrelated facts N", "change", "cases", "reachable (AURA)", "found by search", "only via the 8 most recent", "reachable without the 0.25 minimum"],
  summary.map((s) => [s.size, s.kind, s.n, `${fmt(s.reachable)} [${fmt(s.lo)}, ${fmt(s.hi)}]`, fmt(s.viaRelated), fmt(s.viaRecentOnly), `${fmt(s.reachableNoMin)} [${fmt(s.lo2)}, ${fmt(s.hi2)}]`])));
md.push(``);
const big = Math.max(...cfg.sizes);
md.push(`Each fact type is changed with 3 phrasings per kind of change (update / retire / forget); rows in changes.csv.`);
md.push(``);
md.push(`## By fact type (N = ${big})`);
md.push(``);
md.push(mdTable(["slot", "cases", "reachable (AURA)", "without minimum", "median rank of the fact (hybrid score)"],
  SLOTS.map((sl) => {
    const sel = rows.filter((x) => x.size === big && x.slot === sl.key);
    const ranks = sel.map((x) => x.hybridRank).sort((p, q) => p - q);
    return [sl.key, sel.length, fmt(mean(sel.map((x) => x.reachable)), 2), fmt(mean(sel.map((x) => x.reachableNoMin)), 2), ranks[Math.floor(ranks.length / 2)]];
  })));
// candidate-selection modes side by side
md.push(``);
md.push(`## Candidate-selection modes (server/memory.mjs \`selectCandidates\`)`);
md.push(``);
md.push(`default = AURA as shipped; nomin = no minimum score; sentence = also search each sentence separately; adaptive = sentence search, no minimum score, 24 matches when the text sounds like a change. Share of changes whose target is shown (95% Wilson), and the mean number of memories shown.`);
md.push(``);
const modeSummary = [];
for (const size of cfg.sizes) {
  for (const mixed of [0, 1]) for (const kind of ["all", "update", "retire", "forget"]) {
    const sel = allRows.filter((x) => x.size === size && !!x.mixed === !!mixed && (kind === "all" || x.kind === kind));
    const row = { size, turn: mixed ? "mixed (change + 2 unrelated sentences)" : "single sentence", kind, n: sel.length };
    for (const m of MODES) {
      const k = sel.reduce((t, x) => t + (x[`reach_${m}`] ?? 0), 0);
      const [lo, hi] = wilson(k, sel.length);
      Object.assign(row, { [`reach_${m}`]: k / sel.length, [`lo_${m}`]: lo, [`hi_${m}`]: hi, [`cand_${m}`]: mean(sel.map((x) => x[`cand_${m}`] ?? NaN)) });
    }
    modeSummary.push(row);
  }
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "summary_modes.csv"), toCSV(modeSummary));
md.push(mdTable(["unrelated facts N", "turn", "change", "cases", ...MODES.map((m) => `${m}: shown [CI] (mean candidates)`)],
  modeSummary.map((r) => [r.size, r.turn, r.kind, r.n, ...MODES.map((m) => `${fmt(r[`reach_${m}`])} [${fmt(r[`lo_${m}`])}, ${fmt(r[`hi_${m}`])}] (${fmt(r[`cand_${m}`], 1)})`)])));
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "summary.md"), md.join("\n") + "\n");
writeJSON(path.join(out, "run-info.json"), { finishedAt: new Date().toISOString(), embeddingModel: "Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2", node: process.version, platform: `${process.platform}-${process.arch}`, lastSessionEmbedStats: embedStats });
console.log(`\nResults: ${out}`);

// Experiment 4: the same scenarios with the REAL Gemini extractor (gemini-3.5-flash-lite by default).
// Needs internet access and GEMINI_API_KEY in .env. Uses requests from your daily quota, so it asks first.
//
//   npm run eval:real                        shows the plan and the number of requests, does nothing
//   npm run eval:real -- --yes               runs it (4 personas x auto + gate, about 170 requests)
//   npm run eval:real -- --yes --personas 8 --policies auto,gate,gateAll
//   npm run eval:real -- --out <folder> --yes    continue an interrupted run
//   npm run eval:real -- --check-with-sim    no Gemini: checks the value-based scorer against exact scoring
//
// Gemini writes memories in its own words, so memories are scored by the values they mention
// (eval/lib/loose.mjs). Every final memory is saved in memories.jsonl for manual inspection.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
import { openIsolated, EVAL_DIR } from "./lib/env.mjs";
import { makePersona, withRestates, isFiller } from "./lib/scenarios.mjs";

import { looseJudge, looseScore, classify } from "./lib/loose.mjs";
import { mean, ci95, fmt, toCSV, mdTable, writeJSON, outDir, appendRows, readRows, budget } from "./lib/stats.mjs";

const { values: a } = parseArgs({
  options: {
    personas: { type: "string", default: "4" },
    seeds: { type: "string", default: "1" },
    policies: { type: "string", default: "auto,gate" },
    u: { type: "string", default: "0" },
    rpm: { type: "string", default: "12" },
    "filler-initial": { type: "string", default: "30" },
    "filler-gap": { type: "string", default: "10" },
    out: { type: "string" },
    "extract-min-score": { type: "string" },
    // the two memory features under test (see server/memory.mjs); defaults = AURA as shipped
    candidates: { type: "string", default: "default" },
    repropose: { type: "string", default: "0" },
    restate: { type: "string", default: "0" },
    budget: { type: "string", default: "0" },
    yes: { type: "boolean", default: false },
    "check-with-sim": { type: "boolean", default: false },
    e: { type: "string", default: "0.1" },
  },
});
if (a["extract-min-score"] != null) process.env.AURA_EXTRACT_MIN_SCORE = a["extract-min-score"];
const check = a["check-with-sim"];

const env = await openIsolated({ clock: check ? "fake" : "real" });
const out = outDir(EVAL_DIR, check ? "real-scorer-check" : "real-gemini", a.out);
const cfgFile = path.join(out, "config.json");
const cfg = fs.existsSync(cfgFile)
  ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(cfgFile, "utf8"))
  : {
      experiment: check ? "real-scorer-check" : "real-gemini",
      personas: Number(a.personas),
      seeds: Number(a.seeds),
      policies: a.policies.split(","),
      u: Number(a.u),
      rpm: Number(a.rpm),
      fillerInitial: Number(a["filler-initial"]),
      fillerPerGap: Number(a["filler-gap"]),
      extractor: check ? `simulated, e = ${a.e}` : `Gemini ${env.config.TEXT_MODEL}`,
      e: check ? Number(a.e) : null,
      extractMinScore: process.env.AURA_EXTRACT_MIN_SCORE ?? "default (0.25)",
      candidates: a.candidates,
      repropose: Number(a.repropose),
      restate: Number(a.restate),
    };
// a resumed run keeps the features it was started with
process.env.AURA_CANDIDATES = cfg.candidates ?? "default";
process.env.AURA_REPROPOSE = String(cfg.repropose ?? 0);

const jobs = [];
for (const policy of cfg.policies) for (let seed = 1; seed <= cfg.seeds; seed++) for (let i = 0; i < cfg.personas; i++) jobs.push({ policy, seed, persona: i });
const turnsPer = mean(Array.from({ length: cfg.personas }, (_, i) => withRestates(makePersona(1, i), cfg.restate ?? 0, "1").sessions.flat().length));

if (!check) {
  if (!env.gem.hasKey()) {
    console.log("GEMINI_API_KEY is not set. Add it to the .env file in the project root.");
    env.cleanup();
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const est = Math.round(jobs.length * turnsPer);
  console.log(`Plan: ${jobs.length} persona runs (${cfg.personas} personas x ${cfg.seeds} seed(s) x ${cfg.policies.join(", ")}), ` +
    `about ${est} requests to ${env.config.TEXT_MODEL} at most ${cfg.rpm} per minute (about ${Math.ceil(est / cfg.rpm)} min).`);
  if (!a.yes) {
    console.log(`Nothing was sent. Add --yes to run it.`);
    env.cleanup();
    process.exit(0);
  }
}
if (!fs.existsSync(cfgFile)) writeJSON(cfgFile, { ...cfg, startedAt: new Date().toISOString() });

// pace the requests (free-tier keys allow only a few per minute)
let last = 0;
const paced = async (args, realGen) => {
  const gap = 60000 / cfg.rpm;
  const wait = last + gap - Date.now();
  if (wait > 0) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, wait));
  last = Date.now();
  return realGen(args);
};

const outOfTime = budget(Number(a.budget));
const done = new Set(readRows(out, "runs.jsonl").map((r) => `${r.policy}|${r.seed}|${r.persona}`));
let latency = [];
env.mem.memoryEvents.on("extraction", (x) => latency.push(x.latencyMs));

for (const job of jobs) {
  if (done.has(`${job.policy}|${job.seed}|${job.persona}`)) continue;
  if (outOfTime()) break;
  const persona = withRestates(makePersona(job.seed, job.persona), cfg.restate ?? 0, `${job.seed}`);
  const before = { ...env.gem.usage };
  latency = [];
  let memories = [];
  let exact = null;
  let decisions = [];
  // check mode: decide with the value-based judge, and count how often the exact judge agrees
  const judgeTally = { n: 0, agree: 0 };
  const judge = check
    ? {
        addIsCorrect(c, g) { const a = looseJudge.addIsCorrect(c, g); judgeTally.n++; if (a === exactJudge.addIsCorrect(c, g)) judgeTally.agree++; return a; },
        proposalIsCorrect(p, g) { const a = looseJudge.proposalIsCorrect(p, g); judgeTally.n++; if (a === exactJudge.proposalIsCorrect(p, g)) judgeTally.agree++; return a; },
      }
    : looseJudge;
  const m = await runPersona(env, persona, {
    policy: job.policy,
    e: check ? cfg.e : 0,
    u: cfg.u,
    fillerInitial: cfg.fillerInitial,
    fillerPerGap: cfg.fillerPerGap,
    extractor: check ? "sim" : "real",
    restateUpdates: check && (cfg.restate ?? 0) > 0,
    extractorFn: check ? undefined : paced,
    judge,
    scorer: looseScore,
    onFinish: (env2, gold, run) => {
      memories = env2.db.prepare("SELECT id, content, status, category, source FROM memories").all().filter((r) => !isFiller(r.content)).map((r) => ({ ...r, judged: classify(r.content, gold) }));
      if (check) exact = exactScore(env2, gold, run);
      decisions = run.decisions;
    },
  });
  if (m.extractionErrors > 0 && !check) {
    console.log(`Persona ${job.persona} (${job.policy}): ${m.extractionErrors} extraction request(s) failed (${m.lastError || "see server log"}). ` +
      `Not saved. Wait (quota?) and continue with: npm run eval:real -- --out "${out}" --yes`);
    break;
  }
  const row = {
    ...job,
    ...m,
    promptsPer100Turns: (100 * m.prompts) / m.userTurns,
    requests: env.gem.usage.calls - before.calls,
    promptTokens: env.gem.usage.promptTokens - before.promptTokens,
    outputTokens: env.gem.usage.outputTokens - before.outputTokens,
    meanLatencyMs: mean(latency),
  };
  if (check) {
    row.exactCorrect = exact.correct;
    row.exactStale = exact.stale;
    row.exactFalse = exact.falseMem;
    row.agree = exact.correct === m.correct && exact.stale === m.stale && exact.falseMem === m.falseMem ? 1 : 0;
    row.judgeDecisions = judgeTally.n;
    row.judgeAgree = judgeTally.agree;
  }
  appendRows(out, "runs.jsonl", [row]);
  appendRows(out, "memories.jsonl", [{ ...job, memories }]);
  appendRows(out, "decisions.jsonl", decisions.map((d) => ({ ...job, ...d })));
  console.log(`${job.policy.padEnd(7)} persona ${job.seed}-${job.persona}: F1 ${fmt(m.f1)}  stale ${m.stale}  false ${m.falseMem}  other ${m.otherMem}  prompts ${m.prompts}` + (check ? `  agrees with exact scoring: ${row.agree ? "yes" : "NO"}` : `  requests ${row.requests}`));
}
env.cleanup();

const rows = readRows(out, "runs.jsonl");
if (rows.length < jobs.length) {
  console.log(`\n${rows.length} of ${jobs.length} persona runs done. Continue with:  npm run eval:real -- --out "${out}" --yes`);
  process.exit(0);
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "runs.csv"), toCSV(rows));
const md = [];
md.push(check ? `# Scorer check: value-based scoring vs. exact scoring (simulated extractor, e = ${cfg.e})` : `# Experiment 4: real Gemini extractor (${cfg.extractor})`);
md.push(``);
md.push(`${cfg.personas} personas x ${cfg.seeds} seed(s); simulated user slip rate u = ${cfg.u}; candidate selection: ${cfg.extractMinScore}; features: candidates \`${cfg.candidates ?? "default"}\`, re-proposal limit ${cfg.repropose ?? 0}, restate probability ${cfg.restate ?? 0}. ` +
  `Memories are scored by the values they mention (eval/lib/loose.mjs): true = mentions the current value; ended = correctly records that a retired fact ended; ` +
  `stale = only an earlier value; false = a value the user never stated as their own; hypothetical = a hypothetical kept as a memory (counted as an error); ` +
  `third-party = a fact about someone in the user's life (allowed, not counted); other = mentions none of the scenario values (not counted).`);
md.push(``);
md.push(mdTable(
  ["policy", "n", "F1", "precision", "recall", "ended", "stale", "false", "hypothetical", "third-party", "other", "prompts / 100 turns", "proposals judged correct", "requests", "mean latency (ms)", "tokens in / out per request"],
  cfg.policies.map((p) => {
    const sel = rows.filter((r) => r.policy === p);
    const decided = sel.reduce((t, r) => t + r.correctAccepted + r.correctRejected + r.wrongAccepted + r.wrongRejected, 0);
    const right = sel.reduce((t, r) => t + r.correctAccepted + r.correctRejected, 0);
    const req = sel.reduce((t, r) => t + r.requests, 0);
    return [p, sel.length, `${fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.f1)))} Â± ${fmt(ci95(sel.map((r) => r.f1)))}`, fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.precision))), fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.recall))),
      fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.endedMem || 0)), 2), fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.stale)), 2), fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.falseMem)), 2),
      fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.hypotheticalMem || 0)), 2), fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.thirdPartyMem || 0)), 2), fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.otherMem)), 2), fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.promptsPer100Turns)), 1),
      decided ? `${right} of ${decided}` : "n/a", req, fmt(mean(sel.map((r) => r.meanLatencyMs)), 0),
      req ? `${Math.round(sel.reduce((t, r) => t + r.promptTokens, 0) / req)} / ${Math.round(sel.reduce((t, r) => t + r.outputTokens, 0) / req)}` : "n/a"];
  })
));
if (check) {
  md.push(``);
  md.push(`Agreement of value-based and exact scoring (correct, stale and false counts identical): ${rows.filter((r) => r.agree).length} of ${rows.length} persona runs.`);
  md.push(`Agreement of the value-based and exact review judges: ${rows.reduce((t, r) => t + (r.judgeAgree || 0), 0)} of ${rows.reduce((t, r) => t + (r.judgeDecisions || 0), 0)} decisions.`);
}
md.push(``);
md.push(`Every final memory with its judgement: memories.jsonl. Raw rows: runs.csv.`);
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "summary.md"), md.join("\n") + "\n");
writeJSON(path.join(out, "run-info.json"), { finishedAt: new Date().toISOString(), node: process.version, platform: `${process.platform}-${process.arch}` });
console.log(`\nResults: ${out}`);

// Experiment 2: does memory search find the right fact when the user asks about it?
// Runs AURA's real searchMemories() (local MiniLM embeddings + keyword overlap, minimum score 0.25) over
// stores of different sizes, with questions phrased the way people ask them ("What's my dog's name?"),
// and compares it with variants of the scoring rule. No Gemini calls.
//
//   npm run eval:retrieval
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
import { openIsolated, EVAL_DIR } from "./lib/env.mjs";
import { makePersona, SLOT, factOf, fillerSample } from "./lib/scenarios.mjs";
import { rng, hash } from "./lib/rng.mjs";
import { mean, fmt, toCSV, mdTable, writeJSON, wilson, outDir, appendRows, readRows, budget } from "./lib/stats.mjs";

const { values: a } = parseArgs({
  options: {
    personas: { type: "string", default: "20" },
    seeds: { type: "string", default: "3" },
    sizes: { type: "string", default: "25,100,350" },
    out: { type: "string" },
    budget: { type: "string", default: "0" },
  },
});
const out = outDir(EVAL_DIR, "retrieval", a.out);
const cfgFile = path.join(out, "config.json");
const cfg = fs.existsSync(cfgFile)
  ? JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(cfgFile, "utf8"))
  : { experiment: "retrieval", personas: Number(a.personas), seeds: Number(a.seeds), sizes: a.sizes.split(",").map(Number) };
if (!fs.existsSync(cfgFile)) writeJSON(cfgFile, { ...cfg, startedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
const outOfTime = budget(Number(a.budget));
const doneSizes = new Set(readRows(out, "queries.jsonl").map((r) => r.size));

const env = await openIsolated();
const { mem, models, db } = env;
const DAY = 86400000;
const cos = models.cosine;

// Scoring variants. "aura" is the real function; the others re-score the same rows.
const VARIANTS = {
  aura_k6: { label: "AURA (hybrid 0.85/0.15, min 0.25), k=6 â€” recall tool", k: 6 },
  aura_k4: { label: "AURA (hybrid, min 0.25), k=4 â€” typed messages", k: 4 },
  hybrid_nomin_k6: { label: "hybrid, no minimum score, k=6", k: 6 },
  semantic_nomin_k6: { label: "embedding only, no minimum score, k=6", k: 6 },
  lexical_k6: { label: "keywords only (AURA fallback when the model is unavailable, min 0.1), k=6", k: 6 },
};

for (const size of cfg.sizes) {
  if (doneSizes.has(size)) continue;
  if (outOfTime()) break;
  const rows = [];
  const absent = [];
  for (let seed = 1; seed <= cfg.seeds; seed++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < cfg.personas; i++) {
      const persona = makePersona(seed, i);
      env.reset();
      const r = rng(hash(`retrieval|${size}|${persona.id}`));
      // store: the persona's current facts + unrelated facts, learned at random times over 90 days
      const facts = [...persona.finalGold.state].filter(([, v]) => v != null).map(([k, v]) => ({ slot: k, content: factOf(k, v) }));
      const contents = [...facts.map((f) => f.content), ...fillerSample(size, `retrieval|${persona.id}`)];
      const ins = db.prepare("INSERT INTO memories(content, category, status, source, embedding, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, 'other', 'active', 'manual', ?, ?, ?)");
      for (const c of contents) {
        const t = Date.now() - Math.floor(r() * 90 * DAY);
        ins.run(c, env.f32ToBlob(await models.embedText(c)), t, t);
      }
      const all = db.prepare("SELECT id, content, embedding FROM memories").all().map((x) => ({ ...x, vec: new Float32Array(new Uint8Array(x.embedding).buffer) }));
      const idOf = new Map(all.map((x) => [x.content, x.id]));

      for (const f of facts) {
        for (const q of SLOT[f.slot].queries) {
          const target = idOf.get(f.content);
          const qv = await models.embedText(q);
          const scored = all.map((x) => {
            const sem = cos(qv, x.vec);
            const lex = mem.lexicalScore(q, x.content);
            return { id: x.id, sem, lex, hyb: 0.85 * sem + 0.15 * lex };
          });
          const rankBy = (key, min, k) => scored.filter((s) => s[key] >= min).sort((p, q2) => q2[key] - p[key]).slice(0, k).map((s) => s.id);
          const real6 = (await mem.searchMemories(q, 6)).map((m) => m.id);
          const real4 = (await mem.searchMemories(q, 4)).map((m) => m.id);
          // sanity: our re-scoring reproduces the real function (ties aside)
          const sanity = rankBy("hyb", 0.25, 6).join() === real6.join() ? 1 : 0;
          const results = {
            aura_k6: real6,
            aura_k4: real4,
            hybrid_nomin_k6: rankBy("hyb", -Infinity, 6),
            semantic_nomin_k6: rankBy("sem", -Infinity, 6),
            lexical_k6: rankBy("lex", 0.1, 6),
          };
          const t = scored.find((s) => s.id === target);
          const fullRank = [...scored].sort((p, q2) => q2.hyb - p.hyb).findIndex((s) => s.id === target) + 1;
          const row = { size, seed, persona: i, slot: f.slot, query: q, targetSem: t.sem, targetLex: t.lex, targetHybrid: t.hyb, hybridRank: fullRank, sanity };
          for (const [v, ids] of Object.entries(results)) {
            row[`${v}_hit`] = ids.includes(target) ? 1 : 0;
            row[`${v}_top1`] = ids[0] === target ? 1 : 0;
            row[`${v}_empty`] = ids.length === 0 ? 1 : 0;
          }
          rows.push(row);
        }
      }
      // questions about facts this user never stated (or that are no longer true): whatever comes back is unrelated
      const present = new Set(facts.map((f) => f.slot));
      for (const sl of Object.values(SLOT)) {
        if (present.has(sl.key)) continue;
        for (const q of sl.queries) {
          const qv = await models.embedText(q);
          let best = -Infinity;
          for (const x of all) best = Math.max(best, 0.85 * cos(qv, x.vec) + 0.15 * mem.lexicalScore(q, x.content));
          absent.push({ size, seed, persona: i, slot: sl.key, query: q, bestHybrid: best, auraReturned: (await mem.searchMemories(q, 6)).length });
        }
      }
    }
  }
  appendRows(out, "absent.jsonl", absent);
  appendRows(out, "queries.jsonl", rows);
  console.log(`size ${size}: ${rows.length} queries, AURA hit@6 ${fmt(mean(rows.map((x) => x.aura_k6_hit)))}`);
}
const embedStats = { ...models.embedStats };
env.cleanup();
const rows = readRows(out, "queries.jsonl");
if (!cfg.sizes.every((z) => rows.some((r) => r.size === z))) {
  console.log(`\nNot finished. Continue with:  npm run eval:retrieval -- --out "${out}"`);
  process.exit(0);
}
const absentRows = readRows(out, "absent.jsonl");
const sanityChecked = rows.length;
const sanityMismatch = rows.filter((r) => !r.sanity).length;

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "queries.csv"), toCSV(rows));
const summary = [];
for (const size of cfg.sizes) {
  const sel = rows.filter((x) => x.size === size);
  for (const [v, info] of Object.entries(VARIANTS)) {
    const hits = sel.reduce((t, x) => t + x[`${v}_hit`], 0);
    const [lo, hi] = wilson(hits, sel.length);
    summary.push({
      size, variant: v, label: info.label, n: sel.length,
      hitAtK: hits / sel.length, hitLo: lo, hitHi: hi,
      top1: mean(sel.map((x) => x[`${v}_top1`])),
      emptyRate: mean(sel.map((x) => x[`${v}_empty`])),
    });
  }
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "summary.csv"), toCSV(summary));

// per-slot view at the largest size (which kinds of facts are hard to find)
const big = Math.max(...cfg.sizes);
const perSlot = Object.keys(SLOT).map((k) => {
  const sel = rows.filter((x) => x.size === big && x.slot === k);
  return sel.length ? [k, sel.length, fmt(mean(sel.map((x) => x.aura_k6_hit)), 2), fmt(mean(sel.map((x) => x.hybrid_nomin_k6_hit)), 2), fmt(mean(sel.map((x) => x.targetSem)), 3)] : null;
}).filter(Boolean);

const belowMin = rows.filter((x) => x.targetHybrid < 0.25).length;
const md = [];
md.push(`# Experiment 2: memory retrieval with AURA's search`);
md.push(``);
md.push(`Real local embedding model (Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2) and AURA's real searchMemories(). ` +
  `Each store holds one persona's current facts plus N unrelated facts; each fact is asked about with 2 natural questions. ${cfg.personas} personas x ${cfg.seeds} seeds per size. ` +
  `Hit@k = the right fact is among the k results; 95% Wilson intervals in brackets.`);
md.push(``);
md.push(mdTable(
  ["store size N", "variant", "queries", "hit@k", "top-1", "no results"],
  summary.map((s) => [s.size, s.label, s.n, `${fmt(s.hitAtK)} [${fmt(s.hitLo)}, ${fmt(s.hitHi)}]`, fmt(s.top1), fmt(s.emptyRate)])
));
md.push(``);
md.push(`- Right fact scores below AURA's minimum (0.25) on the hybrid score: ${belowMin} of ${rows.length} queries (${fmt(belowMin / rows.length)}). Mean hybrid score of the right fact: ${fmt(mean(rows.map((x) => x.targetHybrid)))}; mean embedding similarity: ${fmt(mean(rows.map((x) => x.targetSem)))}.`);
md.push(`- Sanity check: re-scoring reproduced the real searchMemories() top-6 in ${sanityChecked - sanityMismatch} of ${sanityChecked} queries (differences come only from ties).`);
md.push(``);
md.push(`## By kind of fact (N = ${big})`);
md.push(``);
md.push(mdTable(["slot", "queries", "AURA hit@6", "hybrid no-min hit@6", "mean embedding similarity"], perSlot));
md.push(``);
md.push(`## Choosing the minimum score`);
md.push(``);
md.push(`Trade-off for the hybrid score at k = 6: "found" = questions about a stored fact that get it among the results; ` +
  `"noise" = questions about something the user never stated (or that is no longer true) that still return memories (unrelated ones). ${absentRows.length / cfg.sizes.length} such questions per size.`);
md.push(``);
const TH = [0, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3, 0.35];
const thRows = [];
for (const size of cfg.sizes) {
  const pres = rows.filter((x) => x.size === size);
  const abs = absentRows.filter((x) => x.size === size);
  for (const t of TH) {
    const found = mean(pres.map((x) => (x.targetHybrid >= t && x.hybridRank <= 6 ? 1 : 0)));
    const noise = mean(abs.map((x) => (x.bestHybrid >= t ? 1 : 0)));
    thRows.push({ size, threshold: t, found, noise });
  }
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "threshold.csv"), toCSV(thRows));
md.push(mdTable(["store size N", ...TH.map((t) => `min ${t}`)], cfg.sizes.map((size) => [size, ...TH.map((t) => { const r = thRows.find((x) => x.size === size && x.threshold === t); return `${fmt(r.found, 2)} / ${fmt(r.noise, 2)}`; })])));
md.push(``);
md.push(`Cells: found / noise. AURA uses min 0.25. Check: AURA's real search returned something for ${fmt(mean(absentRows.filter((x) => x.size === Math.max(...cfg.sizes)).map((x) => (x.auraReturned > 0 ? 1 : 0))), 2)} of the never-stated questions at N = ${Math.max(...cfg.sizes)} (table: ${fmt(thRows.find((x) => x.size === Math.max(...cfg.sizes) && x.threshold === 0.25).noise, 2)}).`);
md.push(``);
md.push(`Note: AURA puts the 30 most recently confirmed memories into the Live system prompt, so search matters once a user has more than 30 active memories.`);
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, "summary.md"), md.join("\n") + "\n");
writeJSON(path.join(out, "run-info.json"), { finishedAt: new Date().toISOString(), embeddingModel: "Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2", node: process.version, platform: `${process.platform}-${process.arch}`, sanityChecked, sanityMismatch, lastSessionEmbedStats: embedStats });
console.log(`\nResults: ${out}`);

// Stands in for server/models.mjs during evaluation: the real local models, with text embeddings memoised.
import * as real from "../../server/models.mjs";
export * from "../../server/models.mjs"; // everything else unchanged (embedText below takes precedence)

const cache = new Map();
export const embedStats = { hits: 0, misses: 0, ms: 0 };

export async function embedText(text) {
  const key = String(text);
  const hit = cache.get(key);
  if (hit) {
    embedStats.hits++;
    return hit;
  }
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const v = await real.embedText(key);
  embedStats.ms += Math.round(performance.now() - t0);
  embedStats.misses++;
  cache.set(key, v);
  return v;
}

// Opens AURA's real server modules on a throw-away database in a temporary folder.
// Your own data/aura.db is never opened: the run refuses to start unless the database path is inside
// the new temporary folder.
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

export const EVAL_DIR = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
export const ROOT = path.resolve(EVAL_DIR, "..");
const TEXT_MODEL_REL = path.join("models", "Xenova", "all-MiniLM-L6-v2");

/**
 * clock: "fake" (default) makes Date.now() tick 1 ms per call from a fixed start, so runs are exactly
 * repeatable (AURA orders memories by millisecond timestamps, and ties would otherwise depend on timing).
 * Real-model runs use clock: "real" (request pacing and latency need real time).
 */
export async function openIsolated({ clock = "fake" } = {}) {
  if (clock === "fake") {
    let t = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 13, 0, 0, 0);
    Date.now = () => ++t;
  }
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "aura-eval-"));
  // the local embedding model is copied from the project's model cache (no download)
  const src = path.join(process.env.AURA_EVAL_MODEL_DIR || path.join(ROOT, "data"), TEXT_MODEL_REL);
  if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(src, "onnx"))) {
    throw new Error(`The local embedding model was not found at ${src}. Start AURA once so it downloads its models.`);
  }
  fs.cpSync(src, path.join(dir, TEXT_MODEL_REL), { recursive: true });

  process.env.AURA_DATA_DIR = dir;
  process.env.AURA_NO_WARMUP = "1";
  delete process.env.AURA_DB_PATH;

  // the app logs every extraction; keep the evaluation's own output readable
  if (!process.env.AURA_EVAL_VERBOSE) {
    const log = console.log;
    console.log = (...x) => {
      if (typeof x[0] === "string" && x[0].startsWith("[memory]")) return;
      log(...x);
    };
  }

  const config = await import("../../server/config.mjs");
  const dbm = await import("../../server/db.mjs");
  const inside = (p) => path.resolve(p).startsWith(path.resolve(dir) + path.sep);
  if (path.resolve(config.DATA_DIR) !== path.resolve(dir) || !inside(dbm.DB_PATH)) {
    throw new Error(`Refusing to run: the database (${dbm.DB_PATH}) is not inside the temporary folder ${dir}.`);
  }
  // throw-away database: skip waiting for the disk on every write (results are unaffected)
  dbm.db.exec("PRAGMA synchronous = OFF; PRAGMA journal_mode = MEMORY;");
  const mem = await import("../../server/memory.mjs");
  const models = await import("./cached-models.mjs");
  const gem = await import("./proxy-gemini.mjs");

  return {
    dir,
    config,
    db: dbm.db,
    f32ToBlob: dbm.f32ToBlob,
    saveSettings: dbm.saveSettings,
    mem,
    models,
    gem,
    reset() {
      dbm.db.exec("DELETE FROM memory_proposals; DELETE FROM memories; DELETE FROM messages; DELETE FROM conversations; DELETE FROM settings;");
    },
    cleanup() {
      try {
        dbm.db.close();
      } catch {}
      fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    },
  };
}



================================================
FILE: eval/lib/harness.mjs

// Runs one persona through AURA's real memory pipeline (extraction -> operations -> review) and scores
// the final memory store against the ground truth.
//
// Policies (how memory changes are handled):
//   append  : only "add" is ever applied (no updates, no retirements, no deletions)
//   auto    : every operation is applied immediately          (AURA with "ask before changes" off)
//   gate    : changes to existing memories wait for the user   (AURA default: confirmMemoryChanges on)
//   gateAll : like gate, and new facts are confirmed too       (emulated in the harness: AURA has no such setting)
//
// The extractor is either simulated (known error rates, see makeSimExtractor) or the real Gemini model
// wrapped by the same policy logic. The simulated user approves correct proposals and turns down wrong
// ones, but makes a mistake with probability u.
import { rng, hash, pick } from "./rng.mjs";
import { SLOT, FACT_INDEX, factOf, isTrue, isFiller, newGold, applyEvent, goldFacts, fillerSample } from "./scenarios.mjs";

export const POLICIES = ["append", "auto", "gate", "gateAll"];
const DAY = 86400000;

// "[12] (personal) The user lives in Pune." lines of the extraction prompt
export function parseCandidates(prompt) {
  const out = [];
  const re = /^\[(\d+)\] \((\w+)\) (.*)$/gm;
  let m;
  while ((m = re.exec(prompt))) out.push({ id: Number(m[1]), category: m[2], content: m[3] });
  return out;
}

/**
 * The simulated extractor: returns the operations a correct model would return for the current turn,
 * then injects errors at rate e:
 *   miss            : the correct operation is dropped                     (prob e per fact-bearing turn)
 *   spurious add    : a distractor becomes a false memory                  (prob e per distractor turn)
 *   wrong change    : a TRUE memory shown to the model is retired or overwritten with a false value
 *                                                                          (prob e per non-distractor turn)
 * A correct model can only reference memories it was shown (the candidates in the prompt); when the
 * memory to change is not among them it does what a real model would: it adds the new fact.
 */
export function makeSimExtractor(run) {
  return (args) => {
    if (!/maintain the long-term memory/.test(args.system || "")) throw new Error("unexpected model call in the simulation");
    const { turn, gold, e, r } = run.ctx;
    const ev = turn.event;
    const cands = parseCandidates(args.prompt);
    const idOf = new Map(cands.map((c) => [c.content, c.id]));
    const ops = [];
    const slot = ev.slot ? SLOT[ev.slot] : null;
    const miss = r() < e; // drawn on every turn, in a fixed order, so all policies see the same errors
    const spurious = r() < e;
    const wrong = r() < e;
    const wrongKind = r();
    const victimRoll = r();
    const corruptRoll = r();

    if (ev.type === "add" && !miss) ops.push({ action: "add", content: factOf(ev.slot, ev.value), category: slot.category });
    if (ev.type === "update" && !miss) {
      const id = idOf.get(factOf(ev.slot, ev.from));
      ops.push(id ? { action: "update", memory_id: id, content: factOf(ev.slot, ev.to), category: slot.category } : { action: "add", content: factOf(ev.slot, ev.to), category: slot.category });
    }
    if ((ev.type === "retire" || ev.type === "forget") && !miss) {
      const id = idOf.get(factOf(ev.slot, ev.from));
      if (id) ops.push({ action: ev.type, memory_id: id });
    }
    if (ev.type === "reconfirm" && !idOf.has(factOf(ev.slot, ev.value))) {
      // with restateUpdates, a correct model that is shown the older, no-longer-true value of the same fact updates it
      const stale = run.restateUpdates
        ? cands.find((c) => {
            const i = FACT_INDEX.get(c.content);
            return i && !i.distractor && i.slot === ev.slot && i.value !== ev.value && !isTrue(c.content, gold);
          })
        : null;
      ops.push(stale ? { action: "update", memory_id: stale.id, content: factOf(ev.slot, ev.value), category: slot.category } : { action: "add", content: factOf(ev.slot, ev.value), category: slot.category });
    }
    if (ev.type === "distractor" && spurious) ops.push({ action: "add", content: ev.falseFact, category: "other" });

    if (ev.type !== "distractor" && wrong) {
      const victims = cands.filter((c) => isTrue(c.content, gold) && FACT_INDEX.get(c.content)?.slot !== ev.slot);
      if (victims.length) {
        const v = victims[Math.floor(victimRoll * victims.length)];
        const info = FACT_INDEX.get(v.content);
        let corrupted = null;
        if (info) {
          const unsaid = SLOT[info.slot].values.filter((x) => !(gold.stated.get(info.slot) || new Set()).has(x));
          if (unsaid.length) corrupted = factOf(info.slot, unsaid[Math.floor(corruptRoll * unsaid.length)]);
        }
        const op = wrongKind < 0.5 && corrupted ? { action: "update", memory_id: v.id, content: corrupted, category: info.slot ? SLOT[info.slot].category : "other" } : { action: "retire", memory_id: v.id };
        ops.push(op);
        run.injected.add(`${op.action}:${v.id}`);
        run.counts.injectedWrongChanges++;
      }
    }
    if (miss && ["add", "update", "retire", "forget"].includes(ev.type)) run.counts.injectedMisses++;
    if (ev.type === "distractor" && spurious) run.counts.injectedSpurious++;
    return { operations: ops };
  };
}

/** Wraps an extractor with the policy-specific handling of its output. */
export function withPolicy(run, extractor) {
  return async (args, realGenerateJSON) => {
    const out = await extractor(args, realGenerateJSON);
    let ops = Array.isArray(out?.operations) ? out.operations : [];
    run.counts.opsReturned += ops.length;
    if (run.policy === "append") ops = ops.filter((o) => o.action === "add");
    if (run.policy === "gateAll") {
      const kept = [];
      for (const o of ops) {
        if (o.action !== "add") {
          kept.push(o);
          continue;
        }
        run.counts.prompts++;
        run.counts.addPrompts++;
        const correct = run.judge.addIsCorrect(o.content, run.ctx.gold);
        if (userAccepts(run, correct)) kept.push(o);
        tally(run, correct, userAcceptsLast(run));
        run.decisions.push({ action: "add", content: o.content, judgedCorrect: correct, accepted: userAcceptsLast(run) });
      }
      ops = kept;
    }
    return { ...out, operations: ops };
  };
}

function userAccepts(run, correct) {
  const slip = run.userR() < run.u;
  run._last = correct ? !slip : slip;
  return run._last;
}
const userAcceptsLast = (run) => run._last;

function tally(run, correct, accepted) {
  if (correct && accepted) run.counts.correctAccepted++;
  else if (correct && !accepted) run.counts.correctRejected++;
  else if (!correct && accepted) run.counts.wrongAccepted++;
  else run.counts.wrongRejected++;
}

// Ground-truth judgements for the simulation (exact sentences are known).
export const exactJudge = {
  addIsCorrect: (content, gold) => isTrue(content, gold),
  proposalIsCorrect(p, gold) {
    const target = p.current?.content || "";
    const ti = FACT_INDEX.get(target);
    if (p.action === "update") {
      const ni = FACT_INDEX.get(p.content || "");
      return isTrue(p.content, gold) && !isTrue(target, gold) && !!ti && !!ni && ti.slot === ni.slot;
    }
    if (p.action === "retire") return !isTrue(target, gold);
    if (p.action === "forget") return !!ti && gold.forgotten.some((f) => f.slot === ti.slot && f.value === ti.value);
    return false;
  },
};

function newCounts() {
  return {
    userTurns: 0, extractions: 0, opsReturned: 0, prompts: 0, addPrompts: 0, changePrompts: 0,
    correctAccepted: 0, correctRejected: 0, wrongAccepted: 0, wrongRejected: 0,
    injectedWrongChanges: 0, injectedMisses: 0, injectedSpurious: 0, wrongChangesApplied: 0,
    candidateMissesOnChange: 0, changeTurns: 0, extractionErrors: 0,
  };
}

async function insertFiller(env, content, t) {
  const emb = await env.models.embedText(content);
  env.db
    .prepare("INSERT INTO memories(content, category, status, source, embedding, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, 'other', 'active', 'manual', ?, ?, ?)")
    .run(content, env.f32ToBlob(emb), t, t);
}

/**
 * Runs one persona under one policy. Returns per-persona metrics.
 * opts: { policy, e, u, fillerInitial, fillerPerGap, extractor: "sim" | "real", judge }
 */
export async function runPersona(env, persona, opts) {
  const { policy, e = 0, u = 0, fillerInitial = 30, fillerPerGap = 10 } = opts;
  env.reset();
  env.saveSettings({ autoMemory: true, confirmMemoryChanges: policy === "gate" || policy === "gateAll" });

  const run = {
    policy, e, u, persona,
    ctx: null,
    counts: newCounts(),
    injected: new Set(),
    judge: opts.judge || exactJudge,
    userR: rng(hash(`user|${persona.id}|${policy}|${e}|${u}`)),
    restateUpdates: !!opts.restateUpdates,
    decisions: [], // every review card: what was proposed and what the simulated user decided
  };
  // opts.extractorFn(args, realGenerateJSON, run) lets a runner wrap the real model (e.g. to pace requests)
  const base = opts.extractorFn
    ? (args, realGen) => opts.extractorFn(args, realGen, run)
    : opts.extractor === "real"
      ? (args, realGen) => realGen(args)
      : makeSimExtractor(run);
  env.gem.setHandler(withPolicy(run, base));

  // instrumentation: which applied/accepted operations were injected wrong changes
  const onApplied = (a) => {
    for (const x of a.applied || []) {
      const id = x.op === "update" ? x.replaced : x.id;
      if ((x.op === "update" || x.op === "retire" || x.op === "forget") && run.injected.has(`${x.op}:${id}`)) run.counts.wrongChangesApplied++;
    }
  };
  const onDecision = (d) => {
    if (d.decision === "accepted" && run.injected.has(`${d.action}:${d.memoryId}`)) run.counts.wrongChangesApplied++;
  };
  env.mem.memoryEvents.on("applied", onApplied);
  env.mem.memoryEvents.on("decision", onDecision);

  try {
    const fillers = fillerSample(fillerInitial + fillerPerGap * (persona.sessions.length - 1), `${persona.id}`);
    let fi = 0;
    const t0 = Date.now() - 90 * DAY;
    for (; fi < fillerInitial; fi++) await insertFiller(env, fillers[fi], t0 + fi * 60000);

    const gold = newGold();
    for (let s = 0; s < persona.sessions.length; s++) {
      // other conversations happened between sessions: more (recent) memories
      if (s > 0) for (let k = 0; k < fillerPerGap; k++, fi++) await insertFiller(env, fillers[fi], Date.now());
      const t = Date.now();
      const convId = Number(env.db.prepare("INSERT INTO conversations(started_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?)").run(t, t).lastInsertRowid);
      const msg = env.db.prepare("INSERT INTO messages(conversation_id, role, modality, text, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'text', ?, ?)");

      for (let i = 0; i < persona.sessions[s].length; i++) {
        const turn = persona.sessions[s][i];
        applyEvent(gold, turn.event);
        if (turn.assistantFirst) msg.run(convId, "assistant", turn.assistantFirst, Date.now());
        msg.run(convId, "user", turn.user, Date.now());
        msg.run(convId, "assistant", turn.assistant, Date.now());
        run.counts.userTurns++;
        run.ctx = { turn, gold, e, r: rng(hash(`turn|${persona.id}|${s}|${i}|${e}`)) };

        // reachability: was the memory this turn changes among the memories shown to the model?
        if (["update", "retire", "forget"].includes(turn.event.type)) run.counts.changeTurns++;
        const onExtraction = (x) => {
          if (!["update", "retire", "forget"].includes(turn.event.type)) return;
          const target = factOf(turn.event.slot, turn.event.from);
          const row = env.db.prepare("SELECT id FROM memories WHERE content = ? AND status = 'active'").get(target);
          if (row && !x.candidateIds.includes(row.id)) run.counts.candidateMissesOnChange++;
        };
        env.mem.memoryEvents.once("extraction", onExtraction);
        try {
          await env.mem.extractFromConversation(convId);
        } catch (err) {
          // like the app: a failed extraction is retried with the next message (extracted_upto did not move)
          run.counts.extractionErrors++;
          run.lastError = String(err?.message || err);
          if (run.counts.extractionErrors <= 2) console.log(`  extraction error: ${run.lastError}`);
          if (opts.stopOnError) throw err;
        }
        env.mem.memoryEvents.off("extraction", onExtraction);
        run.counts.extractions++;
      }

      // end of session: the user goes through the cards waiting for an OK
      if (policy === "gate" || policy === "gateAll") {
        for (const p of env.mem.listProposals()) {
          run.counts.prompts++;
          run.counts.changePrompts++;
          const correct = run.judge.proposalIsCorrect(p, gold);
          const accepted = userAccepts(run, correct);
          if (accepted) await env.mem.acceptProposal(p.id);
          else env.mem.rejectProposal(p.id);
          tally(run, correct, accepted);
          run.decisions.push({ session: s + 1, action: p.action, current: p.current?.content || null, content: p.content || null, judgedCorrect: correct, accepted });
        }
      }
    }
    if (opts.onFinish) opts.onFinish(env, gold, run);
    return { ...(opts.scorer || score)(env, gold, run), ...run.counts };
  } finally {
    env.mem.memoryEvents.off("applied", onApplied);
    env.mem.memoryEvents.off("decision", onDecision);
    env.gem.setHandler(null);
  }
}

/** Compares the final memory store with the ground truth. */
export function score(env, gold, run) {
  const rows = env.db.prepare("SELECT id, content, status FROM memories").all();
  const active = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "active" && !isFiller(r.content));
  const activeSet = new Set(active.map((r) => r.content));
  const G = goldFacts(gold);
  const correct = G.filter((f) => activeSet.has(f)).length;
  let stale = 0;
  let falseMem = 0;
  for (const r of active) {
    if (isTrue(r.content, gold)) continue;
    const info = FACT_INDEX.get(r.content);
    const wasSaid = info && !info.distractor && (gold.stated.get(info.slot) || new Set()).has(info.value);
    if (wasSaid) stale++;
    else falseMem++;
  }
  const missing = G.filter((f) => !activeSet.has(f));
  const destroyed = missing.filter((f) => rows.some((r) => r.content === f && r.status !== "active")).length;
  const fillerRows = rows.filter((r) => isFiller(r.content));
  const fillerLost = fillerRows.filter((r) => r.status !== "active").length;
  // forgetting: is the forgotten value still stored anywhere?
  let forgetMemResidual = 0;
  let forgetTextResidual = 0;
  for (const f of gold.forgotten) {
    const fact = factOf(f.slot, f.value);
    if (rows.some((r) => r.content === fact)) forgetMemResidual++;
    const n = env.db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM messages WHERE text LIKE ?").get(`%${f.value}%`).n;
    if (n > 0) forgetTextResidual++;
  }
  const nActive = active.length;
  const precision = nActive ? correct / nActive : 1;
  const recall = G.length ? correct / G.length : 1;
  return {
    goldFacts: G.length,
    activeFacts: nActive,
    correct,
    stale,
    falseMem,
    missing: missing.length,
    destroyed,
    fillerLost,
    forgets: gold.forgotten.length,
    forgetMemResidual,
    forgetTextResidual,
    precision,
    recall,
    f1: precision + recall ? (2 * precision * recall) / (precision + recall) : 0,
    exactState: correct === G.length && nActive === correct && fillerLost === 0 ? 1 : 0,
  };
}

export { pick };

// Module-resolution hooks for the evaluation harness (registered by register.mjs).
//  - "sharp" (an image library transformers.js loads at start) is replaced by a stub: the evaluation only
//    embeds text, and on Linux the Windows-installed binary of sharp cannot load.
//  - server/gemini.mjs is routed through proxy-gemini.mjs, so a run can either call the real model or a
//    simulated extractor with known error rates.
//  - server/models.mjs is routed through cached-models.mjs, which memoises text embeddings (same model,
//    same vectors; repeated sentences are only embedded once).
const here = (f) => new URL(f, import.meta.url).href;

export async function resolve(specifier, context, next) {
  if (specifier === "sharp") return { url: here("./sharp-stub.mjs"), shortCircuit: true };
  const r = await next(specifier, context);
  const parent = context.parentURL || "";
  if (r.url.endsWith("/server/gemini.mjs") && !parent.endsWith("/eval/lib/proxy-gemini.mjs")) {
    return { ...r, url: here("./proxy-gemini.mjs") };
  }
  if (r.url.endsWith("/server/models.mjs") && !parent.endsWith("/eval/lib/cached-models.mjs")) {
    return { ...r, url: here("./cached-models.mjs") };
  }
  return r;
}

// A tiny made-up dataset in the LongMemEval file format, used only to test the runner without Gemini
// (`npm run eval:lme -- --check-with-sim`). It is NOT LongMemEval data and no result from it is reported.
//
// Format of one LongMemEval instance (as published with the benchmark):
//   question_id, question_type, question, answer, question_date,
//   haystack_session_ids[], haystack_dates[], haystack_sessions[][] of { role, content, has_answer? },
//   answer_session_ids[]
import { rng, hash, pick } from "./rng.mjs";

const CITIES = ["Pune", "Hyderabad", "Chennai", "Jaipur", "Kochi", "Indore"];
const FIRMS = ["Infosys", "Wipro", "Zoho", "Freshworks", "Flipkart", "Swiggy"];
const GAMES = ["chess", "carrom", "badminton", "cricket", "hockey"];

const turn = (role, content, has_answer) => (has_answer ? { role, content, has_answer: true } : { role, content });

export function makeFixture(n = 6, seed = 1) {
  const out = [];
  for (let q = 0; q < n; q++) {
    const r = rng(hash(`fixture|${seed}|${q}`));
    const kind = q % 2 === 0 ? "city" : "employer";
    const a = pick(kind === "city" ? CITIES : FIRMS, r);
    let b = pick(kind === "city" ? CITIES : FIRMS, r);
    if (b === a) b = (kind === "city" ? CITIES : FIRMS).find((x) => x !== a);
    const first = kind === "city" ? `I live in ${a}.` : `I work at ${a}.`;
    const second = kind === "city" ? `I have just moved to ${b}.` : `I now work at ${b}.`;
    const sessions = [];
    const ids = [];
    const dates = [];
    const add = (id, date, turns) => {
      ids.push(id);
      dates.push(date);
      sessions.push(turns);
    };
    add(`q${q}-s1`, "2023/03/02 (Thu) 09:10", [turn("user", first, true), turn("assistant", "Thanks, noted.")]);
    add(`q${q}-d1`, "2023/03/09 (Thu) 18:30", [turn("user", `I like ${pick(GAMES, r)}.`), turn("assistant", "Nice choice.")]);
    add(`q${q}-s2`, "2023/05/20 (Sat) 02:21", [turn("user", second, true), turn("assistant", "Good luck with the change.")]);
    add(`q${q}-d2`, "2023/05/27 (Sat) 11:00", [turn("user", `I like ${pick(GAMES, r)}.`), turn("assistant", "Sounds fun.")]);
    add(`q${q}-d3`, "2023/06/03 (Sat) 20:45", [turn("user", "What is the capital of France?"), turn("assistant", "Paris.")]);
    out.push({
      question_id: `fx${q}`,
      question_type: "knowledge-update",
      question: kind === "city" ? "Where do I live now?" : "Where do I work now?",
      answer: b,
      question_date: "2023/07/01 (Sat) 10:00",
      haystack_session_ids: ids,
      haystack_dates: dates,
      haystack_sessions: sessions,
      answer_session_ids: [`q${q}-s1`, `q${q}-s2`],
    });
  }
  return out;
}
