// ---- "never interrupt a live conversation" -------------------------------------------------------

const presence = { voice: false, at: 0 };
const PRESENCE_TTL = 2 * 60_000; // the browser repeats it every minute while voice is on
/** Called by the browser when a voice session starts or stops (and every minute while it runs). */
export function setPresence({ voice }, at = Date.now()) {
  presence.voice = !!voice;
  presence.at = at;
}
export function busy(at = Date.now()) {
  if (presence.voice && at - presence.at < PRESENCE_TTL) return "voice";
  // a meeting that is still recording (speech in the last two minutes)
  const rec = db
    .prepare(
      `SELECT 1 FROM meetings m WHERE m.ended_at IS NULL
         AND m.started_at + COALESCE((SELECT MAX(end_ms) FROM segments s WHERE s.meeting_id = m.id), 0) > ?`
    )
    .get(at - PRESENCE_TTL);
  return rec ? "meeting" : null;
}

// ---- the scheduler -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Why nothing can be shown right now (or null when something can).
 * Daily counts use the user's local day.
 */
// requested: a reminder the user asked for. It may appear during a voice conversation and ignores quiet hours,
// the cooldown and the daily limit (those are for things AURA brings up on its own); a meeting recording still holds it.
export function blockedReason(at = Date.now(), { requested = false } = {}) {
  const L = limits();
  const b = busy(at);
  if (b === "meeting") return "meeting recording";
  if (requested) return null;
  if (b === "voice") return "voice conversation";
  if (inQuietHours(at, L.timeZone, L.quietHours)) return "quiet hours";
  // only a real dismissal counts (not a declined or expired reminder suggestion)
  const lastDismiss = db.prepare("SELECT MAX(decided_at) AS t FROM nudges WHERE status = 'dismissed' AND outcome = 'dismissed'").get().t;
  if (lastDismiss && at - lastDismiss < L.cooldownMs) return "cooldown";
  if (shownToday(at) >= L.maxPerDay) return "daily limit";
  return null;
}
// reminders the user asked for don't use up the daily allowance
const shownToday = (at, type = null) =>
  db
    .prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM nudges WHERE shown_at >= ? ${type ? "AND type = ?" : "AND type != 'reminder'"}`)
    .get(...[startOfDay(at, limits().timeZone), ...(type ? [type] : [])]).n;

/**
 * One scheduler step: create what is due (memory checks, the daily briefing), then show due nudges
 * within the limits. Returns the nudges it showed.
 */
export async function tick(at = Date.now()) {
  if (!anyOn()) return [];
  try {
    if (switches().memory) queueMemoryCheck(at);
    if (switches().briefing) await queueDailyBriefing(at);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[proactive] could not create a nudge:", e.message);
  }
  return surface(at);
}

/** Move due nudges to the inbox ("shown"), respecting every limit. */
export function surface(at = Date.now()) {
  if (!anyOn()) return [];
  const L = limits();
  const shown = [];
  // reminder confirmations whose time has already passed are no use any more
  for (const r of db.prepare("SELECT * FROM nudges WHERE type = 'reminder' AND kind = 'confirm' AND status IN ('pending','snoozed')").all()) {
    const when = parse(r.payload)?.at;
    if (when && when <= at) {
      db.prepare("UPDATE nudges SET status = 'dismissed', outcome = 'expired', decided_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(at, r.id);
      log("expired", { id: r.id, type: r.type });
    }
  }
  const due = db
    .prepare("SELECT * FROM nudges WHERE status IN ('pending','snoozed') AND due_at <= ? ORDER BY due_at, id")
    .all(at)
    .map(toNudge)
    .filter((n) => typeOn(n.type));
  for (const n of due) {
    if (blockedReason(at, { requested: n.type === "reminder" })) continue;
    if (n.type === "memory_check") {
      if (shownToday(at, "memory_check") >= L.memoryChecksPerDay) continue;
      const m = n.sourceMemoryId && mem.getMemory(n.sourceMemoryId);
      if (!m || m.status !== "active") {
        db.prepare("UPDATE nudges SET status = 'dismissed', outcome = 'gone', decided_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(at, n.id);
        continue;
      }
    }
    db.prepare("UPDATE nudges SET status = 'shown', shown_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(at, n.id);
    log("shown", { id: n.id, type: n.type, kind: n.kind });
    shown.push(getNudge(n.id));
  }
  return shown;
}

let timer = null;
/** Runs tick() every 60 s. Does nothing when every switch is off. */
export function startScheduler(everyMs = 60_000) {
  if (timer || !anyOn()) return false;
  const run = () => tick().catch((e) => console.error("[proactive] tick failed:", e.message));
  timer = setInterval(run, everyMs);
  timer.unref?.();
  setTimeout(run, 5_000).unref?.();
  console.log(`[proactive] on: ${Object.entries(switches()).filter(([, v]) => v).map(([k]) => k).join(", ")}`);
  return true;
}
export function stopScheduler() {
  clearInterval(timer);
  timer = null;
}

// ---- the user's answer -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

const httpError = (status, message) => Object.assign(new Error(message), { status });

/**
 * decision: accept | snooze | dismiss
 * For a memory check, accept needs answer: yes | changed (with content) | forget.
 */
export async function decide(id, { decision, answer, content } = {}, at = Date.now()) {
  const n = getNudge(id);
  if (!n || !typeOn(n.type)) throw httpError(404, "Not found");
  if (!["shown", "pending", "snoozed"].includes(n.status)) throw httpError(409, "This has already been answered.");
  const finish = (status, outcome) => {
    db.prepare("UPDATE nudges SET status = ?, outcome = ?, decided_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(status, outcome, at, id);
    log("decided", { id, type: n.type, kind: n.kind, status, outcome, waitMs: n.shownAt ? at - n.shownAt : null });
  };

  if (decision === "snooze") {
    db.prepare("UPDATE nudges SET status = 'snoozed', due_at = ?, snoozes = snoozes + 1, decided_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(at + SNOOZE_MS[n.type], at, id);
    log("decided", { id, type: n.type, kind: n.kind, status: "snoozed", outcome: null });
    return { nudge: getNudge(id) };
  }
  if (decision === "dismiss") {
    // saying no to a reminder isn't a sign of too many nudges, so only other dismissals start the cooldown
    finish("dismissed", n.type === "reminder" ? (n.kind === "confirm" ? "declined" : "cancelled") : "dismissed");
    return { nudge: getNudge(id) };
  }
  if (decision !== "accept") throw httpError(400, "decision must be accept, snooze or dismiss");

  if (n.type === "memory_check") {
    const r = await answerMemoryCheck(n, { answer, content }, finish);
    return { nudge: getNudge(id), ...r };
  }
  if (n.type === "reminder" && n.kind === "confirm") {
    const p = n.payload || {};
    if (!p.at || p.at <= at) {
      finish("dismissed", "expired");
      throw httpError(409, "That time has already passed.");
    }
    finish("accepted", "scheduled");
    const due = insertNudge({
      type: "reminder",
      kind: "due",
      text: p.what,
      dueAt: p.at,
      conversationId: n.sourceConversationId,
      meetingId: n.sourceMeetingId,
      payload: { what: p.what, at: p.at, when: p.when, key: p.key, confirmedFrom: id },
      at,
    });
    return { nudge: getNudge(id), reminder: due };
  }
  finish("accepted", n.type === "reminder" ? "done" : "read");
  return { nudge: getNudge(id) };
}

// ---- 1. memory checks ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

// AURA's categories for facts that change: work (job, projects), people (relationships), plan (projects, plans).
// "personal" also holds lasting facts (birthday, home town), so only where-you-live facts are taken from it.
const FAST_CATEGORIES = ["work", "people", "plan"];
const WHERE_YOU_LIVE = /\b(live|lives|living|based|moved|stay|stays|staying|city|flat|apartment|rent|rents|renting|house|home|hostel|neighbou?rhood)\b/i;

/**
 * Memories worth checking, most overdue first: active, in a fast-changing category, not confirmed for a while,
 * not already waiting for review and not asked about recently. Memories learned from a meeting transcript are
 * treated as less certain (speaker names can be wrong) and are checked after half the time.
 */
export function selectMemoryChecks({ at = Date.now(), limit = 1 } = {}) {
  const L = limits();
  const rows = db
    .prepare(
      `SELECT * FROM memories m WHERE m.status = 'active'
         AND m.category IN ('work','people','plan','personal')
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_proposals p WHERE p.memory_id = m.id AND p.status = 'pending')
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nudges n WHERE n.type = 'memory_check' AND n.source_memory_id = m.id
                         AND (n.status IN ('pending','shown','snoozed') OR n.created_at > ?))`
    )
    .all(at - L.recheckMs);
  return rows
    .filter((r) => FAST_CATEGORIES.includes(r.category) || WHERE_YOU_LIVE.test(r.content))
    .map((r) => {
      const lowConfidence = r.source === "meeting";
      const threshold = lowConfidence ? L.staleMs / 2 : L.staleMs;
      return { id: r.id, content: r.content, category: r.category, source: r.source, confirmedAt: r.updated_at, lowConfidence, overdue: (at - r.updated_at) / threshold };
    })
    .filter((c) => c.overdue >= 1)
    .sort((a, b) => b.overdue - a.overdue || a.id - b.id)
    .slice(0, limit);
}

/** Add one memory check when the day's allowance isn't used up and none is open. */
export function queueMemoryCheck(at = Date.now()) {
  if (!switches().memory) return null;
  const L = limits();
  const today = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM nudges WHERE type = 'memory_check' AND created_at >= ?").get(startOfDay(at, L.timeZone)).n;
  if (today >= L.memoryChecksPerDay) return null;
  const open = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM nudges WHERE type = 'memory_check' AND status IN ('pending','shown','snoozed')").get().n;
  if (open) return null;
  const [c] = selectMemoryChecks({ at, limit: 1 });
  if (!c) return null;
  return insertNudge({
    type: "memory_check",
    text: `Is this still true? "${c.content}"`,
    dueAt: at,
    memoryId: c.id,
    payload: { memory: c.content, category: c.category, confirmedAt: c.confirmedAt, lowConfidence: c.lowConfidence },
    at,
  });
}

async function answerMemoryCheck(n, { answer, content }, finish) {
  const m = n.sourceMemoryId && mem.getMemory(n.sourceMemoryId);
  if (!m || m.status !== "active") {
    finish("dismissed", "gone");
    throw httpError(409, "That memory has already been changed or deleted.");
  }
  if (answer === "yes") {
    mem.confirmMemory(m.id);
    finish("accepted", "yes");
    return { memory: mem.getMemory(m.id) };
  }
  if (answer === "changed") {
    const text = String(content || "").trim();
    if (!text) throw httpError(400, "Write what is true now.");
    const r = await mem.applyUserChange({ action: "update", memoryId: m.id, content: text });
    if (!r) {
      // same wording as before: the user confirmed it
      mem.confirmMemory(m.id);
      finish("accepted", "yes");
      return { memory: mem.getMemory(m.id) };
    }
    finish("accepted", "changed");
    return { memory: r.memory };
  }
  if (answer === "forget") {
    // record the answer first: deleting the memory blanks the text of its checks
    finish("accepted", "forget");
    await mem.applyUserChange({ action: "forget", memoryId: m.id });
    return { memory: null };
  }
  throw httpError(400, "answer must be yes, changed or forget");
}

// ---- 2. reminders ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

const DEFAULT_HOUR = 9; // a date without a time means 9:00 in the morning
const RELATIVE = /\b(in|after|within)\s+(\d+|an?|a few|half an?)\s*(sec|second|min|minute|hour|hr)/i;
const norm = (s) => String(s).toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, " ").trim();

/**
 * Resolve a date phrase ("tomorrow at 5pm", "next Wednesday", "20 Oct") against a fixed "now" in a time zone.
 * Returns { at, text, index } or null. Future dates are preferred ("Friday" = the coming Friday).
 */
export function resolveDate(phrase, { now = Date.now(), tz = timeZone() } = {}) {
  const ref = { instant: new Date(now), timezone: offsetMinutes(now, tz) };
  const r = chrono.parse(String(phrase || ""), ref, { forwardDate: true })[0];
  if (!r) return null;
  let at;
  if (RELATIVE.test(r.text)) {
    // "in 3 minutes": counted from now, to the minute (so the same request made twice gives the same time)
    at = Math.floor(r.start.date().getTime() / 60_000) * 60_000;
  } else {
    // wall-clock date and time in the user's zone (the zone's offset on that day, not today's)
    const g = (k) => r.start.get(k);
    const timed = r.start.isCertain("hour");
    at = zonedTime(g("year"), g("month"), g("day"), timed ? g("hour") : DEFAULT_HOUR, timed ? g("minute") || 0 : 0, tz);
  }
  return { at, text: r.text, index: r.index };
}

// "remind me", "set / add / create / make a reminder", "set an alarm", "don't let me forget"
const REMINDER_ASK = /\b(?:remind me|(?:set|add|create|make|put|schedule)\s+(?:me\s+)?(?:a|an|one)?\s*(?:reminder|alarm)|don'?t let me forget)\b/i;

/**
 * "Remind me to call Mom tomorrow at 5pm" / "Could you set a reminder for my exam at 11am?"
 * -> { what, at, when } (at is null when no date or time was given), or null when nothing asks for a reminder.
 */
export function parseReminder(text, { now = Date.now(), tz = timeZone() } = {}) {
  // "p.m." is not the end of a sentence
  const s = String(text || "").replace(/\b([ap])\.\s?m\.?(?=\s|$|[,;!?])/gi, "$1m");
  const sentence = s.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s+|\n+/).find((x) => REMINDER_ASK.test(x));
  if (!sentence) return null;
  const m = REMINDER_ASK.exec(sentence);
  const after = sentence.slice(m.index + m[0].length);
  const d = resolveDate(after, { now, tz });
  if (!d) return { what: cleanWhat(after), at: null, when: null };
  const what = cleanWhat(after.slice(0, d.index) + " " + after.slice(d.index + d.text.length));
  return { what, at: d.at, when: d.text };
}
const cleanWhat = (s) =>
  String(s)
    .replace(/^\s*(to|that|about|of|for)\s+/i, "")
    .replace(/\s+(at|on|by|in|for|this|next)\s*$/i, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .replace(/^[\s,;:-]+|[\s,;:.!?-]+$/g, "")
    .trim();

/** Ask (through the inbox) whether to set a reminder. Nothing is scheduled until the user accepts. */
function proposeReminder({ what, at, when, conversationId = null, meetingId = null, now }) {
  if (!what || !at || at <= now) return null;
  const key = `${norm(what)}@${at}`;
  const dup = db.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM nudges WHERE type = 'reminder' AND json_extract(payload, '$.key') = ?").get(key);
  if (dup) return null;
  const tz = timeZone();
  return insertNudge({
    type: "reminder",
    kind: "confirm",
    text: `Set a reminder: "${what}" on ${formatWhen(at, tz)}?`,
    dueAt: now,
    conversationId,
    meetingId,
    payload: { what, at, when, key, timeZone: tz },
    at: now,
  });
}

/**
 * The voice assistant's set_reminder tool: resolve the time and open a confirmation (also shown as a card).
 * The assistant reads the time back and calls confirmReminder only after the user says yes.
 * A matching open confirmation from the same conversation (e.g. made from the chat text) is reused.
 */
export function requestReminder({ what, when, conversationId = null }, at = Date.now()) {
  if (!switches().reminders) throw httpError(404, "Reminders are switched off (AURA_PROACTIVE_REMINDERS=1 turns them on).");
  const task = cleanWhat(what);
  if (!task) throw httpError(400, "what is the reminder for?");
  const d = resolveDate(when, { now: at });
  if (!d) return { ok: false, error: `Couldn't work out a date or time from "${when}". Ask the user for the day and time.` };
  if (d.at <= at) return { ok: false, error: `${formatWhen(d.at)} has already passed. Ask the user for a time in the future.` };
  const open = db
    .prepare("SELECT * FROM nudges WHERE type = 'reminder' AND kind = 'confirm' AND status IN ('pending','shown','snoozed') AND json_extract(payload, '$.at') = ? AND (source_conversation_id IS ? OR source_conversation_id IS NULL OR ? IS NULL) ORDER BY id DESC")
    .get(d.at, conversationId, conversationId);
  let n = open ? toNudge(open) : proposeReminder({ what: task, at: d.at, when: d.text, conversationId, now: at });
  if (!n) {
    // the same reminder was already set or declined before
    const prev = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM nudges WHERE type = 'reminder' AND json_extract(payload, '$.key') = ? ORDER BY id DESC").get(`${norm(task)}@${d.at}`);
    if (prev?.kind === "due") return { ok: true, alreadySet: true, reminderId: prev.id, what: task, when: formatWhen(d.at) };
    n = insertNudge({ type: "reminder", kind: "confirm", text: `Set a reminder: "${task}" on ${formatWhen(d.at)}?`, dueAt: at, conversationId, payload: { what: task, at: d.at, when: d.text, key: `${norm(task)}@${d.at}#${at}`, timeZone: timeZone() }, at });
  }
  surface(at); // show the card now (cards are allowed during voice)
  return { ok: true, needsConfirmation: true, reminderId: n.id, what: n.payload?.what || task, when: formatWhen(d.at), whenSaid: d.text };
}

/** The user said yes (by voice): set the reminder. */
export async function confirmReminder(id, at = Date.now()) {
  const n = getNudge(id);
  if (!n || n.type !== "reminder" || n.kind !== "confirm") throw httpError(404, "No reminder suggestion with that id.");
  if (n.status === "accepted") return { ok: true, alreadySet: true, what: n.payload?.what, when: formatWhen(n.payload?.at) };
  const r = await decide(id, { decision: "accept" }, at);
  return { ok: true, set: true, what: r.reminder.text, when: formatWhen(r.reminder.dueAt) };
}

/** The user said no (by voice). */
export async function cancelReminder(id, at = Date.now()) {
  const n = getNudge(id);
  if (!n || n.type !== "reminder") throw httpError(404, "No reminder with that id.");
  if (!["pending", "shown", "snoozed"].includes(n.status)) return { ok: true, alreadyClosed: true };
  await decide(id, { decision: "dismiss" }, at);
  return { ok: true, cancelled: true };
}

/** A user message in a conversation (typed or spoken). */
export function onUserMessage(conversationId, text, at = Date.now()) {
  if (!switches().reminders) return null;
  try {
    const r = parseReminder(text, { now: at });
    if (!r) return null;
    if (!r.at) {
      log("unresolved", { conversationId, what: r.what });
      return null;
    }
    return proposeReminder({ ...r, conversationId, now: at });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("[proactive] reminder:", e.message);
    return null;
  }
}

/** Minutes were written: action items with a due date become reminder suggestions (dates read from the meeting day). */
export function onMinutes(meeting, at = Date.now()) {
  if (!switches().reminders || !meeting?.minutes) return [];
  const out = [];
  for (const a of meeting.minutes.actionItems || []) {
    if (!a.due) continue;
    const d = resolveDate(a.due, { now: meeting.startedAt });
    if (!d) {
      log("unresolved", { meetingId: meeting.id, what: a.task, due: a.due });
      continue;
    }
    const what = a.owner ? `${a.task} (${a.owner})` : a.task;
    const n = proposeReminder({ what, at: d.at, when: a.due, meetingId: meeting.id, now: at });
    if (n) out.push(n);
  }
  return out;
}

// ---- 3. briefing -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

const BRIEF_SYSTEM = `You write a short briefing for the user of a personal assistant.
Use only the facts given. At most 5 lines, each one short sentence, most useful first. No greeting, no filler.
Write dates the way they are given.`;
const BRIEF_SCHEMA = {
  type: "object",
  properties: { lines: { type: "array", items: { type: "string" }, description: "At most 5 short lines" } },
  required: ["lines"],
};

/** The short context the briefing is written from. */
export function briefingContext(at = Date.now()) {
  const tz = timeZone();
  const reminders = db
    .prepare("SELECT * FROM nudges WHERE type = 'reminder' AND kind = 'due' AND status IN ('pending','snoozed','shown') AND due_at < ? ORDER BY due_at LIMIT 5")
    .all(at + 7 * DAY)
    .map((r) => `${r.text} - ${formatWhen(r.due_at, tz)}`);
  const changes = db
    .prepare("SELECT content, status FROM memories WHERE updated_at > ? ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 6")
    .all(at - 7 * DAY)
    .map((r) => (r.status === "active" ? r.content : `${r.content} (no longer true)`));
  const reviews = mem.listProposals().slice(0, 3).map((p) => (p.action === "update" ? `"${p.current?.content}" -> "${p.content}"` : `${p.action}: "${p.current?.content}"`));
  const last = db.prepare("SELECT id, title, started_at, minutes FROM meetings WHERE minutes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1").get();
  const items = (parse(last?.minutes)?.actionItems || []).slice(0, 5).map((a) => [a.task, a.owner && `owner ${a.owner}`, a.due && `due ${a.due}`].filter(Boolean).join(", "));
  return {
    reminders,
    memoryChanges: changes,
    pendingReviews: { count: mem.pendingProposalCount(), examples: reviews },
    lastMeeting: last ? { title: last.title, date: formatWhen(last.started_at, tz), actionItems: items } : null,
  };
}

/** A briefing of up to 5 lines. One Gemini call; none when there is nothing to say. */
export async function buildBriefing(at = Date.now()) {
  const c = briefingContext(at);
  const empty = !c.reminders.length && !c.memoryChanges.length && !c.pendingReviews.count && !c.lastMeeting?.actionItems.length;
  if (empty) return { lines: ["Nothing new: no upcoming reminders, recent memory changes, open reviews or meeting action items."], context: c };
  if (!hasKey()) throw httpError(503, "GEMINI_API_KEY is not set");
  const prompt = [`Now: ${formatWhen(at)}`, "", JSON.stringify(c, null, 1)].join("\n").slice(0, 4000);
  const out = await generateJSON({ system: BRIEF_SYSTEM, prompt, schema: BRIEF_SCHEMA });
  const lines = (Array.isArray(out.lines) ? out.lines : []).map((l) => String(l || "").trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 5);
  return { lines: lines.length ? lines : ["Nothing to report."], context: c };
}

/** "Brief me" button. Not limited (the user asked for it); logged like any other nudge. */
export async function briefingNow(at = Date.now()) {
  if (!switches().briefing) throw httpError(404, "The briefing is switched off (AURA_PROACTIVE_BRIEFING=1 turns it on).");
  const b = await buildBriefing(at);
  const n = insertNudge({ type: "briefing", kind: "on_demand", text: b.lines.join("\n"), dueAt: at, payload: { lines: b.lines }, at });
  db.prepare("UPDATE nudges SET status = 'accepted', outcome = 'on_demand', decided_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(at, n.id);
  return { lines: b.lines };
}

/** Once a day after AURA_BRIEFING_TIME (if set). */
async function queueDailyBriefing(at) {
  const L = limits();
  if (L.briefingTime == null) return null;
  const p = localParts(at, L.timeZone);
  if (p.h * 60 + p.mi < L.briefingTime) return null;
  const done = db.prepare("SELECT 1 FROM nudges WHERE type = 'briefing' AND kind = 'daily' AND created_at >= ?").get(startOfDay(at, L.timeZone));
  if (done) return null;
  const b = await buildBriefing(at);
  return insertNudge({ type: "briefing", kind: "daily", text: b.lines.join("\n"), dueAt: at, payload: { lines: b.lines }, at });
}

// ---- outcomes --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

/** Counts per type: how nudges ended (for judging whether they help). */
export function stats() {
  const rows = db.prepare("SELECT type, kind, status, outcome, COUNT(*) AS n FROM nudges GROUP BY type, kind, status, outcome").all();
  const out = {};
  for (const r of rows) {
    const t = (out[r.type] ||= { total: 0, byStatus: {}, byOutcome: {} });
    t.total += r.n;
    t.byStatus[r.status] = (t.byStatus[r.status] || 0) + r.n;
    if (r.outcome) t.byOutcome[r.outcome] = (t.byOutcome[r.outcome] || 0) + r.n;
  }
  return out;
}

// End-to-end tests of the server logic with the two external pieces faked:
// Gemini (network) and the local ONNX models (large downloads).
// Run: npm run test:server
import { test, mock, before, after } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";

const dataDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "aura-test-"));
process.env.AURA_DATA_DIR = dataDir;
process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY = "test-key";
process.env.AURA_NO_WARMUP = "1";
process.env.AURA_BATCH_WAIT_MS = "30";

// ---- fakes ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// speaker "voice" k is encoded as a marker sample at the start of each turn; each voice maps to a fixed random vector
function seeded(seed) {
  let s = seed;
  return () => ((s = (s * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648) / 2147483648) * 2 - 1;
}
const voices = new Map();
function voiceVector(k) {
  if (!voices.has(k)) {
    const r = seeded(k * 7919 + 1);
    voices.set(k, Float32Array.from({ length: 64 }, r));
  }
  return voices.get(k);
}
let noiseSeed = 1;
let noise = 0.15;
const normalize = (v) => {
  const n = Math.hypot(...v) || 1;
  return Float32Array.from(v, (x) => x / n);
};
const cosine = (a, b) => {
  let d = 0, na = 0, nb = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { d += a[i] * b[i]; na += a[i] ** 2; nb += b[i] ** 2; }
  return d / Math.sqrt(na * nb);
};
mock.module(new URL("../models.mjs", import.meta.url).href, {
  namedExports: {
    modelStatus: { text: { state: "error" }, speaker: { state: "ready" }, segmentation: { state: "ready" } },
    warmUp: () => {},
    normalize,
    cosine,
    embedText: async () => { throw new Error("no text model in tests"); },
    embedSpeaker: async (samples) => {
      const k = Math.round(samples[0] * 32768);
      const r = seeded(noiseSeed++);
      return normalize(Array.from(voiceVector(k), (x) => x + r() * noise));
    },
    // turns start at each marker sample; the same voice gets the same local index
    speakerTurns: async (samples) => {
      const dur = samples.length / 16000;
      const marks = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < samples.length; i++) if (samples[i] !== 0) marks.push({ at: i / 16000, v: Math.round(samples[i] * 32768) });
      const local = new Map();
      const turns = marks.map((m, i) => {
        if (!local.has(m.v)) local.set(m.v, local.size);
        return { start: i === 0 ? 0 : m.at, end: marks[i + 1]?.at ?? dur, local: local.get(m.v) };
      });
      return turns.length ? turns : [{ start: 0, end: dur, local: 0 }];
    },
  },
});

const geminiCalls = { json: [], transcribe: 0 };
let nextOps = [];
let nextMeetingOps = []; // what the meeting memory extractor returns
let nextMinutes = null; // what the minutes writer returns
let docFail = false; // make the document reader fail
mock.module(new URL("../gemini.mjs", import.meta.url).href, {
  namedExports: {
    hasKey: () => true,
    createLiveToken: async () => ({ token: "auth_tokens/fake", expiresAt: Date.now() + 1000 }),
    generateJSON: async (args) => {
      geminiCalls.json.push(args);
      if (/You read documents/.test(args.system || "")) {
        if (docFail) throw new Error("model unavailable");
        return { title: "Rental agreement", doc_type: "contract", overview: "A one-year rental agreement for a flat in Pune.", key_points: ["Rent is 25,000 a month"], suggested_questions: ["When does it end?"], pages: 2 };
      }
      if (/You answer questions about the user's documents/.test(args.system || "")) {
        return { answer: "The rent is 25,000 rupees a month.", found: true, quotes: [{ text: "Monthly rent: 25,000", where: "page 1" }] };
      }
      if (args.schema?.properties?.summary) return nextMinutes;
      if (/transcript of a meeting/.test(args.system || "")) return { operations: nextMeetingOps };
      return { operations: nextOps };
    },
    transcribeSegments: async (bufs, opts) => {
      geminiCalls.transcribe++;
      geminiCalls.lastTranscribe = { n: bufs.length, ...opts };
      const texts = bufs.map((b) => `words from voice ${b.readInt16LE(0)}`);
      return { texts, raw: { transcripts: texts }, count: texts.length };
    },
  },
});

const { start, server } = await import("../index.mjs");
const B = "http://127.0.0.1:3911";
const j = async (method, url, body) => {
  const r = await fetch(B + url, {
    method,
    headers: body instanceof Buffer ? { "Content-Type": "application/octet-stream" } : { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: body instanceof Buffer ? body : body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const t = await r.text();
  return { status: r.status, data: t ? JSON.parse(t) : null, text: t };
};
const pcm = (voice, seconds) => {
  const b = Buffer.alloc(Math.round(seconds * 16000) * 2);
  b.writeInt16LE(voice, 0);
  return b;
};
// one piece of speech with several speakers back to back: [[voice, seconds], ...]
const turnsPcm = (turns) => Buffer.concat(turns.map(([v, s]) => pcm(v, s)));
const settled = (d) => d.segments.every((s) => s.status !== "pending" && s.status !== "queued");
const until = async (fn, ms = 3000) => {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  for (;;) {
    const v = await fn();
    if (v) return v;
    if (Date.now() - t0 > ms) throw new Error("timeout");
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50));
  }
};

before(async () => { await start(3911); });
after(() => { server.close(); fs.rmSync(dataDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); });

test("conversation messages are stored and listed", async () => {
  const c = (await j("POST", "/api/conversations")).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "I work at Infosys as a data engineer.", modality: "voice" });
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "assistant", text: "Got it." });
  const got = (await j("GET", `/api/conversations/${c.id}`)).data;
  assert.equal(got.messages.length, 2);
  assert.equal(got.messages[0].modality, "voice");
  const list = (await j("GET", "/api/conversations")).data;
  assert.ok(list.some((x) => x.id === c.id));
});

test("memory extraction adds, updates (keeping history) and retires facts", async () => {
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { confirmMemoryChanges: false }); // apply changes directly
  const c = (await j("POST", "/api/conversations")).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "I work at Infosys and my sister is Priya." });
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "assistant", text: "Noted." });
  nextOps = [
    { action: "add", content: "The user works at Infosys.", category: "work" },
    { action: "add", content: "The user's sister is named Priya.", category: "people" },
  ];
  const r1 = (await j("POST", `/api/memories/extract/${c.id}`)).data;
  assert.equal(r1.length, 2);
  const infosys = r1[0].memory;

  // nothing new -> no Gemini call
  const calls = geminiCalls.json.length;
  assert.deepEqual((await j("POST", `/api/memories/extract/${c.id}`)).data, []);
  assert.equal(geminiCalls.json.length, calls);

  // the job changes: the extractor sees the old fact as a candidate and updates it
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "I moved to TCS last month." });
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "assistant", text: "Congrats!" });
  nextOps = [{ action: "update", memory_id: infosys.id, content: "The user works at TCS (since September 2026).", category: "work" }];
  const r2 = (await j("POST", `/api/memories/extract/${c.id}`)).data;
  assert.equal(r2[0].op, "update");
  const prompt = geminiCalls.json.at(-1).prompt;
  assert.match(prompt, new RegExp(`\\[${infosys.id}\\].*Infosys`), "old fact offered to the model");
  assert.match(prompt, /moved to TCS/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(prompt.split("New messages to process:")[1], /my sister is Priya/, "processed messages are not re-sent as new");

  const all = (await j("GET", "/api/memories")).data;
  const old = all.find((m) => m.id === infosys.id);
  assert.equal(old.status, "superseded");
  assert.equal(old.supersededBy, r2[0].memory.id);

  // only current facts are used for answers
  const setup = (await j("GET", "/api/live/setup")).data;
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, /TCS/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(setup.systemInstruction, /Infosys/);
  const hits = (await j("GET", "/api/memories/search?q=where%20does%20the%20user%20work")).data;
  assert.ok(hits.some((h) => /TCS/.test(h.content)));
  assert.ok(!hits.some((h) => /Infosys/.test(h.content)));

  // ids the model was not shown are ignored (no blind edits)
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "Whatever." });
  nextOps = [{ action: "forget", memory_id: 99999 }];
  assert.deepEqual((await j("POST", `/api/memories/extract/${c.id}`)).data, []);
});

test("changes to existing memories wait for the user's OK", async () => {
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { confirmMemoryChanges: true });
  const c = (await j("POST", "/api/conversations")).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "I live in Pune and I drive a Swift." });
  nextOps = [
    { action: "add", content: "The user lives in Pune.", category: "personal" },
    { action: "add", content: "The user drives a Maruti Swift.", category: "personal" },
  ];
  const added = (await j("POST", `/api/memories/extract/${c.id}`)).data;
  const pune = added[0].memory;
  const swift = added[1].memory;

  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "I moved to Bengaluru. Also sold the car." });
  nextOps = [
    { action: "update", memory_id: pune.id, content: "The user lives in Bengaluru.", category: "personal" },
    { action: "retire", memory_id: swift.id },
  ];
  const r = (await j("POST", `/api/memories/extract/${c.id}`)).data;
  assert.deepEqual(r.map((x) => x.op), ["proposed", "proposed"]);
  // nothing changed yet
  let all = (await j("GET", "/api/memories")).data;
  assert.equal(all.find((m) => m.id === pune.id).status, "active");
  assert.equal(all.find((m) => m.id === swift.id).status, "active");
  assert.equal((await j("GET", "/api/health")).data.memoryReviews, 2);

  const props = (await j("GET", "/api/memories/proposals")).data;
  assert.equal(props.length, 2);
  const upd = props.find((p) => p.action === "update");
  assert.equal(upd.current.content, "The user lives in Pune.");
  assert.equal(upd.content, "The user lives in Bengaluru.");

  // accept the update with an edit, keep the car
  await j("POST", `/api/memories/proposals/${upd.id}/accept`, { content: "The user lives in Bengaluru (Koramangala)." });
  await j("POST", `/api/memories/proposals/${props.find((p) => p.action === "retire").id}/reject`);
  all = (await j("GET", "/api/memories")).data;
  assert.equal(all.find((m) => m.id === pune.id).status, "superseded");
  assert.ok(all.some((m) => m.status === "active" && m.content === "The user lives in Bengaluru (Koramangala)."));
  assert.equal(all.find((m) => m.id === swift.id).status, "active");
  assert.equal((await j("GET", "/api/health")).data.memoryReviews, 0);

  // a change the user turned down is not asked again
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "No car any more." });
  nextOps = [{ action: "retire", memory_id: swift.id }];
  assert.deepEqual((await j("POST", `/api/memories/extract/${c.id}`)).data, []);
});

test("conversations can be renamed, pinned, exported and continued", async () => {
  const a = (await j("POST", "/api/conversations")).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${a.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "Plan my Goa trip" });
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${a.id}/messages`, { role: "assistant", text: "Sure, when are you going?" });
  const b = (await j("POST", "/api/conversations")).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${b.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "Newer chat" });

  let got = (await j("PATCH", `/api/conversations/${a.id}`, { title: "Goa trip", pinned: true })).data;
  assert.equal(got.title, "Goa trip");
  assert.equal(got.pinned, true);
  const list = (await j("GET", "/api/conversations")).data;
  assert.equal(list[0].id, a.id, "pinned first even though older");
  // clearing the name goes back to the automatic title
  got = (await j("PATCH", `/api/conversations/${a.id}`, { title: "" })).data;
  assert.equal(got.title, "Plan my Goa trip");
  await j("PATCH", `/api/conversations/${a.id}`, { title: "Goa trip" });

  const md = await fetch(`${B}/api/conversations/${a.id}/export?format=md`);
  assert.match(md.headers.get("content-disposition"), /Goa_trip\.md/);
  const body = await md.text();
  assert.match(body, /^# Goa trip/);
  assert.match(body, /\*\*You\*\*: Plan my Goa trip/);
  const json = JSON.parse(await (await fetch(`${B}/api/conversations/${a.id}/export?format=json`)).text());
  assert.equal(json.messages.length, 2);

  // continuing: the assistant is given the earlier messages
  const setup = (await j("GET", `/api/live/setup?conversation=${a.id}`)).data;
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, /continuing an earlier conversation/);
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, /User: Plan my Goa trip\nAURA: Sure, when are you going\?/);
  assert.doesNotMatch((await j("GET", "/api/live/setup")).data.systemInstruction, /earlier conversation/);
});

test("meeting: live transcription mode returns turns and takes text from the browser", async () => {
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title: "Live" })).data;
  const r = (await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=0&end=5000&live=1`, turnsPcm([[10, 2.5], [11, 2.5]]))).data;
  assert.equal(r.turns.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(r.turns.map((t) => [t.startMs, t.endMs]), [[0, 2500], [2500, 5000]]);
  let d = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
  assert.deepEqual(d.segments.map((s) => s.status), ["live", "live"]);
  const before = geminiCalls.transcribe;
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments/${r.turns[0].id}/transcript`, { text: "namaste everyone" });
  // the browser couldn't transcribe the second turn: the server does it the standard way
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments/${r.turns[1].id}/transcript`, { failed: true });
  d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return settled(x) && x.segments.every((s) => s.status !== "live") && x;
  });
  assert.equal(d.segments[0].text, "namaste everyone");
  assert.equal(d.segments[1].text, "words from voice 11");
  assert.equal(geminiCalls.transcribe, before + 1);
  assert.equal(new Set(d.segments.map((s) => s.speakerId)).size, 2);
});

test("memories can be edited, restored and deleted", async () => {
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/memories", { content: "The user likes jazz.", category: "preference" })).data;
  const e = (await j("PATCH", `/api/memories/${m.id}`, { content: "The user likes jazz and blues." })).data;
  assert.equal(e.content, "The user likes jazz and blues.");
  await j("PATCH", `/api/memories/${m.id}`, { status: "outdated" });
  assert.equal((await j("GET", "/api/memories")).data.find((x) => x.id === m.id).status, "outdated");
  await j("PATCH", `/api/memories/${m.id}`, { status: "active" });
  assert.equal((await j("DELETE", `/api/memories/${m.id}`)).data.deleted, true);
  assert.ok(!(await j("GET", "/api/memories")).data.some((x) => x.id === m.id));
});

test("enrollment requires consent and enough audio", async () => {
  assert.equal((await j("POST", "/api/speakers?name=Asha", pcm(1, 10))).status, 400);
  assert.equal((await j("POST", "/api/speakers?name=Asha&consent=yes", pcm(1, 3))).status, 400);
  const p = (await j("POST", "/api/speakers?name=Asha&consent=yes", pcm(1, 10))).data;
  assert.equal(p.name, "Asha");
  const id = (await j("POST", "/api/speakers/identify", pcm(1, 3))).data;
  assert.equal(id[0].name, "Asha");
  assert.ok(id[0].score > 0.9);
});

test("meeting: registered voice gets its name, unknown voices get stable Speaker N labels", async () => {
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title: "Standup" })).data;
  // voice 1 = Asha (enrolled above); voices 2 and 3 are unknown
  const order = [1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 3, 2];
  let t = 0;
  for (const v of order) {
    await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=${t}&end=${t + 2000}`, pcm(v, 2));
    t += 2500;
  }
  // a very short blip right after voice 2
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=${t}&end=${t + 500}`, pcm(2, 0.5));
  const done = await until(async () => {
    const d = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return settled(d) && d;
  });
  const label = new Map(done.speakers.map((s) => [s.id, s.label]));
  const labels = done.segments.map((s) => label.get(s.speakerId));
  assert.deepEqual(labels, ["Asha", "Speaker 1", "Speaker 2", "Speaker 1", "Asha", "Speaker 2", "Speaker 1", "Speaker 1"]);
  assert.equal(done.segments.at(-1).speakerUncertain, true, "short segment flagged");
  assert.equal(done.segments[0].text, "words from voice 1");

  // corrections: rename Speaker 1 everywhere, move one line, merge
  const s1 = done.speakers.find((s) => s.label === "Speaker 1");
  const s2 = done.speakers.find((s) => s.label === "Speaker 2");
  await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/speakers/${s1.id}`, { label: "Ravi" });
  let d = (await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments/${done.segments[2].id}`, { speakerId: s1.id })).data;
  assert.equal(new Map(d.speakers.map((s) => [s.id, s.label])).get(d.segments[2].speakerId), "Ravi");
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/speakers/${s2.id}/merge`, { into: s1.id });
  d = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
  assert.ok(!d.speakers.some((s) => s.id === s2.id));
  d = (await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments/${done.segments[0].id}`, { text: "Corrected text" })).data;
  assert.equal(d.segments[0].text, "Corrected text");

  // the merged voice keeps landing on the merged speaker
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=28000&end=30000`, pcm(3, 2));
  d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return settled(x) && x;
  });
  assert.equal(d.segments.at(-1).speakerId, s1.id, "voice 3 now goes to Ravi");

  // a new unknown voice after a rename is still numbered after the existing ones
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=30000&end=32000`, pcm(4, 2));
  d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return settled(x) && x;
  });
  assert.equal(new Map(d.speakers.map((s) => [s.id, s.label])).get(d.segments.at(-1).speakerId), "Speaker 3", "numbering continues after Speaker 2");

  // export
  const txt = await fetch(`${B}/api/meetings/${m.id}/export?format=txt`);
  assert.match(txt.headers.get("content-disposition"), /Standup\.txt/);
  const body = await txt.text();
  assert.match(body, /\[00:00 - 00:02\] Asha: Corrected text/);
  assert.match(body, /Ravi: words from voice 2/);
  const md = await (await fetch(`${B}/api/meetings/${m.id}/export?format=md`)).text();
  assert.match(md, /^# Standup/);
  const json = JSON.parse(await (await fetch(`${B}/api/meetings/${m.id}/export?format=json`)).text());
  assert.equal(json.segments[0].speaker, "Asha");
});

test("meeting: two people in one piece of speech are split into two lines", async () => {
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title: "Back to back" })).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=1000&end=6000`, turnsPcm([[5, 2.5], [6, 2.5]]));
  const d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.segments.length === 2 && settled(x) && x;
  });
  const label = new Map(d.speakers.map((s) => [s.id, s.label]));
  assert.deepEqual(d.segments.map((s) => label.get(s.speakerId)), ["Speaker 1", "Speaker 2"]);
  assert.deepEqual(d.segments.map((s) => s.text), ["words from voice 5", "words from voice 6"]);
  assert.equal(d.segments[0].startMs, 1000);
  assert.equal(d.segments[1].startMs, 3500, "second line starts where the second voice starts");
  assert.equal(d.segments[1].endMs, 6000);
});

test("voice chat: the speech language setting becomes transcription language codes", async () => {
  assert.equal((await j("GET", "/api/settings")).data.assistantLanguage, "auto");
  assert.deepEqual((await j("GET", "/api/live/setup")).data.languageCodes, [], "automatic by default");
  const codes = async (assistantLanguage) => {
    await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { assistantLanguage });
    return (await j("GET", "/api/live/setup")).data.languageCodes;
  };
  assert.deepEqual(await codes("en"), ["en-IN"]);
  assert.deepEqual(await codes("hi"), ["hi-IN"]);
  assert.deepEqual(await codes("en-hi"), ["en-IN", "hi-IN"]);
  assert.deepEqual(await codes("klingon"), [], "unknown values fall back to automatic");
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { assistantLanguage: "auto" });
});

test("meeting: transcription gets earlier lines as context and the language hint", async () => {
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { meetingLanguage: "English and Hindi" });
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title: "Context" })).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=0&end=2000`, pcm(7, 2));
  await until(async () => settled((await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data));
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=3000&end=5000`, pcm(7, 2));
  await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.segments.length === 2 && settled(x);
  });
  assert.equal(geminiCalls.lastTranscribe.language, "English and Hindi");
  assert.match(geminiCalls.lastTranscribe.context, /Speaker 1: words from voice 7/);
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { meetingLanguage: "" });
});

test("meeting: after it ends, one voice split in two is merged back", async () => {
  // very strict matching during the meeting: the same voice gets split into several speakers
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { voiceClusterThreshold: 0.995 });
  noise = 0.25;
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title: "Refine" })).data;
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=${i * 3000}&end=${i * 3000 + 2000}`, pcm(8, 2));
  let d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.segments.length === 4 && settled(x) && x;
  });
  assert.ok(d.speakers.length > 1, "split during the meeting");
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { voiceClusterThreshold: 0.55 });
  noise = 0.15;
  await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`, { ended: true });
  d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.refined && x;
  });
  assert.equal(d.speakers.length, 1, "merged after the meeting");
  assert.equal(new Set(d.segments.map((s) => s.speakerId)).size, 1);
  assert.equal(d.speakers[0].segments, 4);
});

test("voice profiles from an older model are flagged and not used", async () => {
  const p = (await j("POST", "/api/speakers?name=Old&consent=yes", pcm(9, 10))).data;
  assert.equal(p.outdated, false);
  const { db } = await import("../db.mjs");
  db.prepare("UPDATE speaker_profiles SET model = 'old-model' WHERE id = ?").run(p.id);
  assert.equal((await j("GET", "/api/speakers")).data.find((x) => x.id === p.id).outdated, true);
  assert.ok(!(await j("POST", "/api/speakers/identify", pcm(9, 3))).data.some((x) => x.name === "Old"));
  // re-recording replaces the voiceprint in place
  const r = (await j("POST", `/api/speakers?name=Old&consent=yes&replace=${p.id}`, pcm(9, 10))).data;
  assert.equal(r.id, p.id);
  assert.equal(r.outdated, false);
});

// a finished, transcribed two-person meeting that started at `startedAt`
async function finishedMeeting(title, startedAt) {
  const m = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title })).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/segments?start=0&end=5000`, turnsPcm([[21, 2.5], [22, 2.5]]));
  await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.segments.length === 2 && settled(x);
  });
  if (startedAt) {
    const { db } = await import("../db.mjs");
    db.prepare("UPDATE meetings SET started_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(startedAt, m.id);
  }
  return m;
}

test("meeting: when it ends, durable facts go to memory, linked to the meeting", async () => {
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { confirmMemoryChanges: false, userName: "Soubh" });
  nextMeetingOps = [{ action: "add", content: "In the meeting on 7 Oct 2026, Speaker 2 agreed to send the budget by Friday.", category: "work" }];
  const m = await finishedMeeting("Budget sync");
  await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`, { ended: true });
  const d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.memoryStatus === "done" && x;
  });
  assert.equal(d.memoryCount, 1);
  const call = geminiCalls.json.findLast((c) => /transcript of a meeting/.test(c.system));
  assert.match(call.prompt, /Speaker 1: words from voice 21/);
  assert.match(call.prompt, /Speaker 2: words from voice 22/);
  assert.match(call.prompt, /The user's name is Soubh/);
  assert.match(call.prompt, /Meeting date:/);
  const memo = (await j("GET", "/api/memories")).data.find((x) => /send the budget/.test(x.content));
  assert.equal(memo.meetingId, m.id);
  assert.equal(memo.source, "meeting");
  // the assistant's brief for this meeting lists it
  const brief = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/brief`)).data;
  assert.deepEqual(brief.memoriesFromThisMeeting, [memo.content]);
  assert.match(brief.transcript, /Speaker 2: words from voice 22/);
  nextMeetingOps = [];
});

test("meeting: memory from meetings can be switched off and run by hand", async () => {
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { meetingMemory: false });
  const calls = geminiCalls.json.length;
  const m = await finishedMeeting("Quiet one");
  await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`, { ended: true });
  const d = await until(async () => {
    const x = (await j("GET", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`)).data;
    return x.refined && x.memoryStatus && x;
  });
  assert.equal(d.memoryStatus, "off");
  assert.equal(geminiCalls.json.length, calls, "nothing sent to Gemini");
  nextMeetingOps = [{ action: "add", content: "In the meeting on 7 Oct 2026, the team chose Goa for the offsite.", category: "plan" }];
  const after = (await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/memorize`)).data;
  assert.equal(after.memoryStatus, "done");
  assert.equal(after.memoryCount, 1);
  nextMeetingOps = [{ action: "forget", memory_id: 1 }];
  const again = (await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/memorize`)).data;
  assert.equal(again.memoryCount, 0, "meetings never delete memories");
  nextMeetingOps = [];
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { meetingMemory: true });
});

test("meeting: minutes are written, stored, exported and name an untitled meeting", async () => {
  const m = await finishedMeeting(""); // automatic "Meeting <date>" title
  assert.match(m.title, /^Meeting \d/);
  nextMinutes = {
    suggested_title: "Offsite planning",
    summary: "The team planned the offsite.",
    key_points: ["Goa is preferred"],
    decisions: ["Offsite in Goa"],
    action_items: [{ task: "Book flights", owner: "Speaker 2", due: "2026-10-20" }, { task: "" }],
    open_questions: [],
  };
  const d = (await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/minutes`)).data;
  assert.equal(d.title, "Offsite planning");
  assert.equal(d.minutes.summary, "The team planned the offsite.");
  assert.deepEqual(d.minutes.actionItems, [{ task: "Book flights", owner: "Speaker 2", due: "2026-10-20" }]);
  assert.ok(d.minutesAt);
  const call = geminiCalls.json.at(-1);
  assert.match(call.prompt, /\[00:00\] Speaker \d: words from voice 21/);
  const md = await fetch(`${B}/api/meetings/${m.id}/export?format=md`).then((r) => r.text());
  assert.match(md, /## Minutes of meeting/);
  assert.match(md, /Book flights \| owner: Speaker 2 \| due: 2026-10-20/);
  assert.match(md, /## Transcript/);
  // a title the user chose is kept
  await j("PATCH", `/api/meetings/${m.id}`, { title: "My name" });
  nextMinutes = { ...nextMinutes, suggested_title: "Something else" };
  assert.equal((await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/minutes`)).data.title, "My name");
  assert.equal((await j("DELETE", `/api/meetings/${m.id}/minutes`)).data.minutes, null);
  // nothing to summarise
  const empty = (await j("POST", "/api/meetings", { title: "Empty" })).data;
  assert.equal((await j("POST", `/api/meetings/${empty.id}/minutes`)).status, 400);
});

test("meetings can be found by date range and topic", async () => {
  const day = (y, mo, d, h = 10) => new Date(y, mo - 1, d, h).getTime();
  const wed = await finishedMeeting("Design review", day(2026, 10, 7));
  const thu = await finishedMeeting("Hiring chat", day(2026, 10, 8));
  const range = (a, b) => `/api/meetings/find?from=${a}&to=${b}`;
  // "last Wednesday" = 7 Oct 2026, local day
  let r = (await j("GET", range(day(2026, 10, 7, 0), day(2026, 10, 8, 0) - 1))).data;
  assert.deepEqual(r.meetings.map((x) => x.id), [wed.id]);
  assert.match(r.meetings[0].when, /Wednesday,? 7 October 2026/);
  assert.deepEqual(r.meetings[0].participants.sort(), ["Speaker 1", "Speaker 2"]);
  assert.match(r.meetings[0].preview, /words from voice/);
  r = (await j("GET", range(day(2026, 10, 7, 0), day(2026, 10, 9, 0)))).data;
  assert.deepEqual(r.meetings.map((x) => x.id), [thu.id, wed.id], "newest first");
  // topic inside the range
  r = (await j("GET", range(day(2026, 10, 7, 0), day(2026, 10, 9, 0)) + "&q=hiring")).data;
  assert.equal(r.matchedQuery, true);
  assert.deepEqual(r.meetings.map((x) => x.id), [thu.id]);
  // unknown topic: falls back to the date range
  r = (await j("GET", range(day(2026, 10, 7, 0), day(2026, 10, 9, 0)) + "&q=zebra")).data;
  assert.equal(r.matchedQuery, false);
  assert.equal(r.meetings.length, 2);
  // a day without meetings
  assert.deepEqual((await j("GET", range(day(2026, 10, 1, 0), day(2026, 10, 2, 0)))).data.meetings, []);
  // the assistant is told the current date and how to look meetings up
  const setup = (await j("GET", "/api/live/setup")).data;
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, /Right now it is \w+day,? \d+ \w+ \d{4}/);
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, /find_meetings/);
});


// ---- documents ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// a tiny ZIP writer (deflate) so the tests can build real .docx/.pptx/.xlsx files
const zlib = await import("node:zlib");
function makeZip(files) {
  const locals = [], centrals = [];
  let off = 0;
  for (const [name, content] of Object.entries(files)) {
    const data = Buffer.from(content, "utf8");
    const comp = zlib.deflateRawSync(data);
    const crc = zlib.crc32(data);
    const n = Buffer.from(name);
    const lh = Buffer.alloc(30);
    lh.writeUInt32LE(0x04034b50, 0); lh.writeUInt16LE(20, 4); lh.writeUInt16LE(8, 8);
    lh.writeUInt32LE(crc, 14); lh.writeUInt32LE(comp.length, 18); lh.writeUInt32LE(data.length, 22); lh.writeUInt16LE(n.length, 26);
    const ch = Buffer.alloc(46);
    ch.writeUInt32LE(0x02014b50, 0); ch.writeUInt16LE(20, 4); ch.writeUInt16LE(20, 6); ch.writeUInt16LE(8, 10);
    ch.writeUInt32LE(crc, 16); ch.writeUInt32LE(comp.length, 20); ch.writeUInt32LE(data.length, 24); ch.writeUInt16LE(n.length, 28); ch.writeUInt32LE(off, 42);
    locals.push(lh, n, comp);
    centrals.push(ch, n);
    off += 30 + n.length + comp.length;
  }
  const cd = Buffer.concat(centrals);
  const end = Buffer.alloc(22);
  end.writeUInt32LE(0x06054b50, 0); end.writeUInt16LE(centrals.length / 2, 8); end.writeUInt16LE(centrals.length / 2, 10);
  end.writeUInt32LE(cd.length, 12); end.writeUInt32LE(off, 16);
  return Buffer.concat([...locals, cd, end]);
}

test("documents: text comes out of Word, PowerPoint, Excel and CSV files", async () => {
  const { extractText, classify } = await import("../doc-text.mjs");
  const docx = makeZip({ "word/document.xml": `<w:document><w:body><w:p><w:r><w:t>Monthly rent:</w:t></w:r><w:r><w:tab/><w:t>25,000 &amp; deposit</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:tbl><w:tr><w:tc><w:p><w:t>Start</w:t></w:p></w:tc><w:tc><w:p><w:t>1 Nov</w:t></w:p></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl></w:body></w:document>` });
  const t = extractText("lease.docx", docx);
  assert.match(t, /Monthly rent:\t25,000 & deposit/);
  assert.match(t, /Start/);
  assert.match(t, /1 Nov/);

  const pptx = makeZip({
    "ppt/slides/slide2.xml": `<p:sld><a:p><a:r><a:t>Second slide</a:t></a:r></a:p></p:sld>`,
    "ppt/slides/slide10.xml": `<p:sld><a:p><a:t>Tenth</a:t></a:p></p:sld>`,
    "ppt/slides/slide1.xml": `<p:sld><a:p><a:t>Title slide</a:t></a:p><a:p><a:t>Q3 results</a:t></a:p></p:sld>`,
  });
  const p = extractText("deck.pptx", pptx);
  assert.ok(p.indexOf("Title slide") < p.indexOf("Second slide") && p.indexOf("Second slide") < p.indexOf("Tenth"), "slides in numeric order");
  assert.match(p, /--- Slide 1 ---\nTitle slide\nQ3 results/);

  const xlsx = makeZip({
    "xl/workbook.xml": `<workbook><sheets><sheet name="Budget" sheetId="1" r:id="rId1"/></sheets></workbook>`,
    "xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels": `<Relationships><Relationship Id="rId1" Target="worksheets/sheet1.xml"/></Relationships>`,
    "xl/sharedStrings.xml": `<sst><si><t>Item</t></si><si><t>Cost</t></si><si><r><t>Ren</t></r><r><t>t</t></r></si></sst>`,
    "xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml": `<worksheet><sheetData><row r="1"><c r="A1" t="s"><v>0</v></c><c r="B1" t="s"><v>1</v></c></row><row r="2"><c r="A2" t="s"><v>2</v></c><c r="C2"><v>25000</v></c></row><row r="3"><c r="A3" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Food</t></is></c><c r="B3"/></row></sheetData></worksheet>`,
  });
  const x = extractText("budget.xlsx", xlsx);
  assert.match(x, /--- Sheet: Budget ---\nItem\tCost\nRent\t\t25000\nFood/);

  assert.equal(extractText("a.csv", Buffer.from("ï»¿name,age\nA,3\n")), "name,age\nA,3");
  assert.equal(classify("x.pdf").kind, "pdf");
  assert.equal(classify("x.JPG").kind, "image");
  assert.match(classify("old.doc").error, /\.docx/);
  assert.match(classify("thing.exe").error, /aren't supported/);
  const { unzip } = await import("../doc-text.mjs");
  assert.throws(() => unzip(Buffer.from("not a zip at all, definitely not")), /not a valid Office file/);
});

test("documents: added to a conversation, read once, asked about, removed with it", async () => {
  const conv = (await j("POST", "/api/conversations")).data;
  const before = geminiCalls.json.length;
  const pdf = Buffer.from("%PDF-1.4 fake rental agreement");
  const up = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=${encodeURIComponent("Lease 2026.pdf")}`, pdf);
  assert.equal(up.status, 200, up.text);
  const docId = up.data.document.id;
  assert.equal(up.data.document.status, "analysing");
  assert.equal(up.data.message.modality, "document");
  assert.deepEqual(up.data.message.document, { id: docId, name: "Lease 2026.pdf" });

  const ready = await until(async () => {
    const d = (await j("GET", `/api/documents/${docId}`)).data;
    return d.status === "ready" && d;
  });
  assert.equal(ready.analysis.docType, "contract");
  assert.deepEqual(ready.analysis.suggestedQuestions, ["When does it end?"]);
  assert.equal(ready.analysis.pages, 2);
  const readCall = geminiCalls.json.slice(before).find((c) => /You read documents/.test(c.system));
  const inline = readCall.parts.find((p) => p.inlineData);
  assert.equal(inline.inlineData.mimeType, "application/pdf");
  assert.equal(Buffer.from(inline.inlineData.data, "base64").toString(), pdf.toString(), "the PDF itself goes to Gemini");

  // the attachment is part of the conversation
  const c = (await j("GET", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}`)).data;
  assert.equal(c.messages.at(-1).document.id, docId);

  // a text document: its text goes to Gemini, not the file
  const md = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=notes.md`, Buffer.from("# Notes\nThe deposit is two months of rent."));
  assert.equal(md.status, 200);
  await until(async () => (await j("GET", `/api/documents/${md.data.document.id}`)).data.status === "ready");

  // asking: one document, or all of them
  const one = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents/ask`, { question: "How much is the rent?", documentId: docId });
  assert.equal(one.status, 200, one.text);
  assert.equal(one.data.found, true);
  assert.match(one.data.answer, /25,000/);
  assert.equal(one.data.quotes[0].where, "page 1");
  let ask = geminiCalls.json.at(-1);
  assert.match(ask.parts.at(-1).text, /How much is the rent/);
  assert.equal(ask.parts.filter((p) => p.inlineData).length, 1);
  assert.ok(!ask.parts.some((p) => /deposit is two months/.test(p.text || "")), "only the chosen document");
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents/ask`, { question: "What is the deposit?" });
  ask = geminiCalls.json.at(-1);
  assert.ok(ask.parts.some((p) => /deposit is two months/.test(p.text || "")) && ask.parts.some((p) => p.inlineData), "all documents");

  // the assistant is told about them
  const setup = (await j("GET", `/api/live/setup?conversation=${conv.id}`)).data;
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, new RegExp(`document_id ${docId}: "Lease 2026.pdf" \\(PDF\\) â€” contract, A one-year rental agreement`));
  assert.match(setup.systemInstruction, /call ask_document/);

  // files that can't be used are refused with a clear reason
  const bad = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=old.doc`, Buffer.from("x"));
  assert.equal(bad.status, 415);
  assert.match(bad.data.error, /Save it as \.docx/);
  const big = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=scan.png`, Buffer.alloc(15 * 1024 * 1024, 1));
  assert.equal(big.status, 413);
  assert.match(big.data.error, /limit for this type is 14 MB/);
  const empty = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=empty.txt`, Buffer.from("   \n  "));
  assert.equal(empty.status, 422);

  // a failed read can be retried
  docFail = true;
  const f = await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}/documents?name=photo.jpg`, Buffer.from([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 1, 2]));
  const failed = await until(async () => {
    const d = (await j("GET", `/api/documents/${f.data.document.id}`)).data;
    return d.status === "error" && d;
  });
  assert.match(failed.error, /model unavailable/);
  docFail = false;
  await j("POST", `/api/documents/${f.data.document.id}/retry`);
  await until(async () => (await j("GET", `/api/documents/${f.data.document.id}`)).data.status === "ready");

  // the original can be downloaded
  const file = await fetch(`${B}/api/documents/${docId}/file`);
  assert.equal(Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer()).toString(), pdf.toString());
  assert.match(file.headers.get("content-disposition"), /Lease%202026\.pdf/);

  // removing one document, then the whole conversation, removes the stored files
  const docsDir = path.join(dataDir, "documents");
  const n = fs.readdirSync(docsDir).length;
  assert.equal((await j("DELETE", `/api/documents/${md.data.document.id}`)).data.deleted, true);
  assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(docsDir).length, n - 1);
  await j("DELETE", `/api/conversations/${conv.id}`);
  assert.equal(fs.readdirSync(docsDir).length, 0);
  assert.equal((await j("GET", `/api/documents/${docId}`)).status, 404);
});

test("AURA_REPROPOSE: a turned-down change comes back only after new words from the user, and only N times", async () => {
  await j("PUT", "/api/settings", { confirmMemoryChanges: true });
  const mem = await import("../memory.mjs");
  const wait = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 8));
  const c = (await j("POST", "/api/conversations")).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "I live in Pune." });
  nextOps = [{ action: "add", content: "The user lives in Pune.", category: "personal" }];
  const pune = (await j("POST", `/api/memories/extract/${c.id}`)).data[0].memory;
  const say = async (text, ops) => {
    await wait();
    await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text });
    nextOps = ops;
    return (await j("POST", `/api/memories/extract/${c.id}`)).data;
  };
  const move = [{ action: "update", memory_id: pune.id, content: "The user lives in Hyderabad.", category: "personal" }];
  const reject = async () => {
    await wait();
    const p = (await j("GET", "/api/memories/proposals")).data;
    assert.equal(p.length, 1);
    await j("POST", `/api/memories/proposals/${p[0].id}/reject`);
  };
  process.env.AURA_REPROPOSE = "1";
  try {
    assert.equal((await say("I moved to Hyderabad.", move))[0].op, "proposed");
    await reject();
    // the same words again, nothing new said after the rejection: no extraction call, nothing proposed
    assert.deepEqual((await j("POST", `/api/memories/extract/${c.id}`)).data, []);
    // new words after the rejection: asked once more
    assert.equal((await say("Like I said, I live in Hyderabad.", move))[0].op, "proposed");
    await reject();
    // limit of 1 re-proposal reached
    assert.deepEqual(await say("Yes, still in Hyderabad.", move), []);
    // default (0): never again
    process.env.AURA_REPROPOSE = "0";
    assert.deepEqual(await say("Hyderabad it is.", move), []);
  } finally {
    delete process.env.AURA_REPROPOSE;
  }
  assert.equal(mem.pendingProposalCount(), 0);
});

test("AURA_CANDIDATES: modes change which memories the extractor is shown, default stays as it was", async () => {
  const mem = await import("../memory.mjs");
  const { db } = await import("../db.mjs");
  const pune = await mem.addMemory({ content: "The user lives in Pune.", category: "personal" });
  const others = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) others.push(await mem.addMemory({ content: `The user's favourite number is ${i + 100}.`, category: "other" }));
  db.prepare("UPDATE memories SET updated_at = 1 WHERE id = ?").run(pune.id); // oldest: not among the 8 most recent
  others.forEach((m, i) => db.prepare("UPDATE memories SET updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(1000 + i, m.id));
  const text = "Relocated to a brand new city.";
  const ids = async (mode) => (await mem.selectCandidates(text, mode)).map((m) => m.id);
  assert.ok(!(await ids("default")).includes(pune.id), "default: no overlap, not shown");
  assert.ok(!(await ids("sentence")).includes(pune.id), "sentence: still needs the minimum score");
  assert.ok((await ids("nomin")).includes(pune.id), "nomin: shown without the minimum score");
  assert.ok((await ids("adaptive")).includes(pune.id), "adaptive: shown, the text sounds like a change");
  // the switch is read from the environment when no mode is passed
  process.env.AURA_CANDIDATES = "nomin";
  try {
    assert.ok((await mem.selectCandidates(text)).some((m) => m.id === pune.id));
  } finally {
    delete process.env.AURA_CANDIDATES;
  }
  assert.ok(!(await mem.selectCandidates(text)).some((m) => m.id === pune.id));
});

test("dates: phrases resolve in the user's time zone against a fixed now", () => {
  const tz = "Asia/Kolkata";
  const at = (s, now = NOW, zone = tz) => P.resolveDate(s, { now, tz: zone })?.at;
  assert.equal(at("tomorrow at 5pm"), IST(2026, 10, 15, 17));
  assert.equal(at("Friday"), IST(2026, 10, 16, 9), "a day without a time means 9:00");
  assert.equal(at("next Wednesday"), IST(2026, 10, 21, 9));
  assert.equal(at("20 Oct"), IST(2026, 10, 20, 9));
  assert.equal(at("in 2 hours"), NOW + 2 * 3_600_000);
  assert.equal(at("in 3 minutes", NOW + 8_000), NOW + 3 * 60_000, "to the minute");
  assert.equal(at("sometime"), undefined);
  // 23:30 in India is still the same day in UTC: "tomorrow" must follow the local day
  assert.equal(at("tomorrow at 8am", IST(2026, 10, 14, 23, 30)), IST(2026, 10, 15, 8));
  // daylight saving ends in New York on 1 Nov 2026: 9 am that day is 14:00 UTC (not 13:00)
  assert.equal(at("tomorrow at 9am", Date.UTC(2026, 9, 31, 16), "America/New_York"), Date.UTC(2026, 10, 1, 14));
  assert.equal(P.formatWhen(IST(2026, 10, 15, 17), tz), "Thu 15 Oct, 5:00 PM");

  const r = P.parseReminder("Thanks! Can you remind me to call Mom tomorrow at 5pm?", { now: NOW, tz });
  assert.deepEqual(r, { what: "call Mom", at: IST(2026, 10, 15, 17), when: "tomorrow at 5pm" });
  assert.equal(P.parseReminder("remind me about the rent on Friday", { now: NOW, tz }).what, "the rent");
  assert.equal(P.parseReminder("remind me to stretch", { now: NOW, tz }).at, null);
  assert.equal(P.parseReminder("what's the weather tomorrow?", { now: NOW, tz }), null);
  // other ways of asking
  const t = (x) => P.parseReminder(x, { now: NOW, tz });
  // what was actually said at 11:01: same day; said at noon it means tomorrow
  assert.deepEqual(P.parseReminder("Remind me to call my mother at 11:05 a.m.", { now: IST(2026, 10, 14, 11, 1), tz }), { what: "call my mother", at: IST(2026, 10, 14, 11, 5), when: "at 11:05 am" });
  assert.equal(t("Remind me to call my mother at 11:05 a.m.").at, IST(2026, 10, 15, 11, 5));
  assert.equal(t("Could you set a reminder for 1:00 p.m. exam?").at, IST(2026, 10, 14, 13));
  assert.equal(t("Could you set a reminder for 1:00 p.m. exam?").what, "exam");
  assert.equal(t("please set an alarm for 6am tomorrow").at, IST(2026, 10, 15, 6));
  assert.equal(t("don't let me forget the rent on Friday").what, "the rent");
  assert.equal(t("add a reminder to book tickets next Monday").at, IST(2026, 10, 19, 9));
  assert.equal(t("did you see the reminder I wrote?"), null, "talking about a reminder isn't asking for one");
});

// three reminder confirmations, all due now
const threeDue = (now) => ["water the plants", "pay rent", "call Ravi"].map((w, i) => P.onUserMessage(null, `remind me to ${w} on Friday at ${i + 1}pm`, now));

// a nudge of any type, due now
const insert = (type, at, extra = {}) =>
  Number(db.prepare("INSERT INTO nudges(type, kind, text, due_at, status, created_at, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?, ?)")
    .run(type, extra.kind ?? null, extra.text ?? type, at, at, extra.payload ? JSON.stringify(extra.payload) : null).lastInsertRowid);

const briefings = (n, at) => Array.from({ length: n }, () => insert("briefing", at, { kind: "daily" }));

test("scheduler: daily limit, per local day", () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_BRIEFING");
  process.env.AURA_NUDGE_MAX_PER_DAY = "2";
  briefings(3, NOW);
  assert.equal(P.surface(NOW).length, 2);
  assert.equal(P.blockedReason(NOW), "daily limit");
  assert.equal(P.surface(NOW + 3_600_000).length, 0, "still the same day");
  assert.equal(P.surface(IST(2026, 10, 15, 0, 5)).length, 1, "a new local day");
});

test("scheduler: quiet hours (across midnight)", () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_BRIEFING");
  process.env.AURA_QUIET_HOURS = "22:00-08:00";
  briefings(2, IST(2026, 10, 14, 21));
  assert.equal(P.blockedReason(IST(2026, 10, 14, 23)), "quiet hours");
  assert.equal(P.surface(IST(2026, 10, 14, 23)).length, 0);
  assert.equal(P.surface(IST(2026, 10, 15, 7, 59)).length, 0);
  assert.ok(P.surface(IST(2026, 10, 15, 8, 0)).length > 0);
});

test("reminders you asked for ignore the daily limit, quiet hours and cooldown, and don't use up the allowance", async () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_REMINDERS", "AURA_PROACTIVE_BRIEFING");
  process.env.AURA_NUDGE_MAX_PER_DAY = "1";
  process.env.AURA_QUIET_HOURS = "22:00-08:00";
  // what happened on 14 Oct: asked at 11:23 for "in 3 minutes", by voice: the spoken text and the tool
  const t0 = IST(2026, 10, 14, 11, 23) + 8_000;
  const c = (await j("POST", "/api/conversations")).data;
  P.onUserMessage(c.id, "Remind me to drink water in 3 minutes.", t0);
  const tool = P.requestReminder({ what: "drink water", when: "in 3 minutes", conversationId: null }, t0 + 40);
  assert.equal(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM nudges WHERE type = 'reminder'").get().n, 1, "one card, not two");
  assert.equal(P.formatWhen(P.getNudge(tool.reminderId).payload.at), "Wed 14 Oct, 11:26 AM");
  await P.confirmReminder(tool.reminderId, t0 + 13_000);
  // a briefing used up the day's one unsolicited nudge, and the user dismissed it (cooldown)
  const b = insert("briefing", t0, { kind: "daily" });
  P.surface(t0 + 14_000);
  await P.decide(b, { decision: "dismiss" }, t0 + 15_000);
  assert.equal(P.blockedReason(t0 + 20_000), "cooldown");
  // ...the reminder still appears on time
  const due = P.surface(IST(2026, 10, 14, 11, 26));
  assert.equal(due.length, 1);
  assert.equal(due[0].text, "drink water");
  // and at night too
  P.onUserMessage(c.id, "remind me to take my medicine at 11pm", t0);
  const ask = P.surface(t0 + 30_000).find((n) => n.kind === "confirm");
  await P.decide(ask.id, { decision: "accept" }, t0 + 31_000);
  assert.equal(P.surface(IST(2026, 10, 14, 23, 0)).length, 1, "quiet hours don't hold a reminder you set");
});

test("scheduler: cooldown after a dismissal (saying no to a reminder doesn't count)", async () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_REMINDERS", "AURA_PROACTIVE_BRIEFING");
  process.env.AURA_NUDGE_COOLDOWN_MIN = "120";
  process.env.AURA_NUDGE_MAX_PER_DAY = "10";
  // declining a reminder suggestion: no cooldown
  const [ask] = threeDue(NOW);
  P.surface(NOW);
  await P.decide(ask.id, { decision: "dismiss" }, NOW + 60_000);
  assert.equal(P.getNudge(ask.id).outcome, "declined");
  assert.equal(P.blockedReason(NOW + 2 * 60_000), null);
  // dismissing anything else: nothing new for two hours
  const b = insert("briefing", NOW, { kind: "daily" });
  P.surface(NOW + 2 * 60_000);
  await P.decide(b, { decision: "dismiss" }, NOW + 3 * 60_000);
  assert.equal(P.blockedReason(NOW + 30 * 60_000), "cooldown");
  insert("briefing", NOW + 30 * 60_000, { kind: "daily" });
  assert.equal(P.surface(NOW + 30 * 60_000).length, 0);
  assert.ok(P.surface(NOW + 124 * 60_000).length > 0);
});

test("scheduler: during voice chat only reminder cards appear; nothing during a meeting recording", () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_REMINDERS", "AURA_PROACTIVE_BRIEFING");
  process.env.AURA_NUDGE_MAX_PER_DAY = "10";
  threeDue(NOW);
  insert("briefing", NOW, { kind: "daily" });
  P.setPresence({ voice: true }, NOW);
  assert.equal(P.blockedReason(NOW + 60_000), "voice conversation");
  const shown = P.surface(NOW + 60_000);
  assert.ok(shown.length > 0 && shown.every((n) => n.type === "reminder"), "reminders only");
  // the browser stopped reporting (tab closed): the voice flag expires, the briefing shows
  assert.equal(P.blockedReason(NOW + 3 * 60_000), null);
  assert.ok(P.surface(NOW + 3 * 60_000).some((n) => n.type === "briefing"));
  P.setPresence({ voice: false }, NOW);
  // a meeting with speech in the last two minutes blocks everything, reminders too
  P.onUserMessage(null, "remind me to stretch on Saturday at 10am", NOW);
  const m = db.prepare("INSERT INTO meetings(title, started_at) VALUES ('Standup', ?)").run(NOW - 10 * 60_000).lastInsertRowid;
  db.prepare("INSERT INTO segments(meeting_id, start_ms, end_ms, status) VALUES (?, 0, ?, 'done')").run(m, 9 * 60_000);
  assert.equal(P.blockedReason(NOW, { requested: true }), "meeting recording");
  assert.equal(P.surface(NOW).length, 0);
  db.prepare("UPDATE meetings SET ended_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(NOW, m);
  assert.equal(P.blockedReason(NOW), null);
  assert.ok(P.surface(NOW).length > 0);
});
