async function memoryAged(content, category, days, source = "conversation") {
  const m = await mem.addMemory({ content, category, source });
  db.prepare("UPDATE memories SET updated_at = ?, created_at = ? WHERE id = ?").run(NOW - days * DAY, NOW - days * DAY, m.id);
  return m;
}

test("memory checks: only older facts that tend to change, most overdue first", async () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_MEMORY");
  const job = await memoryAged("Works at Infosys as an analyst", "work", 50);
  const city = await memoryAged("Lives in Pune", "personal", 100);
  await memoryAged("Birthday is on 3 May", "personal", 300); // lasting fact
  await memoryAged("Likes filter coffee", "preference", 300); // preference
  await memoryAged("Is writing an IEEE paper", "plan", 5); // recent
  const meeting = await memoryAged("Ravi leads the payments project", "work", 20, "meeting"); // less certain: half the wait
  const reviewed = await memoryAged("Sister Ria studies in Delhi", "people", 200);
  mem.propose({ action: "update", memoryId: reviewed.id, content: "Sister Ria studies in Mumbai" });

  const picked = P.selectMemoryChecks({ at: NOW, limit: 10 });
  assert.deepEqual(picked.map((c) => c.id), [city.id, job.id, meeting.id]);
  assert.equal(picked.find((c) => c.id === meeting.id).lowConfidence, true);

  // one per day by default, and not while one is open
  const n = P.queueMemoryCheck(NOW);
  assert.equal(n.sourceMemoryId, city.id);
  assert.match(n.text, /Is this still true\? "Lives in Pune"/);
  assert.equal(P.queueMemoryCheck(NOW + 1000), null);
  db.prepare("UPDATE nudges SET status = 'dismissed' WHERE id = ?").run(n.id);
  assert.equal(P.queueMemoryCheck(NOW + 2000), null, "daily allowance used");
  process.env.AURA_MEMORY_CHECKS_PER_DAY = "2";
  assert.equal(P.queueMemoryCheck(NOW + 3000).sourceMemoryId, job.id, "the dismissed one is not asked again");
  process.env.AURA_MEMORY_CHECKS_PER_DAY = "5";
  assert.equal(P.limits().memoryChecksPerDay, 2, "never more than 2 a day");
  delete process.env.AURA_MEMORY_CHECKS_PER_DAY;
});

test("memory checks: Yes confirms, Changed goes through propose(), Forget deletes", async () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_MEMORY");
  const a = await memoryAged("Lives in Pune", "personal", 100);
  const b = await memoryAged("Works at Infosys", "work", 90);
  const c = await memoryAged("Dating Priya", "people", 80);
  const ask = (id) => {
    const n = db.prepare("INSERT INTO nudges(type, text, due_at, status, source_memory_id, created_at, shown_at) VALUES ('memory_check', 'q', ?, 'shown', ?, ?, ?)").run(NOW, id, NOW, NOW).lastInsertRowid;
    return Number(n);
  };

  const t0 = Date.now();
  const yes = (await j("POST", `/api/nudges/${ask(a.id)}/decide`, { decision: "accept", answer: "yes" })).data;
  assert.equal(yes.nudge.outcome, "yes");
  assert.ok(mem.getMemory(a.id).updatedAt >= t0, "confirmed now");
  assert.ok(!P.selectMemoryChecks({ at: Date.now(), limit: 10 }).some((x) => x.id === a.id));

  const before = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM memory_proposals WHERE status = 'accepted'").get().n;
  const ch = await j("POST", `/api/nudges/${ask(b.id)}/decide`, { decision: "accept", answer: "changed", content: "Works at TCS" });
  assert.equal(ch.data.nudge.outcome, "changed");
  assert.equal(mem.getMemory(b.id).status, "superseded");
  assert.equal(ch.data.memory.content, "Works at TCS");
  assert.equal(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM memory_proposals WHERE status = 'accepted'").get().n, before + 1, "recorded as an accepted proposal");
  assert.equal((await j("POST", `/api/nudges/${ask(b.id)}/decide`, { decision: "accept", answer: "yes" })).status, 409, "the old fact is gone");

  const id = ask(c.id);
  const fg = await j("POST", `/api/nudges/${id}/decide`, { decision: "accept", answer: "forget" });
  assert.equal(fg.status, 200);
  assert.equal(mem.getMemory(c.id), null);
  const after = P.getNudge(id);
  assert.equal(after.outcome, "forget");
  assert.equal(after.text, "(memory deleted)", "the forgotten fact isn't kept in the nudge");

  assert.equal((await j("POST", `/api/nudges/${ask(a.id)}/decide`, { decision: "accept", answer: "maybe" })).status, 400);
  const s = P.stats().memory_check;
  assert.equal(s.byOutcome.yes, 1);
  assert.equal(s.byOutcome.changed, 1);
  assert.equal(s.byOutcome.forget, 1);
});

test("reminders: asked first with the resolved date, then shown when due", async () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_REMINDERS");
  const ask = P.onUserMessage(null, "Remind me to call Mom tomorrow at 5pm", NOW);
  assert.equal(ask.kind, "confirm");
  assert.equal(ask.text, 'Set a reminder: "call Mom" on Thu 15 Oct, 5:00 PM?');
  assert.equal(P.onUserMessage(null, "remind me to call Mom tomorrow at 5pm", NOW + 5000), null, "not twice");
  assert.equal(P.onUserMessage(null, "remind me to stretch", NOW), null, "no date: no reminder");

  const [shown] = P.surface(NOW);
  const r = await P.decide(shown.id, { decision: "accept" }, NOW + 1000);
  assert.equal(r.nudge.outcome, "scheduled");
  assert.equal(r.reminder.dueAt, IST(2026, 10, 15, 17));
  assert.deepEqual(P.surface(IST(2026, 10, 15, 16, 59)), [], "not before it's due");
  const [due] = P.surface(IST(2026, 10, 15, 17));
  assert.equal(due.text, "call Mom");
  const sn = await P.decide(due.id, { decision: "snooze" }, IST(2026, 10, 15, 17, 1));
  assert.equal(sn.nudge.dueAt, IST(2026, 10, 15, 17, 11));
  assert.equal((await P.decide(P.surface(IST(2026, 10, 15, 17, 11))[0].id, { decision: "accept" })).nudge.outcome, "done");

  // a confirmation nobody answered in time is dropped
  P.onUserMessage(null, "remind me to leave in 2 hours", NOW);
  P.surface(NOW + 3 * 3_600_000);
  assert.equal(db.prepare("SELECT outcome FROM nudges WHERE text LIKE '%leave%'").get().outcome, "expired");
});

test("briefing: one Gemini call on a short context, at most 5 lines", async () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_BRIEFING");
  const empty = await P.buildBriefing(NOW);
  assert.equal(empty.lines.length, 1);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 0, "nothing to say: no call");

  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_REMINDERS");
  P.onUserMessage(null, "remind me to pay rent tomorrow", Date.now());
  await P.decide(P.surface(Date.now())[0].id, { decision: "accept" });
  await mem.addMemory({ content: "Moved to Bengaluru", category: "personal" });
  db.prepare("INSERT INTO meetings(title, started_at, ended_at, minutes) VALUES ('Review', ?, ?, ?)").run(Date.now() - DAY, Date.now() - DAY, JSON.stringify({ actionItems: [{ task: "Fix the login bug", owner: "Sam", due: "Monday" }] }));
  briefingLines = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g"];
  const res = await j("POST", "/api/proactive/briefing");
  assert.equal(res.status, 200);
  assert.deepEqual(res.data.lines, ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
  assert.ok(calls[0].prompt.length <= 4000);
  assert.match(calls[0].prompt, /pay rent/);
  assert.match(calls[0].prompt, /Moved to Bengaluru/);
  assert.match(calls[0].prompt, /Fix the login bug/);
  assert.equal(P.stats().briefing.byOutcome.on_demand, 1);

  // once a day after AURA_BRIEFING_TIME
  process.env.AURA_BRIEFING_TIME = "08:30";

  assert.equal(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM nudges WHERE kind = 'daily'").get().n, 0, "too early");
  await P.tick(IST(2026, 10, 14, 8, 31));
  await P.tick(IST(2026, 10, 14, 9, 31));
  assert.equal(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM nudges WHERE kind = 'daily'").get().n, 1, "once that day");
  await P.tick(IST(2026, 10, 15, 8, 31));
  assert.equal(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM nudges WHERE kind = 'daily'").get().n, 2, "and again the next day");
  delete process.env.AURA_BRIEFING_TIME;
});

test("wiping all data removes nudges too", async () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_REMINDERS");
  threeDue(NOW);
  const r = (await j("DELETE", "/api/data")).data;
  assert.equal(r.nudges, 3);
});

test("voice: set_reminder reads back the time, a spoken yes sets it, the card shows during voice", async () => {
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_REMINDERS");
  const now = Date.now();
  P.setPresence({ voice: true }, now);
  assert.equal((await j("POST", "/api/proactive/reminders", { what: "x", when: "tomorrow" })).status, 200);
  P.deleteAllNudges();

  const r = (await j("POST", "/api/proactive/reminders", { what: "call my mother", when: "in 4 minutes" })).data;
  assert.equal(r.ok, true);
  assert.equal(r.needsConfirmation, true);
  assert.equal(r.what, "call my mother");
  assert.match(r.when, /\d:\d\d (AM|PM)/);
  const card = (await j("GET", "/api/proactive")).data.nudges;
  assert.equal(card.length, 1, "the confirmation card is shown although voice chat is on");
  assert.equal(card[0].id, r.reminderId);

  // the chat text that triggered the tool made its own card first: reused, not doubled
  const c = (await j("POST", "/api/conversations")).data;
  await j("POST", `/api/conversations/${c.id}/messages`, { role: "user", text: "Remind me to water the plants tomorrow at 7pm" });
  const viaTool = (await j("POST", "/api/proactive/reminders", { what: "water the plants", when: "tomorrow at 7pm", conversationId: c.id })).data;
  assert.equal(db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM nudges WHERE text LIKE '%water the plants%'").get().n, 1);

  const yes = (await j("POST", `/api/proactive/reminders/${r.reminderId}/confirm`)).data;
  assert.equal(yes.set, true);
  assert.equal(P.getNudge(r.reminderId).outcome, "scheduled");
  assert.equal((await j("POST", `/api/proactive/reminders/${r.reminderId}/confirm`)).data.alreadySet, true);
  const no = (await j("POST", `/api/proactive/reminders/${viaTool.reminderId}/cancel`)).data;
  assert.equal(no.cancelled, true);
  assert.equal(P.getNudge(viaTool.reminderId).outcome, "declined");

  // the reminder itself appears when due, even during voice chat
  const due = db.prepare("SELECT id FROM nudges WHERE kind = 'due'").get().id;
  const shown = P.surface(now + 5 * 60_000);
  assert.ok(shown.some((n) => n.id === due));

  // unusable times are reported back so the assistant can ask again
  assert.equal((await j("POST", "/api/proactive/reminders", { what: "x", when: "whenever" })).data.ok, false);
  assert.match((await j("POST", "/api/proactive/reminders", { what: "x", when: "yesterday at 9am" })).data.error, /already passed/);
  allOff();
  assert.equal((await j("POST", "/api/proactive/reminders", { what: "x", when: "tomorrow" })).status, 404);
});

test("voice: the assistant's instructions match whether reminders are on", async () => {
  const off = (await j("GET", "/api/live/setup")).data;
  assert.equal(off.reminders, false);
  assert.match(off.systemInstruction, /cannot set reminders/);
  on("AURA_PROACTIVE_REMINDERS");
  const onS = (await j("GET", "/api/live/setup")).data;
  assert.equal(onS.reminders, true);
  assert.match(onS.systemInstruction, /call set_reminder/);
  assert.match(onS.systemInstruction, /Never say a reminder is set unless confirm_reminder succeeded/);
});

FILE: server/tests/turns.test.mjs

// Unit tests for turning pyannote frame regions into speaker turns.
import { test } from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { regionsToTurns } from "../models.mjs";

// powerset ids: 0 silence, 1-3 one speaker, 4 = speakers 0+1, 5 = 0+2, 6 = 1+2
const r = (id, start, end) => ({ id, start, end });

test("one speaker covers the whole clip", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(regionsToTurns([r(0, 0, 0.3), r(1, 0.3, 4.5), r(0, 4.5, 5)], 5), [{ start: 0, end: 5, local: 0 }]);
});

test("a speaker change is cut in the middle of the pause", () => {
  const t = regionsToTurns([r(1, 0, 2), r(0, 2, 2.4), r(2, 2.4, 5)], 5);
  assert.equal(t.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(t.map((x) => x.local), [0, 1]);
  assert.ok(Math.abs(t[0].end - 2.2) < 1e-9 && t[1].start === t[0].end && t[1].end === 5);
});

test("short blips and overlaps don't create extra turns", () => {
  // 0.2 s of speaker 2 inside speaker 1, then an overlap that continues speaker 1
  const t = regionsToTurns([r(1, 0, 2), r(2, 2, 2.2), r(1, 2.2, 3), r(4, 3, 3.5), r(1, 3.5, 4)], 4);
  assert.deepEqual(t, [{ start: 0, end: 4, local: 0 }]);
});

test("the same speaker coming back keeps the same local index", () => {
  const t = regionsToTurns([r(1, 0, 1.5), r(2, 1.5, 3), r(1, 3, 4.5)], 4.5);
  assert.deepEqual(t.map((x) => x.local), [0, 1, 0]);
});

test("silence only falls back to one turn", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(regionsToTurns([r(0, 0, 3)], 3), [{ start: 0, end: 3, local: 0 }]);
});

FILE: src/App.tsx
================================================
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import "./App.scss";
import { LiveAPIProvider } from "./contexts/LiveAPIContext";
import Sidebar, { View } from "./components/Sidebar";
import AssistantView from "./views/AssistantView";
import MemoryView from "./views/MemoryView";
import MeetingView from "./views/MeetingView";
import SettingsPanel from "./components/SettingsPanel";
import Nudges from "./components/Nudges";
import { api, Health } from "./lib/api";

function App() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>("assistant");
  const [historyId, setHistoryId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [settingsOpen, setSettingsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [health, setHealth] = useState<Health | null>(null);
  const [serverDown, setServerDown] = useState(false);
  const [historyVersion, setHistoryVersion] = useState(0);

  const refreshHealth = useCallback(() => {
    api
      .get<Health>("/api/health")
      .then((h) => {
        setHealth(h);
        setServerDown(false);
      })
      .catch(() => setServerDown(true));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshHealth();
    const t = setInterval(refreshHealth, 8000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [refreshHealth]);

  const openHistory = (id: number | null) => {
    setHistoryId(id);
    setView("assistant");
  };

  return (
    <LiveAPIProvider>
      <div className="app">
        <Sidebar
          view={view}
          onView={(v) => {
            setView(v);
            if (v === "assistant") setHistoryId(null);
          }}
          historyId={historyId}
          onOpenHistory={openHistory}
          historyVersion={historyVersion}
          onOpenSettings={() => setSettingsOpen(true)}
          memoryReviews={health?.memoryReviews ?? 0}
        />
        <main className="main">
          {(serverDown || (health && !health.hasKey)) && (
            <div className="banner banner--warn" role="alert">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined">warning</span>
              {serverDown ? (
                <span>
                  The AURA server isn't running, so chat, memory and meetings are unavailable. Start everything with{" "}
                  <code>npm run dev</code>.
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span>
                  No Gemini API key found. Add <code>GEMINI_API_KEY=â€¦</code> to the <code>.env</code> file in the project
                  folder and restart the server.
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {view === "assistant" && (
            <AssistantView
              historyId={historyId}
              onCloseHistory={() => setHistoryId(null)}
              onHistoryChanged={() => setHistoryVersion((v) => v + 1)}
              historyVersion={historyVersion}
              memoryReviews={health?.memoryReviews ?? 0}
            />
          )}
          {view === "memory" && <MemoryView onReviewed={refreshHealth} />}
          {/* kept mounted so a meeting keeps recording while you look at other pages */}
          <MeetingView health={health} hidden={view !== "meeting"} />
        </main>
        <SettingsPanel
          open={settingsOpen}
          onClose={() => setSettingsOpen(false)}
          health={health}
          onDataChanged={() => {
            setHistoryVersion((v) => v + 1);
            refreshHealth();
          }}
        />
        {/* renders nothing unless an AURA_PROACTIVE_* switch is on */}
        <Nudges onChanged={refreshHealth} />
      </div>
    </LiveAPIProvider>
  );
}

export default App;

import { ReportHandler } from 'web-vitals';

const reportWebVitals = (onPerfEntry?: ReportHandler) => {
  if (onPerfEntry && onPerfEntry instanceof Function) {
    import('web-vitals').then(({ getCLS, getFID, getFCP, getLCP, getTTFB }) => {
      getCLS(onPerfEntry);
      getFID(onPerfEntry);
      getFCP(onPerfEntry);
      getLCP(onPerfEntry);
      getTTFB(onPerfEntry);
    });
  }
};

export default reportWebVitals;

FILE: src/components/ConfirmButton.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";

/** Two-step destructive button: first click arms it, second click confirms. */
export default function ConfirmButton({
  onConfirm,
  label,
  confirmLabel = "Confirm",
  icon = "delete",
  small,
  iconOnly,
  disabled,
}: {
  onConfirm: () => void | Promise<void>;
  label: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  icon?: string;
  small?: boolean;
  iconOnly?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const [armed, setArmed] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!armed) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setArmed(false), 4000);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [armed]);

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={cn(iconOnly && !armed ? "icon-button" : "btn btn--ghost", "btn--danger", { "btn--small": small, "is-armed": armed })}
      disabled={disabled || busy}
      title={armed ? confirmLabel : label}
      aria-label={armed ? confirmLabel : label}
      onClick={async () => {
        if (!armed) return setArmed(true);
        setBusy(true);
        try {
          await onConfirm();
        } finally {
          setBusy(false);
          setArmed(false);
        }
      }}
    >
      <span className="material-symbols-outlined">{icon}</span>
      {(!iconOnly || armed) && <span>{armed ? confirmLabel : label}</span>}
    </button>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";
import { api, downloadFile } from "../lib/api";
import ConfirmButton from "./ConfirmButton";

type Conv = { id: number; title: string; pinned: boolean };

/** Editable title plus pin, export and delete for one conversation. */
export function ConversationTitle({ conv, onChanged }: { conv: Conv; onChanged: () => void }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [value, setValue] = useState(conv.title);
  useEffect(() => setValue(conv.title), [conv.title]);

  const save = async () => {
    setEditing(false);
    const t = value.trim();
    if (t === conv.title) return;
    await api.patch(`/api/conversations/${conv.id}`, { title: t }).catch(() => {});
    onChanged();
  };

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <input
        className="title-input conv-title__input"
        value={value}
        autoFocus
        maxLength={120}
        onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={save}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter") e.currentTarget.blur();
          if (e.key === "Escape") {
            setValue(conv.title);
            setEditing(false);
          }
        }}
        aria-label="Conversation name"
      />
    );
  }
  return (
    <h1 className="conv-title">
      <button className="conv-title__btn" onClick={() => setEditing(true)} title="Rename">
        <span className="conv-title__text">{conv.title}</span>
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined conv-title__icon">edit</span>
      </button>
    </h1>
  );
}

export function ConversationActions({
  conv,
  onChanged,
  onDeleted,
  canDelete = true,
}: {
  conv: Conv;
  onChanged: () => void;
  onDeleted?: () => void;
  canDelete?: boolean;
}) {
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menu) return;
    const close = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!ref.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setMenu(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", close);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", close);
  }, [menu]);

  const togglePin = async () => {
    await api.patch(`/api/conversations/${conv.id}`, { pinned: !conv.pinned }).catch(() => {});
    onChanged();
  };

  return (
    <div className="conv-actions">
      <button
        className={cn("icon-button", { "is-on": conv.pinned })}
        onClick={togglePin}
        aria-pressed={conv.pinned}
        title={conv.pinned ? "Unpin" : "Pin to the top of the list"}
        aria-label={conv.pinned ? "Unpin conversation" : "Pin conversation"}
      >
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined">keep</span>
      </button>
      <div className="menu-wrap" ref={ref}>
        <button className="icon-button" onClick={() => setMenu((m) => !m)} aria-expanded={menu} aria-haspopup="menu" title="Export" aria-label="Export conversation">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined">download</span>
        </button>
        {menu && (
          <div className="menu" role="menu">
            {(
              [
                ["md", "Markdown (.md)"],
                ["txt", "Plain text (.txt)"],
                ["json", "JSON (.json)"],
              ] as const
            ).map(([fmt, label]) => (
              <button
                key={fmt}
                role="menuitem"
                onClick={() => {
                  setMenu(false);
                  downloadFile(`/api/conversations/${conv.id}/export?format=${fmt}`, `conversation.${fmt}`).catch((e: Error) => alert(e.message));
                }}
              >
                {label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      {canDelete && onDeleted && (
        <ConfirmButton
          small
          iconOnly
          onConfirm={async () => {
            await api.del(`/api/conversations/${conv.id}`);
            onDeleted();
          }}
          label="Delete conversation"
          confirmLabel="Delete for good"
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";
import { DOCUMENT_ACCEPT, DOCUMENT_LIMIT_MB, DocumentInfo } from "../lib/api";

export const fileSize = (n: number) =>
  n < 1024 ? `${n} B` : n < 1048576 ? `${Math.round(n / 1024)} KB` : `${(n / 1048576).toFixed(n < 10485760 ? 1 : 0)} MB`;

function docIcon(d: { name: string; kind?: string }) {
  const e = d.name.toLowerCase().split(".").pop();
  if (e === "pdf") return "picture_as_pdf";
  if (e === "pptx") return "slideshow";
  if (e === "xlsx" || e === "csv" || e === "tsv") return "table_chart";
  if (d.kind === "image" || /^(png|jpe?g|webp|hei[cf])$/.test(e || "")) return "image";
  if (e === "docx") return "description";
  return "article";
}

/** A document the user added, shown in the conversation. */
export function DocumentCard({
  name,
  doc,
  onAsk,
  onRetry,
}: {
  name: string;
  doc?: DocumentInfo;
  onAsk?: (question: string) => void;
  onRetry?: () => void;
}) {
  const a = doc?.analysis;
  const meta = doc ? [doc.label, fileSize(doc.size), a?.pages ? `${a.pages} page${a.pages === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : null].filter(Boolean).join(" Â· ") : null;
  return (
    <article className={cn("doc-card", { "doc-card--gone": !doc })}>
      <header className="doc-card__head">
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined doc-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">
          {docIcon({ name, kind: doc?.kind })}
        </span>
        <div className="doc-card__title">
          {doc ? (
            <a href={`/api/documents/${doc.id}/file`} download={doc.name} title="Download the original">
              {name}
            </a>
          ) : (
            <span>{name}</span>
          )}
          <span className="doc-card__meta">{doc ? meta : "Removed from this conversation"}</span>
        </div>
      </header>

      {doc?.status === "analysing" && (
        <p className="doc-card__status">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined spin" aria-hidden="true">progress_activity</span>
          Reading the documentâ€¦
        </p>
      )}
      {doc?.status === "error" && (
        <p className="doc-card__status doc-card__status--error">
          <span>Couldn't read it: {doc.error}</span>
          {onRetry && (
            <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" onClick={onRetry}>
              Try again
            </button>
          )}
        </p>
      )}
      {doc?.status === "ready" && a && (
        <>
          <p className="doc-card__overview">{a.overview}</p>
          {a.keyPoints.length > 0 && (
            <details className="doc-card__points">
              <summary>Key points</summary>
              <ul>
                {a.keyPoints.map((k, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>{k}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </details>
          )}
          {doc.truncated && <p className="doc-card__note">This document is long, so only its first part is used for answers.</p>}
          {onAsk && a.suggestedQuestions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="doc-card__ask" aria-label="Ask about this document">
              {a.suggestedQuestions.map((q) => (
                <button key={q} className="chip" onClick={() => onAsk(q)}>
                  {q}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

/** Paperclip button that opens a panel above the message box: add, see and remove documents. */
export function AttachMenu({
  documents,
  onAdd,
  onRemove,
}: {
  documents: DocumentInfo[];
  onAdd: (files: File[]) => Promise<{ name: string; error: string }[]>;
  onRemove: (id: number) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<{ name: string; error: string }[]>([]);
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const close = (e: MouseEvent) => !wrap.current?.contains(e.target as Node) && setOpen(false);
    const esc = (e: globalThis.KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && setOpen(false);
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", close);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", esc);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", close);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", esc);
    };
  }, [open]);

  const add = async (files: File[]) => {
    if (!files.length) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setErrors([]);
    try {
      const failed = await onAdd(files);
      setErrors(failed);
      if (!failed.length) setOpen(false);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      if (input.current) input.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="attach" ref={wrap}>
      <button
        type="button"
        className={cn("icon-button attach__button", { "is-on": open })}
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
        title="Add documents"
        aria-label={documents.length ? `Documents (${documents.length})` : "Add documents"}
      >
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined">attach_file</span>
        {documents.length > 0 && <span className="attach__count">{documents.length}</span>}
      </button>
      <input
        ref={input}
        type="file"
        multiple
        accept={DOCUMENT_ACCEPT}
        hidden
        onChange={(e) => add(Array.from(e.target.files || []))}
      />
      {open && (
        <div className="attach__panel" role="dialog" aria-label="Documents in this conversation">
          <div className="attach__head">
            <strong>Documents in this conversation</strong>
            <button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} aria-label="Close">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined">expand_more</span>
            </button>
          </div>
          {documents.length > 0 ? (
            <ul className="attach__list">
              {documents.map((d) => (
                <li key={d.id}>
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined attach__icon" aria-hidden="true">
                    {docIcon(d)}
                  </span>
                  <span className="attach__name">
                    <span title={d.name}>{d.name}</span>
                    <small>
                      {d.status === "analysing" ? "Readingâ€¦" : d.status === "error" ? "Couldn't read it" : `${d.label} Â· ${fileSize(d.size)}`}
                    </small>
                  </span>
                  <button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={() => onRemove(d.id)} title="Remove from this conversation" aria-label={`Remove ${d.name}`}>
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined">close</span>
                  </button>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          ) : (
            <p className="attach__empty">Add a document and ask AURA about it, by voice or by typing.</p>
          )}
          {errors.length > 0 && (
            <ul className="attach__errors" role="alert">
              {errors.map((e) => (
                <li key={e.name}>
                  <strong>{e.name}:</strong> {e.error}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
          <div className="attach__foot">
            <button type="button" className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => input.current?.click()}>
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined">{busy ? "progress_activity" : "upload_file"}</span>
              {busy ? "Addingâ€¦" : "Add files"}
            </button>
            <span className="attach__hint">
              PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, text or images, up to {DOCUMENT_LIMIT_MB.inline} MB. You can also drop files into the chat.
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { api, Meeting } from "../lib/api";
import { relativeTime } from "../lib/format";

/**
 * After a meeting: minutes of meeting (on request) and what went into long-term memory.
 * `transcriptBusy`: lines are still being transcribed.
 */
export default function MeetingNotes({
  m,
  transcriptBusy,
  onUpdated,
  onError,
}: {
  m: Meeting;
  transcriptBusy: boolean;
  onUpdated: (m: Meeting) => void;
  onError: (e: string) => void;
}) {
  const [writing, setWriting] = useState(false);
  const [memorizing, setMemorizing] = useState(false);
  const lines = m.segments.filter((s) => s.text?.trim()).length;
  if (!lines) return null;

  const write = async () => {
    setWriting(true);
    try {
      onUpdated(await api.post<Meeting>(`/api/meetings/${m.id}/minutes`));
    } catch (e: any) {
      onError(`Couldn't write the minutes. ${e.message}`);
    } finally {
      setWriting(false);
    }
  };
  const remove = async () => {
    try {
      onUpdated(await api.del<Meeting>(`/api/meetings/${m.id}/minutes`));
    } catch (e: any) {
      onError(e.message);
    }
  };
  const memorize = async () => {
    setMemorizing(true);
    try {
      onUpdated(await api.post<Meeting>(`/api/meetings/${m.id}/memorize`));
    } catch (e: any) {
      onError(`Couldn't update memory. ${e.message}`);
    } finally {
      setMemorizing(false);
    }
  };

  const mi = m.minutes;
  const newer = mi ? lines - mi.lines : 0;

  return (
    <section className="notes" aria-label="Minutes and memory">
      {!mi ? (
        <div className="notes__ask">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined notes__icon" aria-hidden="true">summarize</span>
          <div className="notes__ask-text">
            <strong>Minutes of meeting</strong>
            <span>{transcriptBusy ? "Available once the transcript is finished." : "A summary, decisions, action items and open questions from this transcript."}</span>
          </div>
          <button className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={writing || transcriptBusy} onClick={write}>
            {writing ? "Writing minutesâ€¦" : "Write minutes"}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <article className="minutes">
          <header className="minutes__head">
            <h2>Minutes of meeting</h2>
            <span className="muted">Written {m.minutesAt ? relativeTime(m.minutesAt) : ""}</span>
            <span className="minutes__actions">
              <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" disabled={writing || transcriptBusy} onClick={write}>
                {writing ? "Rewritingâ€¦" : "Rewrite"}
              </button>
              <button className="icon-button" onClick={remove} title="Remove the minutes" aria-label="Remove the minutes">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined">close</span>
              </button>
            </span>
          </header>
          {newer > 0 && (
            <p className="minutes__stale">
              {newer} line{newer === 1 ? " was" : "s were"} added or fixed since these were written. Rewrite to include {newer === 1 ? "it" : "them"}.
            </p>
          )}
          {mi.summary && <p className="minutes__summary">{mi.summary}</p>}
          <div className="minutes__grid">
            <MinutesList title="Decisions" items={mi.decisions} />
            <MinutesList title="Key points" items={mi.keyPoints} />
            {mi.actionItems.length > 0 && (
              <div className="minutes__block minutes__block--wide">
                <h3>Action items</h3>
                <ul className="minutes__actions-list">
                  {mi.actionItems.map((a, i) => (
                    <li key={i}>
                      <span>{a.task}</span>
                      {(a.owner || a.due) && (
                        <span className="minutes__meta">
                          {a.owner && <span>{a.owner}</span>}
                          {a.due && <span>Due {a.due}</span>}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            )}
            <MinutesList title="Open questions" items={mi.openQuestions} />
          </div>
          <p className="minutes__note">Written by Gemini from the transcript. Speaker names come from voice recognition, so check who owns what.</p>
        </article>
      )}

      {m.refined && (
        <p className="notes__memory">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">
            {m.memoryStatus === "error" ? "error" : "neurology"}
          </span>
          <span>
            {m.memoryStatus === "running" || memorizing
              ? "Adding what matters from this meeting to memoryâ€¦"
              : m.memoryStatus === "done"
                ? m.memoryCount
                  ? `Memory updated from this meeting: ${m.memoryCount} change${m.memoryCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}. You'll find them on the Memory page.`
                  : "Nothing from this meeting needed remembering."
                : m.memoryStatus === "error"
                  ? `Couldn't update memory from this meeting: ${m.memoryError}`
                  : "This meeting isn't in AURA's memory."}
          </span>
          {m.memoryStatus !== "running" && !memorizing && (
            <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" onClick={memorize}>
              {m.memoryStatus === "done" ? "Check again" : m.memoryStatus === "error" ? "Try again" : "Add to memory"}
            </button>
          )}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function MinutesList({ title, items }: { title: string; items: string[] }) {
  if (!items.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className="minutes__block">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      <ul>
        {items.map((t, i) => (
          <li key={i}>{t}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";
import { api, MemoryProposal } from "../lib/api";

/**
 * Changes AURA wants to make to memories you already have. Nothing changes until you decide.
 * `signal` is any value that changes when there may be new proposals (e.g. the pending count).
 */
export default function MemoryReview({
  signal,
  compact,
  onChanged,
}: {
  signal?: unknown;
  compact?: boolean;
  onChanged?: () => void;
}) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<MemoryProposal[]>([]);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    api
      .get<MemoryProposal[]>("/api/memories/proposals")
      .then(setItems)
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);
  useEffect(load, [load, signal]);

  const decide = async (p: MemoryProposal, accept: boolean) => {
    setBusy(p.id);
    setError(null);
    try {
      if (accept) await api.post(`/api/memories/proposals/${p.id}/accept`, editing[p.id] != null ? { content: editing[p.id] } : {});
      else await api.post(`/api/memories/proposals/${p.id}/reject`);
      setEditing(({ [p.id]: _, ...rest }) => rest);
      load();
      onChanged?.();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  const shown = compact ? items.slice(0, 1) : items;
  if (!items.length) return null;

  return (
    <section className={cn("review", { "review--compact": compact })} aria-label="Memory changes to review">
      {!compact && (
        <h2 className="review__title">
          Needs your OK <span className="review__count">{items.length}</span>
        </h2>
      )}
      {error && <p className="review__error">{error}</p>}
      {shown.map((p) => {
        const old = p.current?.content ?? "";
        const isEditing = editing[p.id] != null;
        return (
          <article key={p.id} className="review__card">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined review__icon" aria-hidden="true">
              {p.action === "update" ? "published_with_changes" : p.action === "retire" ? "history" : "delete"}
            </span>
            <div className="review__body">
              <p className="review__q">
                {p.action === "update"
                  ? "Update this memory?"
                  : p.action === "retire"
                    ? "Is this no longer true?"
                    : "You asked AURA to forget this. Delete it?"}
                {compact && items.length > 1 && <span className="muted"> ({items.length - 1} more on the Memory page)</span>}
              </p>
              <p className={cn("review__old", { "review__old--struck": p.action === "update" && !isEditing })}>{old}</p>
              {p.action === "update" &&
                (isEditing ? (
                  <textarea
                    className="review__edit"
                    value={editing[p.id]}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditing((x) => ({ ...x, [p.id]: e.target.value }))}
                    rows={2}
                    autoFocus
                    aria-label="New wording"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <p className="review__new">{p.content}</p>
                ))}
              <div className="review__actions">
                <button className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={busy === p.id} onClick={() => decide(p, true)}>
                  {p.action === "update" ? "Update" : p.action === "retire" ? "Mark outdated" : "Delete"}
                </button>
                {p.action === "update" && !isEditing && (
                  <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" disabled={busy === p.id} onClick={() => setEditing((x) => ({ ...x, [p.id]: p.content || "" }))}>
                    Edit first
                  </button>
                )}
                <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" disabled={busy === p.id} onClick={() => decide(p, false)}>
                  Keep as is
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </article>
        );
      })}
    </section>
  );
}

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";
import { api, Nudge, ProactiveState } from "../lib/api";
import { useLiveAPIContext } from "../contexts/LiveAPIContext";
import { NUDGES_REFRESH } from "../hooks/use-live-api";

const POLL_MS = 15_000; // reminders are spoken within about 15 s of their time

// per-browser conveniences (storage may be unavailable: then everything still works, just not remembered)
const SPEAK_KEY = "aura.speakReminders";
const SPOKEN_KEY = "aura.spokenReminders";
const readStore = (k: string) => {
  try {
    return window.localStorage.getItem(k);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};
const writeStore = (k: string, v: string) => {
  try {
    window.localStorage.setItem(k, v);
  } catch {}
};

/** Read text aloud with the browser's own speech engine, preferring a voice installed on this computer. */
function speakAloud(text: string) {
  const synth = window.speechSynthesis;
  if (!synth || typeof SpeechSynthesisUtterance === "undefined") return false;
  try {
    const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    const voices = synth.getVoices();
    const en = (v: SpeechSynthesisVoice) => v.lang.toLowerCase().startsWith("en");
    u.voice = voices.find((v) => v.localService && en(v)) || voices.find(en) || null;
    u.rate = 1;
    synth.cancel();
    synth.speak(u);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}
const HEARTBEAT_MS = 60_000;

const when = (t?: number) =>
  t ? new Date(t).toLocaleString(undefined, { weekday: "short", day: "numeric", month: "short", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }) : "";

/**
 * AURA's own suggestions: memory checks, reminders, a short briefing. Shows nothing at all unless one of the
 * AURA_PROACTIVE_* switches is on in the server's .env. During a voice conversation only reminder cards show.
 */
export default function Nudges({ onChanged }: { onChanged?: () => void }) {
  const { status, announceReminder } = useLiveAPIContext();
  const live = status !== "disconnected";
  const [state, setState] = useState<ProactiveState | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [brief, setBrief] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const seen = useRef(new Set<number>());
  const [speak, setSpeak] = useState(() => readStore(SPEAK_KEY) !== "0");
  // reminders already spoken (kept across reloads so one isn't read out twice)
  const spoken = useRef(
    new Set<number>(
      (() => {
        try {
          return JSON.parse(readStore(SPOKEN_KEY) || "[]") as number[];
        } catch {
          return [];
        }
      })()
    )
  );

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const s = await api.get<ProactiveState>("/api/proactive");
      setState(s);
      // something new arrived: open the inbox
      if (s.nudges.some((n) => !seen.current.has(n.id))) setOpen(true);
      s.nudges.forEach((n) => seen.current.add(n.id));
    } catch {
      // server down: the app shows its own banner
    }
  }, []);

  const enabled = !!state && Object.values(state.switches).some(Boolean);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
    // the voice assistant just used a reminder tool
    window.addEventListener(NUDGES_REFRESH, load);
    return () => window.removeEventListener(NUDGES_REFRESH, load);
  }, [load]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const t = setInterval(load, POLL_MS);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [enabled, load]);

  // tell the server while voice chat runs, so it holds everything back
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const say = (voice: boolean) => api.post("/api/proactive/presence", { voice }).catch(() => {});
    say(live);
    if (!live) return;
    const t = setInterval(() => say(true), HEARTBEAT_MS);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(t);
      say(false);
    };
  }, [enabled, live]);

  // say a reminder out loud when it comes due: in AURA's voice during a voice session, otherwise with the browser's speech
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!state) return;
    const due = state.nudges.filter((n) => n.type === "reminder" && n.kind === "due" && !spoken.current.has(n.id));
    if (!due.length) return;
    for (const n of due) {
      spoken.current.add(n.id);
      // one that came due long ago (the app was closed) only gets its card
      if (!speak || Date.now() - n.dueAt > 10 * 60_000) continue;
      if (!announceReminder(n.text)) speakAloud(`Reminder: ${n.text}`);
    }
    writeStore(SPOKEN_KEY, JSON.stringify([...spoken.current].slice(-100)));
  }, [state, speak, announceReminder]);

  const toggleSpeak = () => {
    setSpeak((s) => {
      writeStore(SPEAK_KEY, s ? "0" : "1");
      if (s) window.speechSynthesis?.cancel();
      return !s;
    });
  };

  if (!enabled || !state) return null;
  // during voice chat only reminder cards are shown
  const nudges = live ? state.nudges.filter((n) => n.type === "reminder") : state.nudges;
  if (live && !nudges.length) return null;

  const decide = async (n: Nudge, body: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.post(`/api/nudges/${n.id}/decide`, body);
      if (n.type === "memory_check") onChanged?.();
      await load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message);
      await load();
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const briefMe = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      setBrief((await api.post<{ lines: string[] }>("/api/proactive/briefing")).lines);
      setOpen(true);
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const count = nudges.length;
  if (!open) {
    return (
      <button className="nudges__pill" onClick={() => setOpen(true)} aria-label={count ? `From AURA (${count})` : "From AURA"}>
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">
          {count ? "notifications_unread" : "notifications"}
        </span>
        {count > 0 && <span className="nudges__count">{count}</span>}
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className="nudges" aria-label="From AURA" aria-live="polite">
      <header className="nudges__head">
        <strong>From AURA</strong>
        <div className="nudges__head-actions">
          {state.switches.reminders && (
            <button
              className="icon-button"
              onClick={toggleSpeak}
              aria-pressed={speak}
              aria-label={speak ? "Reminders are read aloud. Turn off" : "Reminders are silent. Read them aloud"}
              title={speak ? "Read reminders aloud: on" : "Read reminders aloud: off"}
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined">{speak ? "volume_up" : "volume_off"}</span>
            </button>
          )}
          {state.switches.briefing && !live && (
            <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" onClick={briefMe} disabled={busy}>
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined">summarize</span>
              Brief me
            </button>
          )}
          <button className="icon-button" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} aria-label="Hide">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined">expand_more</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {brief && (
        <div className="nudge nudge--brief">
          <ul>
            {brief.map((l, i) => (
              <li key={i}>{l}</li>
            ))}
          </ul>
          <div className="nudge__actions">
            <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" onClick={() => setBrief(null)}>
              Close
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {nudges.map((n) => (
        <NudgeCard key={n.id} n={n} busy={busy} onDecide={(body) => decide(n, body)} />
      ))}

      {!count && !brief && <p className="nudges__empty">Nothing right now.</p>}
      {error && (
        <p className="nudges__error" role="alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function NudgeCard({ n, busy, onDecide }: { n: Nudge; busy: boolean; onDecide: (body: Record<string, unknown>) => void }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [text, setText] = useState(n.payload?.memory || "");
  const later = (label = "Later") => (
    <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onDecide({ decision: "snooze" })}>
      {label}
    </button>
  );
  const dismiss = (label = "Dismiss") => (
    <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onDecide({ decision: "dismiss" })}>
      {label}
    </button>
  );

  if (n.type === "memory_check") {
    return (
      <article className="nudge">
        <p className="nudge__label">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">psychology</span>
          Is this still true?
          <button className="icon-button nudge__close" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onDecide({ decision: "dismiss" })} aria-label="Dismiss" title="Dismiss">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined">close</span>
          </button>
        </p>
        {editing ? (
          <form
            className="nudge__edit"
            onSubmit={(e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              if (text.trim()) onDecide({ decision: "accept", answer: "changed", content: text.trim() });
            }}
          >
            <label htmlFor={`nudge-${n.id}`}>What's true now?</label>
            <textarea id={`nudge-${n.id}`} rows={2} value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} autoFocus />
            <div className="nudge__actions">
              <button className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={busy || !text.trim()}>
                Save
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" onClick={() => setEditing(false)}>
                Cancel
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        ) : (
          <>
            <blockquote className="nudge__quote">{n.payload?.memory}</blockquote>
            {n.payload?.lowConfidence && <p className="nudge__note">Learned from a meeting transcript.</p>}
            <div className="nudge__actions">
              <button className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onDecide({ decision: "accept", answer: "yes" })}>
                Yes
              </button>
              <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setEditing(true)}>
                Changed
              </button>
              <button className="btn btn--ghost btn--small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onDecide({ decision: "accept", answer: "forget" })}>
                Forget
              </button>
              {later()}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </article>
    );
  }

  if (n.type === "reminder" && n.kind === "confirm") {
    return (
      <article className="nudge">
        <p className="nudge__label">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">alarm_add</span>
          Set a reminder?
        </p>
        <p className="nudge__text">{n.payload?.what}</p>
        <p className="nudge__when">
          {when(n.payload?.at)}
          {n.payload?.when && <span className="nudge__note"> (from "{n.payload.when}")</span>}
        </p>
        <div className="nudge__actions">
          <button className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onDecide({ decision: "accept" })}>
            Set reminder
          </button>
          {later()}
          {dismiss("No thanks")}
        </div>
      </article>
    );
  }

  if (n.type === "reminder") {
    return (
      <article className={cn("nudge", "nudge--due")}>
        <p className="nudge__label">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">alarm</span>
          Reminder Â· {when(n.payload?.at)}
        </p>
        <p className="nudge__text">{n.text}</p>
        <div className="nudge__actions">
          <button className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onDecide({ decision: "accept" })}>
            Done
          </button>
          {later("In 10 minutes")}
          {dismiss()}
        </div>
      </article>
    );
  }

  return (
    <article className="nudge nudge--brief">
      <p className="nudge__label">
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined" aria-hidden="true">summarize</span>
        Your briefing
      </p>
      <ul>
        {(n.payload?.lines || n.text.split("\n")).map((l, i) => (
          <li key={i}>{l}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <div className="nudge__actions">
        <button className="btn btn--primary btn--small" disabled={busy} onClick={() => onDecide({ decision: "accept" })}>
          Got it
        </button>
        {later()}
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

import cn from "classnames";

/**
 * AURA's mark: a glowing ring whose halo follows the audio level.
 * Used small in the sidebar and large as the voice button.
 */
export default function Orb({
  size = 120,
  level = 0,
  active = false,
  tone = "idle",
  logo = false,
}: {
  size?: number;
  level?: number;
  active?: boolean;
  tone?: "idle" | "listening" | "speaking" | "recording";
  /** Draw the AURA brand mark (public/logo-mark.png) instead of the plain core. */
  logo?: boolean;
}) {
  const l = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, level));
  return (
    <span
      className={cn("orb", `orb--${tone}`, { "orb--active": active, "orb--logo": logo })}
      style={{ width: size, height: size, ["--level" as any]: l.toFixed(3) }}
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <span className="orb__halo" />
      <span className="orb__core" />
      {logo && <img className="orb__logo" src={`${process.env.PUBLIC_URL || ""}/logo-mark.png`} alt="" draggable={false} />}
    </span>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";
import { api, Health, Settings } from "../lib/api";
import { useLiveAPIContext } from "../contexts/LiveAPIContext";
import ConfirmButton from "./ConfirmButton";

const VOICES = ["Kore", "Puck", "Charon", "Fenrir", "Aoede", "Leda", "Orus", "Zephyr"];
// Live API models (free tier: no daily request cap). Web search on the free tier may need a 2.5 model.
const LIVE_MODELS = [
  { id: "gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview", label: "Gemini 3.1 Flash Live (default, no web search on free tier)" },
  { id: "gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025", label: "Gemini 2.5 Flash native audio (web search works on free tier)" },
  { id: "gemini-3.8-live", label: "Gemini 3.8 Live" },
];

// language of the user's speech in voice chat (the server turns these into language codes)
const SPEECH_LANGUAGES: { id: Settings["assistantLanguage"]; label: string }[] = [
  { id: "auto", label: "Detect automatically" },
  { id: "en", label: "English" },
  { id: "hi", label: "Hindi" },
  { id: "en-hi", label: "English and Hindi" },
];

type Props = { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; health: Health | null; onDataChanged: () => void };

export default function SettingsPanel({ open, onClose, health, onDataChanged }: Props) {
  const [s, setS] = useState<Settings | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const live = useLiveAPIContext();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) api.get<Settings>("/api/settings").then(setS).catch((e) => setError(e.message));
  }, [open]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => e.key === "Escape" && onClose();
    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  }, [open, onClose]);

  const update = (patch: Partial<Settings>) => setS((cur) => (cur ? { ...cur, ...patch } : cur));

  const save = async () => {
    if (!s) return;
    try {
      setS(await api.put<Settings>("/api/settings", s));
      setSaved(true);
      setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 2000);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    }
  };

  const wipe = (url: string) => async () => {
    try {
      await api.del(url);
      if (url.includes("conversations") || url === "/api/data") live.newConversation();
      onDataChanged();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className={cn("scrim", { "is-open": open })} onClick={onClose} />
      <aside className={cn("drawer", { "is-open": open })} aria-hidden={!open} aria-label="Settings">
        <header className="drawer__head">
          <h2>Settings</h2>
          <button className="icon-button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close settings">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined">close</span>
          </button>
        </header>

        {error && <div className="banner banner--error">{error}</div>}

        {s && (
          <div className="drawer__body">
            <section>
              <h3>Assistant</h3>
              <label className="field">
                <span>Your name</span>
                <input value={s.userName} onChange={(e) => update({ userName: e.target.value })} placeholder="Optional" />
              </label>
              <label className="field">
                <span>Voice</span>
                <select value={s.voice} onChange={(e) => update({ voice: e.target.value })}>
                  {VOICES.map((v) => (
                    <option key={v}>{v}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </label>
              <label className="field">
                <span>Gemini Live model</span>
                <select value={s.liveModel} onChange={(e) => update({ liveModel: e.target.value })}>
                  {LIVE_MODELS.map((m) => (
                    <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>
                      {m.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                  {!LIVE_MODELS.some((m) => m.id === s.liveModel) && <option value={s.liveModel}>{s.liveModel} (custom)</option>}
                </select>
                <small className="muted">Applies to the next voice session. Web search on a Gemini 3 model needs paid search quota; pick the 2.5 model to use it for free.</small>
              </label>
              <label className="field">
                <span>Language you speak (for transcripts)</span>
                <select
                  value={s.assistantLanguage}
                  onChange={(e) => update({ assistantLanguage: e.target.value as Settings["assistantLanguage"] })}
                >
                  {SPEECH_LANGUAGES.map((l) => (
                    <option key={l.id} value={l.id}>
                      {l.label}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <small className="muted">
                  How AURA writes down what you say in voice chat. Choose English if your English shows up in Hindi script. AURA's
                  understanding and replies don't depend on it. Some Live models may ignore it.
                </small>
              </label>
              <label className="check">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={s.autoMemory} onChange={(e) => update({ autoMemory: e.target.checked })} />
                <span>Learn memories from conversations automatically</span>
              </label>
              <label className="check">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={s.confirmMemoryChanges} onChange={(e) => update({ confirmMemoryChanges: e.target.checked })} />
                <span>Ask me before changing or removing a memory I already have</span>
              </label>
              <label className="check">
                <input type="checkbox" checked={s.webSearch} onChange={(e) => update({ webSearch: e.target.checked })} />
                <span>Let AURA search the web (Google Search) for news and current information</span>
              </label>
              <p className="muted small">Voice, model, language and search changes apply to the next voice session.</p>
            </section>

            <section>
              <h3>Meeting Mode</h3>
              <fieldset className="field">
                <legend>Transcription</legend>
                <label className="check">
                  <input type="radio" name="transcriber" checked={s.meetingTranscriber === "live"} onChange={() => update({ meetingTranscriber: "live" })} />
                  <span>
                    Live: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe Live, streamed while you talk. No daily request limit on the free tier. Picks up languages automatically.
                  </span>
                </label>
                <label className="check">
                  <input type="radio" name="transcriber" checked={s.meetingTranscriber === "standard"} onChange={() => update({ meetingTranscriber: "standard" })} />
                  <span>Standard: a few seconds of speech per request to {health?.geminiModels.transcribe || "Gemini Flash-Lite"}. Uses the daily request quota.</span>
                </label>
              </fieldset>
              <label className="field">
                <span>Languages spoken in meetings (optional)</span>
                <input
                  value={s.meetingLanguage}
                  onChange={(e) => update({ meetingLanguage: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="e.g. English and Hindi, Hindi words in Latin script"
                />
              </label>
              <label className="check">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={s.meetingMemory}
                  disabled={!s.autoMemory}
                  onChange={(e) => update({ meetingMemory: e.target.checked })}
                />
                <span>
                  After a meeting, add decisions, plans and facts from it to memory (one {health?.geminiModels.text || "Gemini Flash-Lite"} request per meeting)
                  {!s.autoMemory && " â€” needs automatic memories turned on"}
                </span>
              </label>
              <label className="field">
                <span>
                  Name a registered voice from similarity <strong>{s.voiceMatchThreshold.toFixed(2)}</strong>
                </span>
                <input type="range" min={0.2} max={0.9} step={0.01} value={s.voiceMatchThreshold} onChange={(e) => update({ voiceMatchThreshold: Number(e.target.value) })} />
              </label>
              <label className="field">
                <span>
                  Treat as an already-heard voice from <strong>{s.voiceClusterThreshold.toFixed(2)}</strong>
                </span>
                <input type="range" min={0.2} max={0.9} step={0.01} value={s.voiceClusterThreshold} onChange={(e) => update({ voiceClusterThreshold: Number(e.target.value) })} />
              </label>
              <p className="muted small">
                Higher values mean fewer wrong names but more people split into extra speakers. Use <em>Test recognition</em> on the Voice profiles page to see
                the scores your voices get.
              </p>
            </section>

            <div className="drawer__save">
              <button className="btn btn--primary" onClick={save}>
                {saved ? "Saved" : "Save settings"}
              </button>
            </div>

            <section>
              <h3>Status</h3>
              <dl className="status-list">
                <dt>Gemini API key</dt>
                <dd className={health?.hasKey ? "ok" : "bad"}>{health ? (health.hasKey ? "Found on the server" : "Missing") : "Server offline"}</dd>
                <dt>Memory search model</dt>
                <dd className={health?.models.text.state === "ready" ? "ok" : health?.models.text.state === "error" ? "bad" : ""}>
                  {health?.models.text.state ?? "â€“"}
                  {health?.models.text.state === "error" && " (keyword search fallback)"}
                </dd>
                <dt>Speaker model</dt>
                <dd className={health?.models.speaker.state === "ready" ? "ok" : health?.models.speaker.state === "error" ? "bad" : ""}>{health?.models.speaker.state ?? "â€“"}</dd>
                <dt>Data folder</dt>
                <dd className="mono-break">{health?.dataDir ?? "â€“"}</dd>
              </dl>
            </section>

            <section>
              <h3>Your data</h3>
              <p className="muted small">Everything lives in the data folder above. Deleting is permanent.</p>
              <div className="danger-list">
                <ConfirmButton small onConfirm={wipe("/api/conversations")} label="Delete all conversations" confirmLabel="Yes, delete conversations" />
                <ConfirmButton small onConfirm={wipe("/api/memories")} label="Delete all memories" confirmLabel="Yes, delete memories" />
                <ConfirmButton small onConfirm={wipe("/api/meetings")} label="Delete all meeting transcripts" confirmLabel="Yes, delete transcripts" />
                <ConfirmButton small onConfirm={wipe("/api/data")} label="Delete everything, including voice profiles" confirmLabel="Yes, delete everything" />
              </div>
            </section>
          </div>
        )}
      </aside>
    </>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import cn from "classnames";
import { useLiveAPIContext } from "../contexts/LiveAPIContext";
import { api, ConversationSummary } from "../lib/api";
import { relativeTime } from "../lib/format";
import Logo from "./Logo";
import { setFaviconState } from "../lib/favicon";

export type View = "assistant" | "memory" | "meeting";

type Props = {
  view: View;
  onView: (v: View) => void;
  historyId: number | null;
  onOpenHistory: (id: number | null) => void;
  historyVersion: number;
  onOpenSettings: () => void;
  memoryReviews: number;
};

const NAV: { id: View; label: string; icon: string }[] = [
  { id: "assistant", label: "Assistant", icon: "graphic_eq" },
  { id: "memory", label: "Memory", icon: "neurology" },
  { id: "meeting", label: "Meeting Mode", icon: "groups" },
];

export default function Sidebar({ view, onView, historyId, onOpenHistory, historyVersion, onOpenSettings, memoryReviews }: Props) {
  const { status, conversationId, messages, micOn, outVolume, micVolume } = useLiveAPIContext();
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<ConversationSummary[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => setFaviconState({ voice: status === "connected" }), [status]);
  const messageCount = messages.filter((m) => !m.pending).length;
  useEffect(() => {
    api
      .get<ConversationSummary[]>("/api/conversations")
      .then(setHistory)
      .catch(() => setHistory([]));
  }, [conversationId, messageCount, historyVersion]);

  const statusLabel =
    status === "connected" ? (micOn ? "Listening" : "Connected, mic off") : status === "connecting" ? "Connectingâ€¦" : "Voice offline";

  return (
    <aside className="sidebar">
      <div className="sidebar__brand">
        <Logo size={36} level={status === "connected" ? Math.max(outVolume * 4, micOn ? micVolume * 3 : 0) : 0} live={status === "connected"} />
      </div>

      <nav className="sidebar__nav" aria-label="Main">
        {NAV.map((n) => (
          <button
            key={n.id}
            className={cn("nav-item", { "nav-item--active": view === n.id && !(n.id === "assistant" && historyId) })}
            onClick={() => onView(n.id)}
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined">{n.icon}</span>
            {n.label}
            {n.id === "memory" && memoryReviews > 0 && (
              <span className="nav-item__badge" title={`${memoryReviews} memory change${memoryReviews === 1 ? "" : "s"} to review`}>
                {memoryReviews}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>

      <div className="sidebar__history">
        {history.length === 0 && (
          <>
            <h2 className="sidebar__heading">Conversations</h2>
            <p className="sidebar__empty">Past conversations will appear here.</p>
          </>
        )}
        {[
          { label: "Pinned", items: history.filter((c) => c.pinned) },
          { label: "Conversations", items: history.filter((c) => !c.pinned) },
        ]
          .filter((g) => g.items.length)
          .map((g) => (
            <div key={g.label} className="sidebar__group">
              <h2 className="sidebar__heading">{g.label}</h2>
              <ul>
                {g.items.map((c) => (
                  <li key={c.id}>
                    <button
                      className={cn("history-item", {
                        "history-item--active": historyId === c.id,
                        "history-item--live": c.id === conversationId && !historyId,
                      })}
                      onClick={() => onOpenHistory(c.id === conversationId ? null : c.id)}
                      title={c.title}
                    >
                      <span className="history-item__title">{c.title}</span>
                      <span className="history-item__meta">{c.id === conversationId ? "Current" : relativeTime(c.updatedAt)}</span>
                    </button>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          ))}
      </div>

      <div className="sidebar__footer">
        <div className={cn("status-pill", `status-pill--${status}`, { "status-pill--mic": micOn })} aria-live="polite">
          <span className="status-pill__dot" />
          {statusLabel}
        </div>
        <button className="icon-button" onClick={onOpenSettings} aria-label="Settings" title="Settings">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined">settings</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}

export type LiveAPIProviderProps = {
  children: ReactNode;
};

export const LiveAPIProvider: FC<LiveAPIProviderProps> = ({ children }) => {
  const liveAPI = useLiveAPI();

  return (
    <LiveAPIContext.Provider value={liveAPI}>
      {children}
    </LiveAPIContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useLiveAPIContext = () => {
  const context = useContext(LiveAPIContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useLiveAPIContext must be used wihin a LiveAPIProvider");
  }
  return context;
};
